amīṣāṃ cittāni pratimohayantī gṛhāṇāṅgāny apve parehi abhi prehi nir daha hṛtsu śokair grāhyāmitrāṃs tamasā vidhya śatrūn
asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣām asmān abhy aity ojasā spardhamānā tāṃ guhata tamasāpavratena yathaiṣām anyo anyaṃ na jānāt
agnir no vidvān praty etu śatrūn pratidahann abhiśastim arātim sa senāṃ mohayatu pareṣāṃ nihastāṃś ca kṛṇavaj jātavedāḥ
yūyam ugrā maruta īdṛśe stha abhi preta mṛḍata sahadhvam amīmṛḍan vasavo nāthitebhyo +'gnir hy eṣāṃ vidvān praty etu śatrūn
amitrasenāṃ maghavann asmāñ chatrūyatām abhi yuvaṃ tān indra vṛtrahann agniś ca dahataṃ prati
prasūta indraḥ pravatā haribhyāṃ pra te vajraḥ pra mṛṇann etu śatrūn jahi pratīco anūcaḥ parāco viśvaṃ hi riṣṭaṃ kṛṇuhi satyam eṣām
senāmohanaṃ kṛṇv indrāmitrebhyas tvam agner vātasya dhrājyā tān viṣūco vi nāśaya
indraḥ senāṃ mohayatu maruto ghnantv ojasā cakṣūṃṣy agnir ā dattāṃ punar etu parājitām
ekaśataṃ viṣkandhāni viṣṭhitā pṛthivīm anu teṣāṃ tu sarveṣām idam astu viṣkandhadūṣaṇam
karṣaphasya viśaphasya dyauṣpitā pṛthivī mātā yathābhicakra devās tathāpi kṛṇutā punaḥ
aśleṣmāṇo adhārayan tathā tan manunā kṛtam kṛṇomi vadhri viṣkandhaṃ muṣkābarho gavām iva
sūtre piśaṅge khṛgalaṃ yad ābadhnanti vedhasaḥ śravasyaṃ śuṣmaṃ kābavaṃ vadhriṃ kṛṇvantu bandhuraḥ
yenā śravasyo caratha devā ivāsuramāyayā śunāṃ kapir iva dūṣaṇo bandhurā kābavasya ca
duṣṭyai hi tvā bhantsyāmi dūṣayitvā kābavam ud āśavo rathā iva śapathebhiḥ sariṣyatha
yamasya lokād adhy ā babhūvitha pramadā martān pra yunakṣudhīraḥ ekākinā sarathaṃ yāsi vidvān svapna mimāno asurasya yonau
bambas tvāgre viśvavayāpaśyat purā rātryā janitor eke ahni tataḥ svapnedam adhy ā babhūvitha viṣvaṅvarūpam apagūhamānaḥ
bṛhan grāvāsurebhyo 'dhi devān upāvavarta mahimānam icchan tasmai svapnāya dadhur ādhipatyaṃ trayastriṃśāsaḥ svar ānaśānāḥ
naitāṃ viduḥ pitaro nota devā yaiṣā jalpiś caraty antaredam trite svapnam adadhur āptye nara ādityāso varuṇenānuśiṣṭāḥ
vy asya krūram abhi yantu duṣkṛto 'svapnena sukṛtaḥ puṇyam āyuḥ svar madasi parameṇa bandhunā tapyamānasya manaso 'dhi jajñiṣe
vidma te sarvāḥ parijāḥ purastād vidma svapna yo adhipā iho te yaśasvino no yaśaseha pāhy ārād dviṣebhir apa yāhi dūram
ambāḥ sumukhāḥ sṛjata padvat sṛjata satyajñeyam sṛjāmy ahaṃ dūtān asmai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
indram aham iha huve somapām ubhayāvinam asmai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
varuṇam aham iha huva ugraṃ rājanyaiḥ saha asmai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
aditim aham iha huve sūraputrāṃ kanīnikām asmai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
bṛhaspatim aham iha huve yo devānāṃ purohito 'smai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
āṇāścāṇāś caṇḍāmarkā asmai viṣāya hantave vār ugram arasaṃ viṣam āheyam arasaṃ viṣaṃ nirviṣam
navānāṃ navatīnāṃ viṣasya ropuṣīṇām sarvāsām agrabhaṃ nāma vītāpetārasaṃ viṣam
mṛtyur eko yama ekaḥ śarva ekaḥ śarur bhavaḥ te naḥ kṛṇvantu bheṣajaṃ devasenābhyas pari
punar no yamaḥ pitṛbhir dadātu punar mitrāvaruṇā vāto agniḥ aghamāro aghaśaṃsaḥ punar dāt punar no devī nirṛtir dadātu
yā devaiḥ prahiteṣuḥ patāt tapase vā mahase vāvasṛṣṭā somas tvām asmad yāvayatu vidvān pitaro vā devahutā nṛcakṣasaḥ
sahasrākṣo amartyaḥ pururūpa ihāvatu sakhye ta ugra mā riṣaṃ sahaguḥ sahapūruṣaḥ
yas te manyuḥ sahasrākṣa viṣeṇa pariṣicyate tena tvam asmabhyaṃ mṛḍa śivo naḥ śambhur ā cara
mā te mayau sahasrākṣa bhāme bhūn māmakaṃ jagat yo no dveṣṭi taṃ gaccha yaṃ dviṣmas taṃ jahi
ye sthāsyāṃ prācyāṃ diśi hetayo nāma devās teṣāṃ vo agnir iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
ye sthāsyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśy aviṣyavo nāma devās teṣaṃ va āpa iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
ye sthāsyāṃ pratīcyāṃ diśi virājo nāma devās teṣaṃ vaḥ kāma iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
ye sthāsyām udīcyāṃ diśi pravidhyanto nāma devās teṣaṃ vo vāta iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
ye sthāsyāṃ dhruvāyāṃ diśi vilimpā nāma devās teṣaṃ vo 'nnam iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
ye sthāsyām ūrdhvāyāṃ diśy aviṣyanto nāma devās teṣaṃ vo varṣam iṣavaḥ te no mṛḍata te no 'dhi brūta tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā
yo apsv antar yo vṛtre antar yaḥ puruṣe yo aśmani ya āviveśauṣadhīr yo vanaspatīṃs tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
yaḥ some antar ya u goṣv antar ya āviṣṭo vayasi yo mṛgeṣu ya āviveśa dvipado yaś catuṣpadas tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
ya indreṇa sarathaṃ saṃbabhūva vaiśvānara uta viśvadāvyaḥ yaṃ johavīmi pṛtanāsuṣāsahiṃ tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
yo devo viśvād yam u kāmam āhur yaṃ dātāraṃ pratigṛhṇantam āhuḥ yo dhīraḥ śakraḥ paribhūr adābhyas tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
yaṃ tvā hotāraṃ manasābhisaṃvidus trayodaśa bhauvanāḥ pañca mānavāḥ varcodhase yaśase sūnṛtāvate tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
ukṣānnāya vaśānnāya somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase vaiśvānarasya jyeṣṭhebhyas tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
divaṃ pṛthivīm antarikṣaṃ ye vidyutam anusaṃcaranti ye dikṣv antar ya u vāte antas tebhyo agnibhyo hutam astv etat
bṛhaspatiṃ varuṇaṃ mitram agniṃ hiraṇyapāṇiṃ savitāram indram viśvān devān aṅgiraso havāmaha imaṃ kravyādaṃ śamayantv agnim
śānto agniḥ kravyād atho puruṣareṣaṇaḥ atho yo viśvadāvyas taṃ kravyādam aśīśamam
āyam agan parṇamaṇir balī balena pramṛṇan sapatnān ojo devānāṃ paya oṣadhīnāṃ mayi rāṣṭraṃ jinvatv aprayucchan
mayi rāṣṭraṃ parṇamaṇe mayi dhārayā śriyam ahaṃ rāṣṭrasyābhīvarge yujā bhūyāsam uttaraḥ
yaṃ nidadhur vanaspatau vājaṃ devāḥ priyaṃ nidhim taṃ ma indraḥ sahāyuṣā maṇiṃ dadhātu bhartave
somasya parṇaḥ saha ugram āgann indreṇa datto varuṇena sakhyā tam ahaṃ bibharmi bahu rocamāno dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
ā mā rukṣat parṇamaṇir mahyā ariṣṭatātaye yathāham uttaro 'sāni mānuṣyā adhi sampadaḥ
punar maitv indriyaṃ punar ātmā draviṇaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca punar agnayo dhiṣṇyāso yathāsthāma kalpayantām ihaiva
ye takṣāṇo rathakārāḥ karmārā ye manīṣiṇaḥ sarvāṃs tān parṇa randhaya upastiṃ kṛṇu me janam
upastir astu vaiśya uta śūdra utāryaḥ sarvāṃs tān parṇa randhaya upastiṃ kṛṇu me janam
yena vehad babhūvitha nāśayāmasi tad vayam idaṃ tad anyatra tvad apa dūre ni dadhmasi
ā te garbho yonim etu pumān vāṇa iveṣudhim ā vīro 'tra jāyatāṃ putras te daśamāsyaḥ
pumāṃsaṃ putraṃ janaya taṃ pumān anu jāyatām bhavāsi putrāṇāṃ mātā jātānāṃ janayāsi ca
yāni bhadrāṇi bījāny ṛṣabhā janayanti tais tvaṃ putraṃ vindasva sā prasūr dhenukā bhava
kṛṇomi te prajāpatyam ā garbho yonim etu te vindasva putraṃ nāri yas tubhyaṃ śam asac cham u tasmai tvaṃ bhava
yāsāṃ pitā parjanyo bhūmir mātā babhūva tās tvā putravidyāya devīḥ prāvantv oṣadhīḥ
yas te yonim udiṅgayād ṛṣabho retasā saha sa ta ā siñcatu prajāṃ dīrghāyuṃ śataśāradām
yāṃ tvā vātovarayad ārdranābhā maharṣabhaḥ tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
yāṃ tvā varāho akhanad ekasminn adhi puṣkare tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
yāṃ tvāditir avapad bījavāpam adhi puṣkare tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
yasyāḥ kulāyaṃ salile antar mahaty arṇave tasyās te viśvadhāyaso viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
ut te bhara uttamāyā adhamāyās ta ud bhare un madhyamān madhyame tad viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
agrabhaṃ sam agrabham ubhāvantau sam agrabham divaś ca pṛthivyāś ca viṣadūṣaṇam ud bhare
paidvo 'si pṛtanāyuḥ svāhā somam ahiṃsīḥ somahiṃsito 'si svāhā brāhmaṇam ahiṃsīr brahmahiṃsito 'si svāhā nābhūd ahir bhrūṇam ārad ahir adrim arasāvadhīt viṣasya brahmaṇāmāsīt tato jīvan na mokṣase
uṣṭo 'hiḥ samuṣṭo *'hir nirdhīto arasaḥ kṛtaḥ viṣasya brahmaṇāmāsīt tato jīvan na mokṣase
punar dadāmi te viṣaṃ pūrvapadyam id āritha māṃ dadaśvān manyase mayā daṣṭo na mokṣase
ekaśataṃ bheṣajāni teṣāṃ mātāsy oṣadhe samudram ava gacchasi pṛthivyām adhi niṣṭhitā
tasyāṃ vedādhi bheṣajaṃ daśaśīrṣo daśajihvaḥ yas te prathama ādade śaṃ śvāvanta oṣadhe yam adād vīrayug bhiṣak
punaś cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇaḥ punar āyur na āgamat niṣ ṭvākaraṃ niṣkṛtyā niṣ ṭvā niṣkṛtyākaram
muñcāmi tvā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta atho yamasya paḍvīśād viśvasmād devakilbiṣāt
saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ kapālāni hṛdayasya ca yo viduḥ udyan sūrya ādityo aṅgadyotam anīnaśat
himavataḥ pra sravatha sindhau samaha saṅgamaḥ tā āpaḥ sarvāḥ saṅgatya cakṣuḥ prāṇaṃ ca dhatta naḥ
hastivarcasaṃ prathatāṃ bṛhad yaśo adityā yat tanvaḥ saṃbabhūva tat sarve savitur mahyam etad viśve devāso aditiḥ sajoṣāḥ
mitraś ca varuṇaś ca indro rudraś ca vedhatu devāso viśvadhāyasas tena māñjantu varcasā
yat te varco jātavedo bṛhad bhavaty āhute tena mām adya varcasā agne varcasvinaṃ kṛdhi
yena hastī varcasā saṃbabhūva yena rājā manuṣyeṣv antaḥ yena devā jyotiṣā dyām udāyan tena māgne varcasā saṃ sṛjeha
yāvad varcaḥ sūryasya asurasya ca hastinaḥ tāvan me aśvinā varcaḥ kṛṇutaṃ puṣkarasrajā
yāvac catasraḥ pradiśaś cakṣur yāvat samaśnute tāvat sam aitv indriyaṃ mayi tad dhastivarcasam
saṃśitaṃ ma idaṃ brahma saṃśitaṃ vīryaṃ mama saṃśitaṃ kṣatraṃ me jiṣṇu yeṣām asmi purohitaḥ
sam aham eṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ śyāmi sam ojo vīryaṃ balam vṛścāmi śatrūṇāṃ bāhū saṃ śyāmi svān aham
tekṣṇīyāṃsaḥ parśor agnes tīkṣṇatarā uta indrasya vajrāt tekṣṇiyāṃso yeṣām asmi purohitaḥ
adhas padyantām adhare bhavantu ye na indraṃ maghavānaṃ pṛtanyān kṣaṇāmi brahmaṇāmitrān un nayāmi svān aham
eṣām aham āyudhā saṃ śyāmy eṣāṃ rāṣṭraṃ suvīraṃ vardhayāmi eṣāṃ kṣatram ajaram astu jiṣṇu ugram eṣāṃ cittaṃ viśve vantu devāḥ
abhi preta jayata prasūtāḥ saṃ vaḥ śyāmi nara āyudhāni tīkṣṇeṣavo baladhanvano hata ugrāyudhā abalān ugrabāhavaḥ
ihaiva dhruvāṃ ni minomi śālāṃ kṣeme tiṣṭhāti ghṛtam ukṣamāṇā tāṃ tvā śāle sarvavīrāḥ suvīrā ariṣṭavīrā abhi saṃ carema
ihaiva dhruvā prati tiṣṭha śāle aśvāvatī gomatī sūnṛtāvatī ūrjasvatī ghṛtavatī payasvaty uc chrayasva mahate saubhagāya
dharuṇy asi śāle bṛhacchandāḥ pūtidhānyā ā tvā vatso mīmayad ā kumāra ā dhenavaḥ sāyam ā syandamānāḥ
imāṃ śālāṃ savitā vāyur agnis tvaṣṭā hotā ni minotu prajānan ukṣantūdhnā maruto ghṛtena bhago no rājā ni kṛṣiṃ tanotu
mānasya patnī śaraṇā syonā devī devebhir nimitāsy agre tṛṇaṃ vasānā sumanā asas tvaṃ rayiṃ no dhehi subhage suvīram
ā tvā kumāras taruṇa ā vatso jagatā saha ā tvā pariśrutaḥ kumbha ā dadhnaḥ kalaśy ayat
imam indra vardhaya kṣatriyaṃ ma imaṃ viśām ekavṛṣaṃ kṛṇu tvam nir amitrān akṣṇuhy asya sarvāṃs tān randhayāsmā ahamuttareṣu
ayam astu dhanapatir dhanānām ayaṃ viśāṃ viśpatir astu rājā asminn indra mahi varcāṃsi dhehy avarcasaṃ kṛṇuhi śatrum asya
emaṃ bhaja grāme aśveṣu goṣu niṣṭaṃ bhaja yo 'mitro asya varṣmat kṣatrāṇām ayam astu rājā indra śatrūṃ randhaya sarvam asmai
asmai dyāvāpṛthivī bhūri vāmaṃ saṃ duhātāṃ gharmadughe iva dhenum ayaṃ rājā priya indrasya bhūyāt priyo gavām oṣadhīnām utāpām
yunajmi ta uttarāvantam indraṃ yena jayanti na parājayante yas tvā karad ekavṛṣaṃ janānām uta rājann uttamaṃ mānavānām
uttaras tvam adhare santv anye ye ke ca rājan pratiśatravas te ekavṛṣa indrasakhā jigīvāṃ chatrūyatām abhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi
viṣāṇāsyāṅgirasī devajāḥ praticakṣaṇī divas pṛthivyāḥ saṃbhūtā sahasrākṣīhaidhi naḥ
sahasrākṣī yā tu gṛbhā ati paśyāsy oṣadhe sadānvāghnī rakṣoghnī bhaveha praticakṣaṇī
ye haranty āsuteyaṃ payasphātiṃ cauṣadhe tāṃs tvaṃ sahasracakṣo gṛbhāya kṛtavīrye
ya āturaṃ randhayante 'rṣmantaṃ ca vihṛtam tāṃs tvaṃ sahasracakṣo gṛbhāya kṛtavīrye
yathāśvā caturakṣo rātriṃ naktātipaśyati evā sahasracakṣo tvaṃ prati paśyāsy āyataḥ
gobhir aśvair vasubhir apakrītāsy oṣadhe śyāvasyāśvasya cakṣuṣā prati paśya kimīdinaḥ
saṃ sacadhvaṃ saṃ pibadhvam annaṃ vo madhumat saha vrataṃ vaḥ sarvaṃ sadhryak samānaṃ ceto astu vaḥ
saṃ jānīdhvam indraś cettā vo 'stv ayaṃ vo 'gnir ni haraḥ śamayāti yad vairahatyam uta bhīmam āsīd viśve devā apa tat plāvayantu
śaṃ vaḥ syāstu bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe śam antarikṣam uta vo marutvān śaṃ vaḥ syāstv aditir devaputrā
kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantām āpa oṣadhīḥ kalpantām agnayaḥ sarve 'smai śraiṣṭhāya savratāḥ
saṃ vaḥ sṛjāmi hṛdayaṃ saṃsṛṣṭaṃ mano astu vaḥ saṃsṛṣṭā vas tanvaḥ santu saṃsṛṣṭaḥ prāṇo astu vaḥ
saṃ vaḥ paśūnāṃ hṛdayaṃ sṛjāmi saṃ putrāṇām uta yā duhitaro vaḥ saṃ vo jāyānāṃ manasā manāṃsi saṃ patīnām uta cakṣuḥ sṛjāmi
prācī dig agnir adhipatir asito rakṣitādityā iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
dakṣiṇā dig indro 'dhipatis tiraścirājī rakṣitā vasava iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
pratīcī dig varuṇo 'dhipatiḥ pṛdākū rakṣitā mitra iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
udīcī dik somo 'dhipatiḥ svajo rakṣitā vāta iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
dhruvā dig viṣṇur adhipatiḥ kalmāṣagrīvo rakṣitā vīrudha iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
ūrdhvā dig bṛhaspatir adhipatiś citro rakṣitāśanir iṣavaḥ tebhyo namo 'dhipatibhyo namo rakṣitṛbhyo nama iṣubhyo namo vo 'stu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas taṃ vo jambhe dadhmas tam u prāṇo jahātu
anaḍvān dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utāmūm anaḍvān dādhārorv antarikṣam anaḍvān dādhāra pradiśaḥ ṣaḍ urvīr anaḍvān idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam ā viveśa
anaḍvān duhe sukṛtasya loka ainaṃ pyāyeta pavamānaḥ purastāt parjanyo dhārā maruta ūdho asya yajñaḥ payo dakṣiṇā doho asya
anaḍvān indraḥ sa paśubhyo vi caṣṭe trayāṃ chakropa mimīte adhvanaḥ sa bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad bhuvanaṃ duhānaḥ sarvā devānāṃ bibhrac carati vratāni
yasya neśe yajñapatir na yajño nāsya dāteśe na pratigrahītā yo viśvabhṛd viśvakarmā gharmaṃ no brūta yatamaś catuṣpāt
indra eṣa manuṣyeṣv antar gharmas taptaś carati śośucānaḥ suprajā asat sa udāre na sarṣad yo nāśnīyād anaḍuho vijānan
yena devāḥ svar āruruhur hitvā śarīram amṛtasya dhāma tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ gharmasya vratena yaśasā tapasyayā
dvādaśaitā rātrīr vratyā āhuḥ prajāpateḥ tatrāpi brahmaṇo vrataṃ tatrāpy anaḍuho balam
yās ta āhuḥ prajāpater vratyā rātrīr dvādaśa tatrāpi brahma yo veda tad vā anaḍuho balam
duhe vā anaḍvān sāyaṃ duhe prātar duhe divā dohā ye asya saṃyanti tān vidmānupadasvataḥ
yo vedānaḍuho dohān saptān upadasvataḥ prajāṃ ca lokaṃ cāpnoti tathā sapta rṣayo viduḥ
madhyam etad anaḍuho yatraiṣa vaha āhitaḥ etāvad asya prācīnaṃ yāvān pratyaṅ samāhitaḥ
padbhiḥ sedim avakrāmann irāṃ jaṅghābhir utkhidan śrameṇānaḍvān kīlālaṃ kīnāśaś cābhi gacchataḥ
indra eṣa manuṣyeṣv anaḍvān ity ucyate śaphāso asya mā riṣan sarvā yāś cāsya kuṣṭhikāḥ
indro balenāsi parameṣṭhī vratena yena gaus tena vaiśvadevaḥ yo asmān dveṣṭi yaṃ vayaṃ dviṣmas tasya prāṇān saṃ bṛhat tasya prāṇān vi vṛha
gṛhān aimi manasā modamāna ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasumaniḥ sumedhāḥ aghoreṇa cakṣuṣā mitriyeṇa gṛhāṇāṃ paśyan paya ut tarāmi
ime gṛhā mayobhuva ūrjasvantaḥ payasvantaḥ pūrṇā vāmasya tiṣṭhantas te no jānantu jānataḥ
sūnṛtāvantaḥ subhagā irāvanto hasāmudāḥ akṣudhyā atṛṣyāso gṛhā māsmad bibhītana
yeṣām adhyeti pravasan yeṣu saumanaso bahuḥ gṛhān upa hvayāmahe te no jānantv āyataḥ
upahūtā iva gāva upahūtā ajāvayaḥ atho annasya kīlāla upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ
upahūtā bhūridhanāḥ sakhāyaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ ariṣṭāḥ sarvapūruṣā gṛhā naḥ santu sarvadā
hantāyam astv apratighātyaḥ sāsahvām̐ indraḥ pṛtanā abhiṣṭhiḥ prajāpatir adadhād ojo asmai bṛhad dhavir haviṣā vardhanena
prajāpate haviṣā vardhanena hantāram indram akṛṇor aghātyam tasmai viśo devakṛtā namanta sa hi hantā sa hi havyo babhūva
prajāpate abhi no neṣa vasya urvīṃ gavyūtim abhimātiṣāhaḥ vardhayann indraṃ bṛhate raṇāya devaṃ devena haviṣā vardhanena
yathā viśvāḥ pṛtanāḥ saṃjayāsi yathā śatrūn sahamānaḥ sahāsai yathāsaḥ samrāṭ susamrāḍ evā tvendro 'prativadhaṃ kṛṇotu
ayaṃ vīro 'prati hantu śatrūn viśve devā apa sadas karātha māsya prajāṃ rīriṣan mota vīrān imam indro 'prativadhaṃ kṛṇotu
jahi śatrūn prati randhayasva agniṣ ṭe gopā adhipā vasiṣṭhaḥ śarma te rājā varuṇo ni yacchād evā tvendro 'prativadhaṃ kṛṇotu
saṃ spṛśethāṃ tanūbhyāṃ saṃ mukhābhyāṃ sam ātmanā saṃ vāṃ brahmaṇaspatiḥ somaḥ saṃ sparśayāti vām
abhy asya nāma vācā dadhāmi nāha mokṣyate mamed ahainaṃ kāme labhai kṛṣṇam ivākhare
yaḥ premā preṇyām āsīd dattaḥ somena babhruṇā tasmād adhi śrutaṃ mama mayy asya mana āhitam
yaṃ pumāṃsaṃ kāmayase yasmin vā bhagam icchase hṛcchokam asminn ā dadhmo yathā śuṣyāti tvām anu
yathāsya hṛdayaṃ śuṣyād apicchinneva śaṃguṇī cakṣur ākāśyaṃ bhīmaṃ māṃpaśyam abhirorudam
priyaṃkaraṇam uttamaṃ madhughena tad ābhṛtam tvaṃ hāsi varcasyo 'tho hāsi sumaṅgalaḥ atho sarvāsāṃ vīrudhāṃ priyaṅkaraṇam ucyase
pratīcī somam asy oṣadhe pratīcy uta sūryam pratīcī viśvān devāṃs tathā tvācchā vadāmasi
imāṃ khanāmy oṣadhiṃ nitatnīm anutantamām āyataḥ pratinandanīṃ parāyato nivartanīm
amuṣyāhaṃ parāyata āyato mano agrabham agrabhaṃ hastyaṃ mano 'tho hṛdayyaṃ manaḥ
mayi te mana āhitaṃ mayi cittaṃ mayi vratam mamed api kratāv aso mama citte sacāvahai
ahaṃ vadāni mā tvaṃ sabhāyāṃ gha tvaṃ vada mamed asas tvaṃ kevalo nānyāsāṃ kīrtayāś cana
yadi vāsi tiro janaṃ yadi vā nadyas tiraḥ iyaṃ tvā mahyam oṣadhir baddhveva ny ānayāt
yathā kalām ity ekā saṃ rājāno 'guḥ sam ṛṇāny aguḥ saṃ kuṣṭhā aguḥ saṃ kulā aguḥ sam asmāsu suṣvapnyaṃ nir dviṣate duṣvapnyaṃ suvāmaḥ
devānāṃ patnīnāṃ garbha yamasya karaṇaḥ yo bhadraḥ svapnaḥ sa mama yaḥ pāpas taṃ dviṣate pra hiṇmaḥ
tṛṣṇāmā nāmāsi kṛṣṇaśakuner mukhaṃ nirṛter mukham taṃ tvā svapna tathā vidma
sa tvaṃ svapnāśva ivākāyam aśva iva nīnāham anāsmākaṃ devapīyuṃ piyāruṃ vapsaḥ
yad asmāsu duṣvapnyaṃ yad goṣu yac ca no gṛhe anāsmākas tad devapīyuḥ piyāruṃ niṣkam iva prati muñcatām
navāratnīn avamāya asmākaṃ tanvas pari duṣvapnyaṃ sarvaṃ durbhūtaṃ dviṣate nir diśāmasi
devā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaro 'po dattodadhiṃ bhinta divas pṛthivyā uror antarikṣād asmai kṣatrāyānena brahmaṇābhyaḥ prajābhya ābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā
devā agna indra sūrya apaḥ
devāḥ sayujo mitra varuṇāryamann apaḥ
devāḥ pitaro 'vamā āyavaḥ krāvya apaḥ
devāpsuṣado 'pāṃ napāt tanūnapān narāśaṃsa apo dattodadhiṃ bhinta
deva bṛhaspate 'po dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi
deva prajāpate 'po dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi
deva parameṣṭhinn apo dhehy udadhiṃ bhindhi divas pṛthivyā uror antarikṣād asmai kṣatrāyānena brahmaṇābhyaḥ prajābhya ābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā
prajāpater jāyamānāḥ prajā jātāś ca yā imāḥ tā asmai prati vedaya cikitvām̐ anu manyatām
yeṣām īśe paśupatiḥ paśūnāṃ catuṣpadām uta vā ye dvipādaḥ niṣkrītās te yajñiyā yanti lokaṃ rāyaspoṣāya yajamānaṃ sacantām
pramuñcanto bhuvanasya gopā gātuṃ devā yajamānāya dhatta upākṛtaṃ śaśamānaṃ yad asthāt priyaṃ devānām apy etu pāthaḥ
ye badhyamānam anu dīdhyānā anvaikṣanta manasā cakṣuṣā ca agniṣ ṭān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ
yeṣāṃ prāṇā anvabadhnanta badvaṃ gavāṃ paśūnām uta pūruṣāṇām indras tān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ
ya āraṇyāḥ paśavo viśvarūpā ye viśvarūpā utaikarūpāḥ vāyuṣ ṭān agre pra mumukta devaḥ prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃvidānaḥ
prajānantaḥ prati gṛhṇantu devāḥ prāṇam aṅgebhyas paryācarantam dyāṃ gaccha prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ svargaṃ yāhi pathibhiḥ śivebhiḥ
samās tvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsara ṛṣayo yāni satyā saṃ dyumnena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaś catasraḥ
saṃ cedhyasvāgne pra ca bodhayainam uc ca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya mā te riṣann upasattāro atra brāhmaṇās te yaśasaḥ santu mānye
tvām agne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne prataraṇo na edhi sapatnahāgne abhimātijid bhava sve kṣaye dīdihy aprayucchan
ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā dabhan pūrvacittā nikāriṇaḥ kṣatram agne suyamam astu tubhyam upasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ
kṣatreṇāgne svena saṃ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradheyaṃ yatasva sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭheyam asyā rājñām agne vihavyo dīdihīha
ati niho 'ti nirṛtīr aty arātīr ati dviṣaḥ viśvā hy agne duritā tara tvam athāsmabhyaṃ sahavīraṃ rayiṃ dāḥ
anādhṛṣyo jātavedā aniṣṭṛto virāḍ agne kṣatrabhir dīdihīha vyamīvāḥ pramuñcan mānuṣebhyaḥ śivebhir adya pari pāhi no gayaiḥ
ayaṃ te yonir ṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ taṃ jānann agna ā roha athā no vardhayā rayim
pradātāraṃ havāmahe agnim ugram ūtaye śucir yo vṛtrahantamaḥ
agne acchā vadeha naḥ pratyaṅ naḥ sumanā bhava pra ṇo yaccha viśāṃ pate dhanadā asi nas tvam
pra ṇo yacchatv aryamā pra bhagaḥ pra bṛhaspatiḥ pra pūṣā prota sūnṛtā rayiṃ devī dadhātu naḥ
aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatim indraṃ dānāya codaya vātaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinam
somaṃ rājānam avase 'gniṃ gīrbhir havāmahe ādityaṃ viṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
indravāyū bṛhaspatiḥ suhaveha havāmahe yathā naḥ sarvam ij jagat saṅgatyāṃ sumanā asat
tvaṃ no agne agnibhir brahma yajñaṃ ca vardhaya tvaṃ no deva dātave rayiṃ dānāya codaya
vājasyedaṃ prasave saṃbabhūva memā ca viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ utāditsantaṃ dāpayati prajānan rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchāt
duhrāṃ me pañca pradiśo duhrām urvīr yathābalam prāpeyaṃ sarvām ākūtiṃ manasā hṛdayena ca
gosaniṃ vācam udeyaṃ varcasā mābhy ūrṇuhi ā rundhāṃ sarvato vāyus tvaṣṭā poṣāya dhriyatām
yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi maghavañ chagdhi tava tvaṃ na ūtibhir vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi
indraṃ vayam anūrādhaṃ havāmahe 'nu rādhyāsma dvipadā catuṣpadā mā naḥ senā araruṣīr upa gur viṣūcīr indra druho vi nāśaya
indras trātota vṛtrahā paraspā no vareṇyaḥ sa rakṣitā caramataḥ sa madhyataḥ sa paścāt sa purastān no astu
uruṃ no lokam anu neṣi vidvān svaryaj jyotir abhayaṃ svasti ugrā ta indra sthavirasya bāhū upa kṣiyema śaraṇā bṛhantā
abhayaṃ naḥ karaty antarikṣam abhayaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī ubhe abhayaṃ paścād abhayaṃ purastād uttarād adharād abhayaṃ no astu
abhayaṃ mitrād abhayam amitrād abhayaṃ jñātād abhayaṃ puro naḥ abhayaṃ naktam abhayaṃ divā naḥ sarvā āśā mama mitraṃ bhavantu
jaya prehi māpa krāmaḥ śatrūṇāṃ veda ā khida indraḥ sapatnahā bhīmaḥ sañjayas te sam ānṛdhat
tvaṃ jayāsi na parā jayāsā arbheṣv ājau maghavan mahatsu ca ugraṃ cit tvām avase saṃ śiśīmahe sa tvaṃ na indra havaneṣu mṛḍa
gojitā bāhū asamakratū yudhi karmankarmañ chatamūtī svajaṅkarā akalpa indro 'pratimānam ojaḥ sa tvaṃ na indra havaneṣu mṛḍa
vedāham aindraṃ priyam asya śevadhiṃ yad asya nāma guhyaṃ samīke sa ij jayāti maghavā mamāsaty asmākaṃ yudhmo vihave havaṃ gamat
vayaṃ jayema tvāyujā bhṛto asmākam aṃśam ud avā bharebhare asmabhyam indra varivaḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi pra śatrūṇāṃ maghavan vṛṣṇiyā ruja
tvāṃ deveṣu prathamaṃ havāmahe tvaṃ babhūvitha pṛtanāsu sāsahiḥ semaṃ naḥ kārum upamanyum udbhidam indra karāsi prasave rathaṃ puraḥ
smara smaro 'si devair datto 'si smara amuṣya mana ā smara yathāhaṃ kāmaye tathā
śocayāsya hṛdayaṃ kāma gaccha aṅgajvaro dahatu śocatu tmanā saṅkalpā asya samarantādhībhir iyam evāsya digamahanyanyāḥ
nirānandāḥ pramucchado manomuho nayuvo naṣṭakṛtvā araṇyavaḥ āveśinīḥ pradrupo ropayiṣṇur eta āstādhyaḥ pra hiṇomi brahmaṇā
hṛtkartanī ṛtudā grāmānnāśanīḥ svapnacchida ughnanīghnā manomuhaḥ āveśinīḥ pradrupo ropayiṣṇur eta āstādhyaḥ pra hiṇomi brahmaṇā
indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇā te adya ubhe ca dyāvāpṛthivī mātariśvā aśvinā devaḥ savitā bhagaś ca manas ta u ghnantu na ramāsā atra
trayastriṃśat tvā uta ghnantu devā ādhyaś cittam upa te bharantām bharadvājasya matayas ta īśatāṃ chinneva naur bandhanāt pra plavasva
etāḥ patanty ādhyo vārṣikīr iva vidyutaḥ tāsāṃ pratigraho bhava sāyaṃ goṣṭhe gavām iva
ni śīrṣato ni pātita ādhyo veśayāmi te tās tvā samuttudantīr bodhayantīr upāsatām
etās ta ādhyaḥ pra hiṇomi brahmaṇā tṛprā aśrīpurogavāḥ tās tvā tṛṇam iva śoṣayān atho tvā rodayān bahu
ajo hy agner ajaniṣṭa śokāt so 'paśyaj janitāram agre tena devā devatām agra āyan tena rohān arohann upa medhīyāṃsaḥ
kramadhvam agnibhir nākam ukhyāṃ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ divas pṛṣṭhaṃ svar gatvā miśrā devebhir ādhvam
agne prehi prathamo devayatāṃ cakṣur devānām uta martyānām iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ svar yantu yajamānāḥ svasti
svar yanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṃ rohantu rādhasaḥ yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṃ suvidvāṃso vi tenire
odanam anajmi śavasā ghṛtena divyaṃ samudraṃ payasaṃ bṛhantam tena geṣma sukṛtasya lokaṃ saroruhāṇā adhi nākam uttamam
yau te pakṣāv ajarau patatriṇau yābhyāṃ rakṣāṃsy apahaṃsy odana tābhyāṃ patyāsma sukṛtasya lokaṃ yatra rṣayaḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ
yatas tiṣṭho divas pṛṣṭhe vyomann adhy odana anvāyan satyadharmāṇo brāhmaṇā rādhasā saha
pṛṣṭhāt pṛthivyā aham antarikṣam āruham antarikṣād divam āruham divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt svar jyotir agām aham
ajo 'sy aja svargo 'si tvayā lokam aṅgirasaḥ pra jānan taṃ lokam anu pra jñeṣma
yenā sahasraṃ vahasi yena vā sarvavedasam tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no vaha svar deveṣu gantave
ajaṃ ca pacata pañca caudanān ajaṃ pañcaudanaṃ paktvā devā lokān sam ānaśuḥ
yā te prajāpihitā purābhūd dhruveṇāśvināpa taṃ bharāmi agniṣ ṭe tāmādyamaḥ punar dād vaiśvānaraḥ paramasmād vyomnaḥ
tvaṃ patiḥ śivo 'gne dvitīyo *'syai prajāṃ jaradaṣṭiṃ sṛjasva muñcaināṃ grāhyā nirṛtir yad bandha agne prajāṃ prajākāmāyai dhehi
tvām agne vṛṣabhaṃ vāśiteyam ācyā jānu putrakāmā saparyati tām ā roha sumanasyamānaḥ prajāpateḥ prajayā saṃ sṛjainām
tubhyaṃ nārī putrakāmeyam agne śuddhaṃ pūtaṃ ghṛtam ā juhoti tām adhi skanda vīrayasva retodhā ugraḥ prajayā saṃ sṛjainam
parvatād divo yoner gātrādgātrāt samāśṛtam reto devasyadevasya tsarau parṇam ivādhām
indrasya jātasya pra papāta nābhis tām eko devaḥ prati jagrāha kāmī tvayā vayaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ somapāḥ sūpayāma uta yā na sūte
tejanāt tyajanaṃ jātaṃ tejanaṃ jāyate śarāt na yeṣati na śocati yas tvā bibharti tejana
parutnam asi tejana parutnaṃ te prabhañjanam parutno astu sa kāmo yenāmūṃ kāmayāmahe
yāvad oṣaḥ śaro astvo janebhyaḥ kṛṇavad bhayam tāvad oṣas tvaṃ tejana tyajanaṃ bhavatād iha
tyajanaṃ ma āpo dadhan tyajanaṃ maruto dadhan tyajanaṃ me viśve devās tyajanaṃ pitaro dadhan
tenāham anyeṣāṃ striyo atyākṣaṃ vidviṣaḥ purā purā dviṣo atyākṣaṃ purā madhyandinād uta purā sāyatvād atyākṣaṃ tejane hi mahad balam
asthād dyaur asthāt pṛthivy asthād viśvam idaṃ jagat asthād avahṛdevāt tiṣṭhāt kāmo ayaṃ tava
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ sam avartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patir eka āsīt sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utāmuṃ tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
ya ojodā baladā yaś ca viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyus tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato vidhartā patir viśvasya jagato babhūva ya īśe 'sya dvipado yaś catuṣpadas tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yena dyaur ugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ yo antarikṣaṃ vimame varīyas tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī tastabhāna adhārayad avasā rejamāne yasminn adhi vitata eti sūryas tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
yasya viśve himavanto mahitvā samudraṃ yasya rasayā sahāhuḥ diśo yasya pradiśaḥ pañca devīs tasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema
āpo ha yasya viśvam āyur dadhānā garbhaṃ janayanta mātaraḥ tatra devānām adhi deva āsta ekasthūṇe vimite dṛḍha ugre
āpo garbhaṃ janayantīr vatsam agre sam airayan tasyota jāyamānasya ulba āsīd dhiraṇyayaḥ
hiraṇya ulba āsīd yo 'gre vatso ajāyata taṃ yonyor vidravantyoḥ pary apaśyad ditir mahī

madhunā mā saṃ sṛjāmi māsareṇa surām iva vāṅ ma iyaṃ madhunā saṃsṛṣṭā akṣyau me madhusaṃdṛśī
madhu dyaur madhu pṛthivī madhv indro madhu sūryaḥ striyo yā jajñire madhu tābhyo 'haṃ madhumattarā
madhumatīr oṣadhaya āpo madhumatīr uta gāvo yā jajñire madhu tābhyo 'haṃ madhumattarā
madhor jāto madhugho vīrudhāṃ balavattamaḥ tenāhaṃ sarvasmai puṃse kṛṇve nikaraṇaṃ hṛdi
yathāśvo bandhaneṣṭho vaḍavām abhidhāvati evā tvam ugra oṣadhe 'muṃ kanikradatam ā naya
aṅgo nu mod iva śvaso aṅgo nu mod iva stanaḥ anyā vivitsamāno anyāḥ parājighāṃsan mām anu pra te manaś chāyā yantam ivānv ayat
khananti tvā taimātāṃ dāsā arasabāhavaḥ dāsy asi prakrīr asy utkhātam arasaṃ viṣam
adanti tvā kakkaṭāsaḥ kuruṅgā adhi sānuṣu pāpī jagdhaprasūr asy abhrikhāte na rūrupaḥ
ava jyām iva dhanvanaḥ śuṣmaṃ tirāmi te viṣa pra ropīr asya pātaya sūryaḥ pūrvā ivoṣasaḥ
sindhuḥ paścāt parihitaḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ tato yad antarā vanaṃ tat sarvaṃ viṣadūṣaṇam
madhu tvā madhukṛt kṛṇotu pituṃ tvā pitukṛt kṛṇotu uto niṣadya pātave atho ūrdhvāya tiṣṭhate
jaghāsa tvā lomakarṇas tan ny āsa paruṣṇiyām tad bhaimīś cakrire srajaḥ sarvaṃ mahiṣado viṣam
urvyā urukṣitas turāyā āturasya ca bhūmyā hi jagrabha nāma viṣaṃ vārayatām iti viṣaṃ dūṣayatād iti
ahaṃ vā indramātaram indraujām indrabhrātaram indrādhivaktrāṃ vīrudham āhārṣaṃ viṣadūṣaṇīm
yat kiṃ ca padvac chaphavad yat kāṇḍi yac ca puṣpavat yad ejati prajāpatiḥ sarvaṃ tad viṣadūṣaṇam
sindhuḥ paścād dharuṇaḥ sūryasyodayanaṃ puraḥ tato yad antarā viṣaṃ tad vācā dūṣayāmasi
yāvat sūryo vitapati yāvac cābhi vipaśyati tāvad viṣasya dūṣaṇaṃ vaco nir mantrayāmahe
jihvā me madhusaṃsrāvā jihvā me madhuvādinī jihve varcasvatī bhava māyaṃ me puruṣo riṣat
hā hai kalyāṇi subhage pṛśniparṇy anāture imaṃ me adya pūruṣaṃ dīrghāyutvāyon naya
yābhyo varṣanti vṛṣṭayo yābhir jīvanty aghnyāḥ tā me viṣasya dūṣaṇīḥ savitā vy akāśayat
prajāpatiṣ ṭvā badhnāt prathamam astṛtaṃ vīryāya kam taṃ te badhnāmy āyuṣe varcasa ojase ca balāya ca astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
ūrdhvas tiṣṭha rakṣann apramādam astṛtemaṃ mā tvā dabhan paṇayo yātudhānāḥ indra iva dasyūn ava dhūnuṣva pṛtanyataḥ sarvāñ chatrūn vi ṣahasva astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
śataṃ cana praharanto 'bhighnanto na tastrire tasminn indraḥ pary adatta cakṣuḥ prāṇam atho balam astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
indrasya tvā varmaṇā pari dhāpayāmo yo devānām adhirājo babhūva puras tvā devāḥ pra ṇayantu sarve 'stṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
asmin maṇāv ekaśataṃ vīryāṇi sahasraṃ prāṇā asminn astṛte vyāghraḥ śatrūn adhi tiṣṭha sarvān yas tvā pṛtanyād adharaḥ so 'stv astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
ghṛtād ullupto madhumān payasvān sahasraprāṇaḥ śatayonir vayodhāḥ śambhūś ca mayobhūś ca ūrjasvāṃś ca payasvāṃś ca astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
yathā tvam uttaro aso asapatnaḥ sapatnahā sajātānām aso vaśī tathā tvā savitā karad astṛtas tvābhi rakṣatu
apaś ca rapaś ca ūṣmā ca bāṣpaś ca śokaś cābhiśokaś ca tṛtīyekaś ca pareparaś ca takmāna ito naśyata
veda vai te takman nāma agniṣ ṭvaṃ nāmāsi taṃ tveto vi nayāmaḥ śani takmā
vṛtrasya haro 'si nabhaso napāt dyauś cāsmat pṛthivī ca takmānaṃ nāśayatām itaḥ
pañcapsinir nāma te mātā sa u ekapsinir ucyase tasyāhaṃ veda te nāma sa takman nir ato drava
audumbaraś ca nāmāsi priyātithiś ca taṃ tveto nāśayāmasi brahmaṇā vīryāvatā
yo 'si jalpaṃś ca lapaṃś ca āvāṃ ca tapaṃś ca tṛtīyekaś ca mauñjigalaś ca te takmāna ito naśyata
vikilīda vilohita vikāśakraṃdarajjana giriṃ gaccha dhūmaketo hṛṣe namāṃsi santu te
bṛhat tvam agne rakṣo adhamaṃ jahi madhyamaṃ ny uttamaṃ śṛṇīhi śaṃ no agnir jyotiranīko astu śaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā
māteva pitevābhi rakṣatainaṃ muñcatainaṃ pary aṃhasaḥ
vātāj jāto antarikṣād vidyuto jyotiṣas pari sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkhaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ
hiraṇyānām eko 'si somād adhi jajñiṣe rathe 'si dārśata iṣudhau rocanas tvam
yo agrato rocanāvān samudrād adhi jajñiṣe śaṅkhena hatvā rakṣāṃsy atriṇo vi ṣahāmahe
ye atriṇo yātudhānā rakṣaso ye kimīdinaḥ sarvāñ chaṅkha tvayā vayaṃ viṣūco vi ṣahāmahe
śaṅkhenāmīvām amatiṃ śaṅkhenota sadānvāḥ śaṅkho no viśvabheṣajaḥ kṛśanaḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ
divi jātaḥ samudrataḥ sindhutas pary ābhṛtaḥ sa no hiraṇyajāḥ śaṅkha āyuṣprataraṇo maṇiḥ
devānām asthi kṛśanaṃ babhūva tad ātmanvac caraty apsv antaḥ taṃ te badhnāmy āyuṣe varcasa ojase ca balāya ca kārśanas tvābhi rakṣatu
kanyā vār avāyatī somam api srutāvidat astaṃ bharanty abravīd indrāya sunomi tvā śakrāya sunomi tvā
asau ya eṣi vīrako gṛhaṃgṛhaṃ vicākaśat imaṃ jambhasutaṃ piba dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇam apūpavantam ukthinam
kuvic chakat kuvit karat kuvin no vasyasas karat kuvit patidviṣo yatīr indreṇa saṃ gamāmahai
ā cana tvā cikitsāmo 'dhi cana tvā nemasi śanair iva śanakair iva indrāyendo pari srava
imāni trīṇi viṣṭapā tānīndra vi rohaya śiras tatasyorvarām ād idaṃ ma upodare
asau ca yā na urvarā ād imāṃ tanvaṃ mama atho tatasya yac chiraḥ sarvā tā romaśā kṛdhi
khe rathasya khe 'nasaḥ khe yugasya śatakrato apālām indra triṣ pūtvy akṛṇoḥ sūryatvacam
divas pṛṣṭhe madhupṛcaḥ suparṇāḥ pañcāśat te bhuvanasya gopāḥ ānujāvaram anu rakṣanta ugrā yeṣām indraṃ vīryāyairayanta
purohitaḥ parameṣṭhī svarājyāya abhīvardham asmā akṛṇod bṛhaspatiḥ tena sapatnān adharān kṛṇuṣva kṣeme paśūn bahulān vardhayitvā jaitrāyod yātu rathavāhanaṃ te
gobhājam aṃśaṃ tava ye samānāḥ sarve samagrā dadhṛg ābharanta abhi vardhasva bhrātṛvyān abhi ye tvā pṛtanyataḥ
ni piṇḍhi sarvān dhūrvato 'bhīvardho yathāsasi abhīvardham abhībhavam abhīṣeṇaṃ mahāgaṇam viśas tvā sarvā ā yantv āpo divyāḥ payasvatīḥ
abhi vardhasva prajayā vāvṛdhāno abhy anīkaiḥ paśubhir bhavāsi brahmarājanyair viśyair vāvṛdhānaḥ śūdrair atīhi sabhayā pṛtanyataḥ
vardhasva kṣetraiḥ prathasva prajayā vardhasva vīraiḥ paśubhir bahur bhava śriyā śulkair yatamas tvā pṛtanyād āptas tubhyaṃ sa balihṛtyāya tiṣṭhatu
indraṃ mitraṃ varuṇam agnim ūtaye mārutaṃ śardho aditiṃ havāmahe rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana
ta ādityā ā gatā sarvatātaye bhūta devā vṛtratūryeṣu śaṃbhuvaḥ
avantu naḥ pitaraḥ supravācanā uta devī devaputre ṛtāvṛdhā
narāśaṃsaṃ vājinaṃ vājayantaṃ kṣayadvīraṃ pūṣaṇaṃ sumnair īmahe
bṛhaspate sadam in naḥ sugaṃ kṛdhi śaṃ yor yat te manurhitaṃ tad īmahe
indraṃ kutso vṛtrahaṇaṃ śacīpatiṃ kāṭe nibāḍha ṛṣir ahvad ūtaye rathaṃ na durgād vasavaḥ sudānavo viśvasmān no aṃhaso niṣ pipartana
devair no devy aditir ni pātu devas trātā trāyatām aprayucchan tan no mitro varuṇo māmahantām aditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
apa naḥ śośucad agham agne śuśugdhy ā rayim
apa naḥ śośucad agham sukṣetriyā sugātuyā vasūyā ca yajāmahe
apa naḥ śośucad agham pra yad bhandiṣṭha eṣāṃ prāsmākāsaś ca sūrayaḥ
apa naḥ śośucad agham pra yat te agne sūrayo jāyemahi pra te vayam
apa naḥ śośucad agham pra yad agneḥ sahasvato viśvato yanti bhānavaḥ
apa naḥ śośucad agham tvaṃ hi viśvatomukha viśvataḥ paribhūr asi
apa naḥ śośucad agham dviṣo no viśvatomukha ati nāveva pāraya
devāḥ śaraṇakṛtaḥ śaraṇā me bhavata prācyā diśo 'gninā rājñādhyakṣeṇa yaśā bhūyāsaṃ yaśasaṃ mā kṛṇuta cārum annādaṃ parā dviṣantaṃ śṛṇīta
bhavata dakṣiṇāyā diśa indreṇa rājñā
bhavata pratīcyā diśo varuṇena rājñā
bhavata udīcyā diśaḥ somena rājñā
bhavata dhruvāyā diśo viṣṇuṇā rājñā
bhavata ūrdhvāyā diśo bṛhaspatinā rājñā
bhavata uttamāyā diśaḥ prajāpatinā rājñā
bhavata paramāyā diśaḥ parameṣṭhinā rājñā
devāḥ śaraṇakṛtaḥ śaraṇā me bhavata sarvābhyo digbhya īśānena rājñādhyakṣeṇa yaśā bhūyāsaṃ yaśasaṃ mā kṛṇuta cārum annādaṃ parā dviṣantaṃ śṛṇīta
prātar agniṃ prātar indraṃ havāmahe prātar mitrāvaruṇā prātar aśvinā prātar bhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somam uta rudraṃ huvema
prātarjitaṃ bhagam ugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putram aditer yo vidhartā ādhraś cid yaṃ manyamānas turaś cid rājā cid yaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣīty āha
bhaga praṇetar bhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyam ud avā dadan naḥ bhaga pra ṇo janaya gobhir aśvair bhaga pra nṛbhir nṛvantaḥ syāma
utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma uta prapitva uta madhye ahnām utodite maghavan sūrye vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma
bhaga eva bhagavām̐ astu devās tena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ij johavīti sa no bhaga puraetā bhaveha
sam adhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no ratham ivāśvā vājina ā vahantu
aśvāvatīr gomatīr na uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadam ucchantu bhadrāḥ ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ
yas te manyo 'vidhad vajra sāyaka saha ojaḥ puṣyati viśvam ānuṣak sāhyāma dāsam āryaṃ tvayā yujā vayaṃ sahaskṛtena sahasā sahīyasā
manyur indro manyur evāsa devo manyur hotā varuṇo jātavedāḥ manyur viśa īḍate mānuṣīr yāḥ pāhi no manyo tapasā sajoṣāḥ
abhīhi manyo tavasas tavīyān tapasā yujā vi jahi śatrūn amitrahā vṛtrahā dasyuhā ca viśvā vasūny ā bharā tvaṃ naḥ
tvaṃ hi manyo abhibhūtyojāḥ svayambhūr bhāmo abhimātiṣāhaḥ viśvacarṣaṇiḥ sahuriḥ sahīyām̐ asmāsv ojaḥ pṛtanāsu dhehi
abhāgaḥ sann apa pareto asmi tava kratvā taviṣasya pracetaḥ taṃ tvā manyo akratur jihīḍāhaṃ svā tanūr baladāvā na ehi
ayaṃ te asmy upa na ehy arvāṅ pratīcīnaḥ sahure viśvadāvan manyo vajrinn upa na ā vavṛtsva hanāva dasyūṃr uta bodhy āpe
abhi prehi dakṣiṇato bhavā no adhā vṛtrāṇi jaṅghanāva bhūri juhomi te dharuṇo madhvo agram ubhā upāṃśu prathamā pibeva
agner manve prathamasya pracetasaḥ pāñcajanyasya bahudhā yam indhate viśoviśaḥ praviśivāṃsam īmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
sujātaṃ jātavedasam agniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vibhum havyavāhaṃ havāmahe sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yathā havyaṃ vahasi jātavedo yathā yajñaṃ kalpayasi prajānan evā devebhyaḥ sumatim ihā vaha sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yāmanyāmann upayuktaṃ vahiṣṭhaṃ karmankarmann ābhagam agnim īḍe rakṣohaṇaṃ yajñavṛdhaṃ ghṛtāhutaṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yena rṣayo valam adyotayan yujā yenāsurāṇām ayuvanta māyāḥ yenāgninā paṇīn indro jigāya sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yena devā amṛtam anvavindan yenauṣadhīr madhumatīr akṛṇvan yenedaṃ svar ābharan sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasyedaṃ pradiśi yad virocate yaj jātaṃ janitavyaṃ ca kevalam staumy agniṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
vāyoḥ savitur vidathāni manmahe yāv ātmanvad vidatho yau ca rakṣathaḥ yau viśvasya paribhū babhūvathus tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayoḥ saṃkhyātā varimāṇi pārthivā yābhyāṃ rajo gupitam antarikṣam yayoḥ prayāṃ nānu kaś canānaśe tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
tava vrate ni viśante janāsas tvayy udite prerate citrabhāno yuvaṃ vāyo savitā ca bhuvanāni rakṣathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
pra sumatiṃ savitar vāya ūtaye mahasvantaṃ matsaraṃ mādayethām arvāg vāmasya pravatā ni yacchathas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
rayiṃ me poṣaṃ savitota vāyus tanū dakṣam ā suvatāṃ suśevam ayakṣmatāṃ maho asmāsu dhattaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
apeto vāyo savitā ca duṣkṛtam apa yakṣmaṃ śimidāṃ sedhataṃ paraḥ saṃ hy ūrjā sṛjathaḥ saṃ balena tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
upa śreṣṭhā na āśiṣo devayor dhāmann asthiran staumi devaṃ savitāraṃ ca vāyuṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
marutāṃ manve adhi me bruvantu premaṃ vājaṃ vājasātā avantu āśūn iva suyamān ahva ūtaye te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
utsam akṣitaṃ vyacanti ye sadā ye vā siñcanti rasam oṣadhīṣu puro dadhe marutaḥ pṛśnimātṝṃs te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
payo dhenūnāṃ rasam oṣadhīnāṃ javam arvatāṃ kavayo ya invatha śagmā bhavantu marutaḥ syonās te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
apaḥ samudrād divam ud vahanti divas pṛthivīm abhi ye sṛjanti ye +'dbhir īśānā marutaś caranti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
ye kīlālais tarpayanti ye ghṛtena ye vā vayo medasā saṃsṛjanti ya īśānā maruto varṣayanti te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
yadīd idaṃ maruto mārutena yadi devā daivyenedṛg āra yūyam īśidhve vasavas tasya niṣkṛtes te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
tigmam anīkaṃ viditaṃ sahasvan mārutaṃ śardhaḥ pṛtanāsūgram staumi maruto nāthito johavīmi te no muñcantv aṃhasaḥ
manve vāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī subhojasau ye aprathethām amitā yojanāni pratiṣṭhe hy abhavataṃ vasūnāṃ te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
pratiṣṭhe hi babhūvathur vasūnāṃ pravṛddhe devī subhage urūcī dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
ye srotyā bibhṛtho ye manuṣyān ye amṛtaṃ bibhṛtho ye havīṃṣi dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
ye usriyā bibhṛtho ye vanaspatīn yayor vāṃ viśvā bhuvanāny antaḥ dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
ye kīlālais tarpayatho ye ghṛtena yābhyāṃ na rte kiṃ cana śaknuvanti dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
asantāpe sutapasā huve vām urvī gabhīre kavibhir namasye dyāvāpṛthivī bhavataṃ me syone te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yan medam abhiśocati yena vā yena vā kṛtaṃ pauruṣeyaṃ na daivyam staumi dyāvāpṛthivī nāthito johavīmi te no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
bhavāśarvau manve vāṃ tasya vittaṃ yayor vāṃ viśvaṃ yad idaṃ vitiṣṭhate yāv īśāte asya dvipado yau catuṣpadas tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayor abhyadhva uta yad dūre cid yau viditāv iṣubhṛtām asiṣṭhau bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayor vadhān nāpapadyate kiṃ cana antar deveṣūta mānuṣeṣu bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yāv ārebhāte bahu sākam ugrau pra ced asrāṣṭram abhibhāṃ janeṣu bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
sahasrākṣau vṛtrahaṇā huve vāṃ dūrehetī svannemī ugrau bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yaḥ kṛtyākṛd yātudhāno mahālo ni tasmin hatam adhi vajram ugrau bhavāśarvau bhavataṃ me syonau tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
adhi me brūtaṃ pṛtanāsūgrau saṃ vajreṇa sṛjataṃ yaḥ kimīdī staumi bhavāśarvau nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
manve vāṃ mitrāvaruṇāv ṛtāvṛdhau satyaujasau druhvāṇaṃ yau nudethe yau satyāvānam avatho haveṣu tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
satyaujasau druhvāṇaṃ yau nudethe pra satyāvānam avatho haveṣu yau gacchatho nṛcakṣasā babhruṇā sutaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yāv aṅgiraso 'vatho yāv agastiṃ mitrāvaruṇā jamadagnim atrim yau kaśyapam avatho yau vasiṣṭhaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau bharadvājam avatho vadhryaśvaṃ viśvāmitraṃ varuṇa mitra kutsam yau kakṣīvantam avathaḥ prota kaṇvaṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau śyāvāśyam avatho yau gaviṣṭhiraṃ mitrāvaruṇā purumīḍham atrim yau vimadam avathaḥ saptavadhriṃ tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yau medhātithim avatho yau triśokaṃ mitrāvaruṇā uśanāṃ kāvyaṃ yau yau mudgalam avatho gotamaṃ ca tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
yayo rathaḥ satyavartma rjuraśmir mithuyā carantam abhiyāti dūṣayan staumi mitrāvaruṇā nāthito johavīmi tau no muñcatam aṃhasaḥ
indrasya manve śaśvad yasya manvire vṛtraghna stomā upa mema āguḥ yo dāśuṣaḥ sukṛto havam etā sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yaś carṣaṇipro vṛṣabhaḥ svarvid yasya grāvāṇaḥ pravadanti nṛmṇe yasyādhvaraḥ saptahotā madacyut sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
ya ugrāṇām ugrabāhur yajur yo dānavānāṃ balam āsasāda yena jitāḥ sindhavo yena gāvaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasya vaśāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo yasmai mīyante svaravaḥ svarvide yasmai śukraḥ pavate brahmaśumbhitaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yasya juṣṭiṃ sominaḥ kāmayante yaṃ havanta iṣuvantaṃ gaviṣṭau yasminn arkaḥ śiśriye yasminn ojaḥ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
ya uttamaḥ karmakṛtyāya jajñe yasya vīryaṃ prathamasyānubuddham yenodyato vajro 'bhyāyatāhiṃ sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
yaḥ saṃgrāmān nayati saṃ yudhe vaśī yaḥ puṣṭāni saṃsṛjati dvayāni staumīndraṃ nāthito johavīmi sa no muñcatv aṃhasaḥ
śunaṃ vatsān apā karomi śunaṃ badhnāmi tantyām āgrayaṇaṃ brahmaṇāṃ havis tasmiñ jāgāra kaśyapaḥ
bāhuṃ vatsam upanayan pātre gāṃ duhann abravīt ariṣṭaṃ brahmabhyo haviḥ śivaṃ kṛṇotu kaśyapaḥ
trayas tiṣṭhanti sukṛtasya loke trayo 'tīkāśās trīṇi śīrṣāṇy eṣām trayas tiṣṭhanti parigṛhya kumbhīṃ yathā haviḥ kaśyapa na vyathātai
satyāt sambhūto vadati taṇḍulān kṣīra āvapan ṛṣir brahmabhya āgrayaṇaṃ ni vedayatu kaśyapaḥ
ṛtumukhe candrabhāgaḥ pātra odanam ud dharāt prāśnantu brahmāṇo havir yathā vedena kaśyapaḥ
ye bhūtāny asṛjanta ye bhūtāny akalpayan sarvasya vidvān adhvaryuḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ bhavatu kaśyapaḥ
śivā āpo vatsebhyaḥ śivā bhavantv oṣadhīḥ vāto vatsebhyaḥ kaśyapaḥ śivaḥ śivaṃ tapatu sūryaḥ
namaḥ piśaṅgabāhvai sindhau jātāyā ugrāyai yo asyai nama it karad aped asya gṛhād ayat
apehi no gṛhebhyo apehi vatsatantyāḥ ātmānam atra rotsyasy ava roha mahānasāt
hā amba suhūtale atho hai sāmanantame putro yas te pṛśnibāhus tam u tvaṃ sāmanaṃ kṛdhi atho duhitaraṃ naptrīm atho tvaṃ sāmanā bhava
bhūtapatir nir ajatv indraś cetaḥ sadānvāḥ gṛhasya budhna āsīnās tā vajreṇādhi tiṣṭhatu
apetetaḥ sadānvā ahiṃsantīr imaṃ gṛham dhenur vātra ya sthāsyaty anaḍvān verayā saha
yā sahamānā carasi sāsahāna iva rṣabhaḥ sadānvāghnīṃ tvā vayaṃ jaitrāyācchā vadāmasi
sahasva no abhimātiṃ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ sahasva sarvā rakṣāṃsi sahamānāsy oṣadhe
tvaṃ vyāghrān sahase tvaṃ siṃhām̐ ubhayādataḥ makṣāś cit kṛṇvānā madhu tvaṃ sahasa oṣadhe
iyaṃ pitre rāṣṭry ety agre prathamāya januṣe bhūmaniṣṭhāḥ tasmā etaṃ surucaṃ hvāram ahyaṃ gharmaṃ śrīṇanti prathamasya dhāsyoḥ
brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastād vi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ sa budhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataś ca yonim asataś ca vi vaḥ
pra yo jajñe vidvām̐ asya bandhuṃ viśvāni devo janimā vivakti brahma brahmaṇa uj jabhāra madhyān nīcād uccā svadhā abhi pra tasthau
mahān mahī askabhāyad vi jāto dyāṃ dvitaḥ pārthivaṃ ca rajaḥ sa budhnād āṣṭra januṣābhy agraṃ bṛhaspatir devatā tasya samrāṭ
nūnaṃ tad asya gavyaṃ hinoti maho devasya pūrvasya mahi eṣa jajñe bahubhiḥ sākam itthā pūrvād ardhād avithuraś ca san nu
sa hi divaḥ sa pṛthivyā ṛteṣṭhā mahi kṣāman rajasī vi ṣkabhāyati ahar yac chukraṃ jyotiṣo janiṣṭa adhā dyumanto vi vasantv ariprāḥ
evātharvā pitaraṃ viśvadevaṃ bṛhaspatir namasāvocad accha tvaṃ viśvasya janitā dhāsy agre kavir devān na dabhāya svadhāvaḥ
mūrdhnā yo agram abhyarty ojasā bṛhaspatim ā vivāsanti devāḥ bhinad valaṃ vi mṛdho dardarīti kanikradad gāḥ svar apo jigāya
ud apaptad asau sūryaḥ purudṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā udāyan raśmibhir hantu udāyann arasām̐ akaḥ
ny amrucad asau sūryo viśvadṛṣṭo adṛṣṭahā nimrocan raśmibhir hantu nimrocann arasām̐ akaḥ
ye ca dṛṣṭā ye cādṛṣṭā ubhayehāviṣyavaḥ teṣāṃ vo agrabhaṃ nāma sarve sākaṃ ni jasyata
adṛṣṭahananī vīrud amitaujā viṣāsahi cukākaṇi tvaṃ jajñiṣe sādṛṣṭāñ jātaśo jahi
jahi jyeṣṭham adṛṣṭānāṃ sarpāṇāṃ moghacāriṇām krimīṇāṃ sarvā jātāni pauñjaṣṭa iva yavaṃ mṛṇa
yaś ca todo yaś ca sarpa ekādaśaś ca yo vṛṣā cukākaṇi tvaṃ tān vṛśca vṛkṣaṃ paraśumān iva
saṃ vṛścaināṃś cukākaṇi vṛkṣaṃ paraśumān iva krimīṇāṃ sarvā jātāni saṃ dahāgnir ivolapam
methiṣṭhā agnir aghalas tviṣīmān krimīṇāṃ jātāni pra dunotu sarvā bṛhaspater medine jātavedā adṛṣṭān hantu dṛṣadeva māṣān
mamāgne varco vihaveṣv astu vayaṃ tvendhānās tanvaṃ puṣema mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaś catasras tvayādhyakṣeṇa pṛtanā jayema
agne manyuṃ pratinudan pareṣāṃ tvaṃ no gopāḥ pari pāhi viśvataḥ apāñco yantu prabudhā durasyavo 'maiṣāṃ cittaṃ bahudhā vi naśyatu
mama devā vihave santu sarva indravanto maruto viṣṇur agniḥ mamāntarikṣam urulokam astu mahyaṃ vātaḥ pavatāṃ kāme asmin
mahyaṃ yajantāṃ mama yānīṣṭā ākūtiḥ satyā manaso me astu eno mā ni gāṃ katamac canāhaṃ viśve devā abhi rakṣantu mām iha
mahyaṃ devā draviṇam ā yajantāṃ mamāśīr astu mama devahūtiḥ daivā hotāraḥ saniṣan na etad ariṣṭāḥ syāma tanvā suvīrāḥ
devīḥ ṣaḍ urvīr uru ṇas karātha viśve devāsa iha mādayadhvam mā hāsmahi prajayā mā dhanena mā radhāma dviṣate soma rājan
uruvyacā no mahiṣaḥ śarma yacchād asmin vāje puruhūtaḥ purukṣuḥ sa naḥ prajāyai haryaśva mṛḍa indra mā no rīriṣo mā parā dāḥ
dhātā vidhartā bhuvanasya yas patiḥ savitā devo abhimātiṣāhaḥ bṛhaspatir indrāgnī aśvinobhā devāḥ pāntu yajamānaṃ nirṛthāt
ihārvāñcam ati hvaya indraṃ jaitrāya jetave asmākam astu kevala itaḥ kṛṇotu vīryam
arvāñcam indram amuto havāmahe yo gojid dhanajid aśvajid yaḥ imaṃ no yajñaṃ vihave juṣasva asmākaṃ kṛṇmo harivo medinaṃ tvā
trātāram indram avitāram indraṃ havehave suhavaṃ śūram indram huvema śakraṃ puruhūtam indraṃ svasti no maghavān pātv indraḥ
tisro devīr mahi me śarma yacchan prajāyai me tanve yac ca puṣṭam māṃ viśaḥ saṃmanaso juṣantāṃ pitryaṃ kṣetraṃ prati jānātv asmān
yo naḥ śakrābhimanyunā indrāmitro jighāṃsati tvaṃ taṃ vṛtrahañ jahi vasv asmabhyam ā bhara
ye naḥ śapanty apa te bhavantv indrāgnibhyām apa bādhāmahe tān ādityā rudrā uparispṛśo mām ugraṃ cettāram adhirājam akran
pṛthivī vaśā sāgniṃ garbhaṃ dadhe semaṃ pāhi tasyai te vidheyaṃ tasyai te namas tasmai te svāhā
antarikṣaṃ vaśā sā vāyuṃ garbhaṃ
dyaur vaśā sā sūryaṃ garbhaṃ
ṛg vaśā sā sāma garbhaṃ
dakṣiṇā vaśā sā yajñaṃ garbhaṃ
viḍ vaśā sā kṣatriyaṃ garbhaṃ
vāg vaśā sā parameṣṭhiṇaṃ garbhaṃ
vaśā vaśā sā rājanyaṃ garbhaṃ
samā vaśā sā saṃvatsaraṃ garbhaṃ dadhe semaṃ pāhi tasyai te vidheyaṃ tasyai te namas tasmai te svāhā
sapta sūryā divam anupraviṣṭās tān pathā vā anv eti dakṣiṇāvān te 'smai sarve ghṛtam ā tapanty ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphurantaḥ
ātapan kṣayati nīcā dāsavyādhī niṣṭapan adhāyatpatraḥ sūrya ud eti bṛhatīr anu
ātaptā pitṝn vidma dasyūn niṣṭaptā vayam guhā ye 'nye sūryāḥ svadhām anu caranti te
dyauḥ sacate 'parāñ janāsaḥ pañcānye paro diva ā kṣiyanti tāṃ brahma divaṃ bṛhad ā viveśa yas tān praveda prataram atīryata
yo dadāti yo dadate yo vā nidhīn śraddadhāno nidhatte yamo vaivasvatān rājā sarvān rakṣatu śevadhīn
mā vidan paryāyiṇo ye dakṣiṇāḥ parimuṣṇanti dattam sugena tān pathā sarvān yamo rājāti neṣati
yena pathā vaivasvato yamo rājeto yayau agnir nas tena nayatu prajānan vaiśvānaraḥ pathikṛd viśvagṛṣṭiḥ
mahi jyotir nihitaṃ martyeṣu yena devāso atarann arātīn tenemaṃ setum ati geṣma sarve vaiśvānaraṃ jyotir amīva devāḥ
ud vayaṃ tamasas pari jyotiṣ paśyanta uttaram devaṃ devatrā sūryam aganma jyotir uttamam
āroko bhrājaḥ paṭaraḥ pataṅgaḥ svarṇaro jyotiṣīmān vibhāsaḥ te 'smai sarve ghṛtam ā tapanty ūrjaṃ duhānā anapasphurantaḥ
samutpatantu pradiśo nabhasvatīḥ sam abhrāṇi vātajūtāni yantu maharṣabhasya nadato nabhasvato vāśrā āpaḥ pṛthivīṃ tarpayantu
sam īkṣayati viṣvagvāto nabhāṃsy apāṃ vegāsaḥ pṛthag ut patantu varṣasya sargā mahayantu bhūmiṃ pṛthag jāyantām oṣadhayo viśvarūpāḥ
abhi kranda stanayārdayodadhiṃ bhūmiṃ parjanya payasā sam aṅdhi tvayā varṣaṃ bahulam etu sṛṣṭam āśāraiṣī kṛśagur etv astam
ud īrayata marutaḥ samudratas tveṣā arkā nabha ut pātayantu pra varṣayanti taviṣāḥ sudānavo 'pāṃ rasair oṣadhayaḥ sacantām
gaṇās tvopa gāyantu mārutāḥ parjanya ghoṣiṇaḥ pṛthak sargā varṣasya varṣataḥ sṛjantu pṛthivīm abhi
sam avantu sudānava utsā ajagarā uta vātā varṣasya varṣataḥ pra vāntu pṛthivīm anu
vāto vidyud abhraṃ varṣaṃ sam avantu sudānavaḥ pra pyāyasva pra pinvasva saṃ bhūmiṃ payasā sṛja
apām agnis tanūbhiḥ saṃvidāno ya oṣadhīnām adhipā babhūva sa no varṣaṃ vanutāṃ jātavedāḥ prāṇaṃ prajābhyo amṛtaṃ divas pari
āśām āśāṃ vi dyotatāṃ vātā vāntu diśo diśaḥ marudbhiḥ pracyutā meghā varṣantu pṛthivīm abhi
prajāpatiḥ salilād ā samudrād āpa īrayann udadhim ardayāti pra pyāyatāṃ vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto 'rvāṅ etena stanayitnunehy apo niṣiñcann asuraḥ pitā naḥ
śvasantu gargarā apām ava nīcīr apaḥ sṛja vadantu pṛśnibāhavo maṇḍūkā īriṇānu
saṃvatsaraṃ śaśayānā brāhmaṇā vratacāriṇaḥ vācaṃ parjanyajinvatāṃ pra maṇḍūkā avādiṣuḥ
upapravada maṇḍūki varṣam ā vada tāduri madhye hradasya plavasva vigṛhya caturaḥ padaḥ
mahāntaṃ kośam ud acābhi ṣiñca savidyutaṃ bhavatu vātu vātaḥ tanvatāṃ yajñaṃ bahudhā visṛṣṭam ānandinīr oṣadhayo bhavantu
yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad vā sapta sindhavo vitaṣṭhuḥ vācaṃ viṣasya dūṣaṇīṃ tām ito nir avādiṣam
suparṇas tvā garutmān viṣa prathamam āvayat nāropayo nāmādaya utāsmā abhavat pituḥ
yāṃ tvāsthat pañcāṅgulir vakrāc cid adhi dhanvanaḥ apaskambhasya bāhvor nir avocam ahaṃ viṣam
śalyād viṣaṃ nir avocam añjanāt parṇadher uta apāṣṭhāc chṛṅgāt kurmalān nir avocam ahaṃ viṣam
arasas ta iṣo śalyo 'tho te 'rasaṃ viṣam utārasasya vṛkṣasya dhanuṣ ṭe arasārasam
ye +'pīṣan ye 'dihan ya āsyan ye 'vāsṛjan sarve te vadhrayaḥ santu vadhrir viṣagiriṣ kṛtaḥ
vadhrayas te khanitāro vadhris tvam asy oṣadhe vadhriḥ sa parvato girir yato jātam idaṃ viṣam
vār idaṃ vārayātai varuṇāvata ābhṛtam tatrāmṛtasyāsiktaṃ tac cakārārasaṃ viṣam
khādireṇa śalilena atho kaṅkatadantyā atho viṣasya yad viṣaṃ tena pāpīr anīnaśam
kityā śataparvaṇā sahasrākṣeṇa carmaṇā tīkṣṇābhir abhribhir vayaṃ nir ajāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
sahaḥ sahasvaty asi itaḥ kaṇvāḥ paro 'nudaḥ imā yā adhunāgatā yāś ceha grahaṇīḥ purā
na tā itthā na tā ihāva māsatā ukheva śṛṅgavac chiraḥ sadānvā brahmaṇaspate tīkṣṇaśṛṅgodṛṣann ihi
vi te nu manthāḥ śaśrire bibhide te gadohanī dadau te adya gauḥ kaṇve parehy avaraṃ mṛṇe
yās tarke tiṣṭhanti yā valīke yāḥ preṅkhe preṅkhayanta uta yā nu ghorāḥ yā garbhān pramṛśanti sarvāḥ pāpīr anīnaśam
yāś celaṃ vasata uta yā nu dūrśaṃ nīlaṃ piśaṅgam uta lohitaṃ yāḥ yā garbhān pramṛśanti sarvāḥ pāpīr anīnaśam
ākhidantīr vikhidantīḥ prāṇam asyāpi nahyata durṇāmnīḥ sarvāḥ saṃgatya māmuṣyoc chiṣṭa kiṃ cana
iyaṃ yā musalāhatā dṛṣatpiṣṭā viṣāsutā tapur agnis tapur dyaus tapus tvaṃ sure bhava
viṣaṃ te tokma rohayanto 'bruvan viṣaṃ kumbhe 'va srava viṣaṃ ta āmanaṃ sure viṣaṃ tvaṃ hasta āhitā viṣaṃ pratihitā bhava
siṃhas te astu taṇḍulo vyāghraḥ paryodanam pṛdākūr astu nagnahur vṛkasya hṛdi saṃ srava
iyaṃ yā pātra āsūtā śaṣpasrakvā vighasvarī varāhamanyur ajany uttānapādam ardaya
udardanī pracyavanī pāṃsupiṅgā vighasvarī utkhātamanyur ajani yat paścāt tat puras kṛdhi
viṣaṃ te pavane sure rudhiraṃ sthāle astu te mathnantv anyo anyasmā iṣudhīṃs tvad dhanus tvat
viṣapāvāno rudhirāś caranti pātāro martās tavase sura ime hatāso anye yodhayanty anyāṃs tam ic chaṃsa mahimānaṃ surāyāḥ
tān vīrudho visravo balena ut pātaya mādaya yodhanāyai bhinnāratnīr bhinnaśīrṣṇā sam ṛcchatām ārtacelo visravan te surāpaḥ
viṣāsutāṃ pibata jarhṛṣāṇā asnā saṃsṛṣṭaṃ rudhireṇa miśrām chinnahastaś carati grāme antar vairahatyāni bahudhā paṇāyan
asimatīm iṣumatīm un nayāmi satād adhi mādayābhi mādaya ahir ivainān pra ropaya anyo 'nyasya moc chiṣan
anu te manyatām agnir varuṇas te 'nu manyatām tatas te putro jāyatāṃ sa varmī goṣu yudhyatām
idaṃ vāyo 'nu jānīhi idam indra bṛhaspate āñjanaṃ putravedanaṃ kṛṇmaḥ puṃsavanaṃ vayam
yenaitat pariṣṭabhitaṃ yasmāt putraṃ na vindase indrāgnī tasmāt tvainasaḥ pari pātām ahardivi
atharvāṇo aṅgiraso viśve devā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ śṛṇvantv adya me havam asyai putrāya vettave
indrāṇī varuṇānī sinīvāly utāditiḥ varutry ugrā patnīnāṃ putram adya dideṣṭu te
putraṃ te mitrāvaruṇā putraṃ devī sarasvatī putraṃ te aśvinobhā ā dhattāṃ puṣkarasrajā
yeṣāṃ ca nāma jagrabha yeṣāṃ ca nopasasmara devās te sarve saṃgatya putraṃ jaivātṛkaṃ dadan
ātmana enaṃ nir mimīṣva sa tvat pari jāyatām tvaṃ bījam urvareva tvaṃ bibhṛhi yonyām
pṛthivī saha yajñair nakṣatraiḥ saha sūryaḥ vātaḥ patatribhiḥ saha putram adya dideṣṭu te
vṛṣā jajñe madhavāno 'yaṃ madhumatībhyaḥ sa u te yonim ā śayāṃ baḍ dakṣaḥ puruṣo bhavan
yoniṃ gaccha madhavāna yonyāṃ puruṣo bhava tataḥ punar nir āyasi śīrṣṇā śroṇī vinonudat
bāṇavām̐ iṣudher iva kṛṇvan pitror yathā priyam śroṇī ahiṃsann antarā daśame māsy āyasi
sa pratyaṅ pratyāvarttā ite saṃvatsare punaḥ yathā jīvāsi bhadrayā bibharat tvā mahābhave
saṃ te yonim acīkl̥paṃ suprajāstvāya bhadrayā tatrā siñcasva vṛṣṇyaṃ daśamāsyam avihrutam
garbhas te yonim ā śayāṃ garbho jarāyv ā śayām kumāra ulbam ā śayāṃ tvaṣṭrā kl̥pto yathāparu
yathā rājan madhavāna tvaṃ bījaṃ virohasi evā tvam asyā nir bhindhi kumāraṃ yonyā adhi
garbham adhān madhavāno garbhaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ garbhaṃ ta indraś cāgniś ca garbhaṃ dhātā dadhātu te
śivaḥ śivābhir vayasvan saṃ gacchasva tanvā jātavedaḥ ratnaṃ dadhānaḥ sumanāḥ purastād gṛhebhyas tvā varcase nir vapāmi
pṛthivyāṃ gharma stabhito 'ntarikṣe divi śritaḥ dyaur enaṃ sarvataḥ pātu yas tvā pacaty odana
ye samudram airayan ye ca sindhuṃ ye 'ntarikṣaṃ pṛthivīm uta dyām ye vātena sarathaṃ yānti devās tān āpnoty odanapāko atra
ṛcā kumbhy adhihitā sāmnā pacyata odanaḥ aṃśuṃ somasyaitaṃ manye vaiśvadevam idaṃ haviḥ
ulūkhale musale ye ca śūrpe bhūmyām ukhāyāṃ yad ivāsasañja yā vipruṣo yāni nirṇejanāni sarvaṃ tat te brahmaṇā pūrayāmi
ūrdhvaḥ prehi mā saṃ vikthā vy asya rajo antaram rakṣāṃsi sarvā tīrtvā athā roha divaṃ tvam

yo 'psu yakṣmaḥ śamayāmi taṃ va ūrjā gavyūtiṃ sam anajmy etām stanyaṃ kṣīram aviṣaṃ vaḥ kṛṇomy asuṃ dhayanto 'pi yūtham eta

yo devānām asi śreṣṭho rudras tanticaro vṛṣā ariṣṭā asmākaṃ vīrā etad astu hutaṃ tava
pūrṇam ahaṃ karīṣiṇaṃ śatavantaṃ sahasriṇam viśvebhir agne devair imaṃ goṣṭhaṃ sahāruham

muniṃ bhavantaṃ pari yāni vāvṛtū rakṣāṃsy agna ululā karikratu atas tvaṃ no adhi pāhi vājinn indreṇa medī bṛhate raṇāya

agniṣ ṭe ni śamayatu yat ta etan mana uhyate juhomi vidvāṃs te havir yathānunmadito bhuvaḥ

ayaṃ me hasto bhagavān ayaṃ me bhagavattaraḥ ayaṃ me viśvabheṣajo 'yaṃ śivābhimarśanaḥ

pari tvā kṛṣṇavartanir agnir dhūmenārciṣā sa tvaṃ tarda paraś cara anyat tarddhi tṛṇaṃ yavāt
ye tardā asureṣitā devebhir iṣitāś ca ye sarvāṃs tān brahmaṇā vayaṃ śalabhāñ jambhayāmasi
śalabhasya śalabhyās tardasyo patatriṇaḥ agner vātasya dhrājyā api nahyāma āsyam
idaṃ yad gavi bheṣajaṃ viśvād rūpāt samābhṛtam ākhor ghuṇasya tardasya teṣāṃ snāvnāpi nahyata
dṛṣṭā tvam asi gandhena oṣadhir ghuṇajambhanī ākhor ghuṇasya jātāni tāni jambhaya tejasā
tūlaṃ tardas tṛṇasyāttu mūlam ākhur dhiyeṣitaḥ atho vṛkṣasya phalgu yad ghuṇā adantu mā yavam

kṣudhāmāraṃ tṛṣṇāmāram agotām anapatyatām apāmārga tvayā vayaṃ sarvaṃ tad apa mṛjmahe
samā bhūmiḥ sūryeṇa ahnā rātrī samāvatī kṛṇomi satyam ūtaye arasāḥ santu kṛtvarīḥ
yo devāḥ kṛtyāṃ kṛtvā harād aviduṣo gṛham vatso dhārur iva mātaraṃ taṃ pratyag upa padyatām
amā kṛtvā pāpmānaṃ yas tayānyaṃ jighāṃsati aśmānas tasyāṃ dagdhāyāṃ bahulāḥ phaṭ karikratu
sahasradhāman viśikhān vigrīvāñ chāyayā tvam prati sma cakruṣe kṛtyāṃ priyāṃ priyāvate hara
yā cakāra na śaśāka śaśre pādam aṅgulim cakāra bhadram asmabhyam abhagā bhagavadbhyaḥ
anayāham oṣadhyā sarvāḥ kṛtyā adūṣayam yāṃ kṣetre cakrur yāṃ gobhyo yāṃ vā te puruṣebhyaḥ
apāmārgo 'pa mārṣṭu kṣetriyaṃ śapathāṃś ca mat apāha yātudhānyo 'pa sarvā arāyyaḥ
apamṛjya yātudhānān apa sarvā arāyyaḥ apāmārga prajayā tvaṃ rayyā sacasva naḥ
utevāsy abandhukṛd utāsy anujāmikaḥ uto kṛtyākṛtaḥ prajāṃ naḍam ivā chindhi vārṣikam
brāhmaṇena paryukto 'si kaṇvena nārṣadena senevaiṣi tviṣīmatī na tatra bhayam asti yatra prāpnoṣy oṣadhe
agre 'sy oṣadhīnāṃ jyotiṣevābhidīpayan uta pākasya trātāsy uta hantāsi rakṣasaḥ
yad ado devā asurāṃs tvayāgre nirakṛṇvata tasmād adhi tvam oṣadhe apāmārgo ajāyathāḥ
vibhindatī śataśākhā vibhindan nāma te pitā pratyag vi bhindhi taṃ tvaṃ yo asmām̐ abhidāsati
asad bhūmyāḥ sam abhavat tad dyām eti bṛhad vacaḥ tad it tato vidhūmayat pratyak kartāram ṛcchatu
pratyaṅ hi saṃbabhūvitha pratīcīnaphalas tvam pratīcīḥ kṛtyā ākṛtya amuṃ kṛtyākṛtaṃ jahi
śatena mā pari pāhi sahasreṇābhi rakṣa mā indras te vīrudhāṃ pata ugra ojmānam ā dadhau
arātyā dyāvāpṛthivī chintaṃ mūlam atho śiraḥ vicchidya madhyataḥ pṛṣṭīs tāṃ kṛṇvāthām adhaspadam
idaṃ śṛṇu jātavedo yad amuṣyā vaco mama arātyāḥ sarvam ic chiraḥ praśnaṃ vṛhatam aśvinā

śreṣṭho me rājā varuṇo havaṃ satyena gacchatu arātiṃ hatvā santokām ugro devo 'bhi dāsatu

somo rājauṣadhībhiḥ sūryācandramasā ubhā arātiṃ sarve gandharvā ghnantv apsarasaś ca yāḥ
bhavo rājā bhavāśarvāv indro vāyur bṛhaspatiḥ tvaṣṭā me adhyakṣaḥ pūṣā te 'rātiṃ ghnantu sarvadā
ye ca devā bhūmicarā ye cāmī divy āsate ye antarikṣasyeśate te 'rātiṃ ghnantu savratāḥ
yā ceṣitāsurair devebhir iṣitā ca yā atho yā manyor jāyate 'rātiṃ hanmi brahmaṇā
tad in nu me acacchadan mahad yakṣaṃ bṛhad vapuḥ viśvair yad devair nirṛtis tanā yujā saṃ mṛtyor iha jāyate
amamriścitsāprathovadadahim ahirājantam ojasā āyuṃ cit kutsam atithigvam ardaya vi nikilbindam ojasā
yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad vā sapta sindhavo mahitvā tāvatī nirṛtir viśvavārā viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda
viśvasya hi jāyamānasya devi puṣṭasya vā puṣṭapatir babhūvitha namo 'stu te nirṛte mā tv asmān parā bhujo nāparaṃ hātayāsi
devīm ahaṃ nirṛtiṃ manyamānaḥ piteva putraṃ na sace vacobhiḥ viśvasya yā jāyamānasya veda śiraḥśiraḥ prati sūro 'nu tasthe
asunvantam ayajamānam iccha stenasyetyāṃ taskarasyānu śikṣa svapantam iccha sā ta ityā namas tu te nirṛte 'haṃ kṛṇomi
asunvakān nirṛtiḥ saṃjighatsur nāsyāḥ pitā vidyate nota mātā madhyāt svasrām anu jaghāna sarvaṃ na devānām asuryaṃ sam āpa
yad asya pāre tamasaḥ śukraṃ jyotir ajāyata tan naḥ parṣad ati dviṣo 'gne vaiśvānara dyumat
pramucyamānaṃ bhuvanasya gopaḥ paśuṃ no atra prati bhāgam etu agnir yajñaṃ trivṛtaṃ saptatantuṃ devo devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan
yau te daṃṣṭrau sudihau ropayiṣṇū nir hvayete dakṣiṇāḥ saṃ ca paśyataḥ anāṣṭraṃ naḥ pitaras tat kṛṇotu yūpe baddhaṃ pramumucimā yad annam
ahrastas tvam aviduṣṭaḥ parehi indrasya goṣṭham api dhāva vidvān dhīrāsas tvā kavayaḥ saṃ mṛjantv iṣam ūrjaṃ yajamānāya matsva
ṛṣibhiṣ ṭvā saptabhir atriṇāhaṃ prati gṛhṇāmi bhuvane syonam jamadagniḥ kaśyapaḥ svādv etad bharadvājo madhv annaṃ kṛṇotu pratigrahītre gotamo vasiṣṭho viśvāmitro daduṣe śarma yacchāt
yan no agraṃ haviṣa ājagāma annasya pātram uta sarpiṣo vā yad vā dhanaṃ vahator ājagāma agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
yad ājyaṃ pratijagrabha yāṃś ca vrīhīn ajaṃ candreṇa saha yaj jaghāsa bṛhaspatir haviṣo no vidhartā mā no hiṃsīc chāgo aśvo vaśā ca
agnir na etat prati gṛhṇātu vidvān bṛhaspatiḥ praty etu prajānan indro marutvān suhutaṃ kṛṇotv ayakṣmam anamīvaṃ te astu
yan no dadur varāham akṣitaṃ vasu yad vā talpam upadhānena naḥ saha yad vāviyūthaṃ saha vṛṣṇyā no agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
yan naḥ śālāṃ viśvabhogām imāṃ dadur gṛhaṃ vā yoktraṃ saha kṛttyota yad vā hara upanāhena devā agniṣ ṭad dhotā suhutaṃ kṛṇotu
sūrye varca iti yac chuśravāhaṃ yena prajā jyotiragrāś caranti some varco yad goṣu varco mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
yajñe varco maruto yad adṛṃhan vāyuḥ paśūn asṛjat saṃ bhagena gandharvāṇām apsarasāṃ yad apsu mayi
yajñe varco yajamāne ca varca udābhiṣikte rājani yac ca varcaḥ dakṣiṇāyāṃ varco adhi yan
rathe varco rathavāhane ca varca iṣudhau varcaḥ kavace ca varcaḥ aśveṣu varco adhi yan
sabhāyāṃ varcaḥ samityāṃ ca varco vadhvāṃ varca uta varco vareṣu surāyāṃ varco adhi yan
siṃhe varca uta varco vyāghre vṛke varco madhuhāre ca varcaḥ śyene varcaḥ patvanāṃ yad babhūva
hiraṇyavarcasam uta hastivarcasaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ yaj jajñuṣāṃ varca āhuḥ kṛṣyāṃ kṣetra ṛṣayo janyānajur mayi devā rāṣṭrabhṛtas tad akran
mayi varco mayi śravo mayi dyumnaṃ mayi tviṣiḥ adhaspadaṃ pṛtanyavo 'haṃ bhūyāsam uttamaḥ
payasvatīr oṣadhayaḥ payasvan māmakaṃ vacaḥ atho payasvatāṃ paya ā harāmi sahasraśaḥ
ahaṃ veda yathā payaś cakāra dhānyaṃ bahu saṃbhṛtvā nāmā yo devas taṃ vayaṃ yajāmahe sarvasyāyajvano gṛhe
yathā dyauś ca pṛthivī ca tasthatur dharuṇāya kam evā sphātiṃ ni tanomi mayāreṣu khaleṣu ca
yathā kūpaḥ śatadhāraḥ sahasradhāro akṣitaḥ evā me astu dhānyaṃ sahasradhāram akṣitam
śatahasta samāhara sahasrahasta saṃ kira yatheha sphātir āyati kṛtasya kāryasya ca
imā yāḥ pañca pradiśo mānavīḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ sarvāḥ śaṃbhūr mayobhuvo vṛṣṭe śāpaṃ nadīr iva iha sphātiṃ samāvahān
iha sphātir oṣadhīnāṃ devānām uta saṃgamaḥ ihaivāśvinor astu dvāparāśvo ruhat
tisro mātrā gandharvāṇāṃ catasro gṛhapatnyāḥ tāsāṃ yā sphātir uttamā tayā tvābhi mṛśāmasi
jyeṣṭhasya tvāṅgirasasya hastābhyām ā rabhāmahe yathāsad bahudhānyam ayakṣmaṃ bahupūruṣam
atyāsarat prathamā dhokṣyamāṇā sarvān yajñān bibhratī vaiśvadevī upa vatsaṃ sṛjata vāśyate gaur vy asṛṣṭa sumanā hiṃ kṛṇoti
badhāna vatsam abhi dhehi bhuñjatīṃ ni dya godhug upa sīda dugdhi iḍām asmā odanaṃ pinvamānā kīlālaṃ ghṛtaṃ madam annabhāgam
sā dhāvatu yamarājñaḥ savatsā sukṛtāṃ pathā prathameha dattā atṛṣṭa dattā prathamedam āgan vatsena gāṃ saṃ sṛja viśvarūpām
prathamedam āgan prathamā dattetād yasmim̐l loke sadya u tvā dadāti sainaṃ dheno prathamā pārayāsi śraddhayā dattā parame vyoman
jānīhi sma saṃskṛte dheno gopatiṃ yas tvā dadāti prathamāṃ svadhānām pūrvā hi tatra sukṛtaḥ parehy athaiṣa aitā jarasaḥ parastāt
ati dhenur anaḍvāham aty anyad vayo akramīt ati vatsānāṃ pitaraṃ ṛṣabhaṃ pratimāsarat
jyotiṣmatī sukṛto yāhi sūre syonās te dheno patayo bhavantu sapta tvā sūryā anvātapantu yamaṃ dhāva māti saraḥ parācīḥ
dātre *'mutra mahyaṃ duhānā ubhau lokau bhuñjatī vi kramasva iṣam ūrjaṃ dakṣiṇāḥ saṃvasānā bhagasya dhārām avase pratīmaḥ
sahasrāṅgā śataṃ jyotīṃṣy asyā yajñasya paprir amṛtā svargā sā na aitu dakṣiṇā viśvarūpā ahiṃsantīṃ prati gṛhṇīma enām
ye te pāśā varuṇa sapta saptatīs tredhā tiṣṭhanti viṣitā ruśantaḥ sinanti sarve anṛtaṃ vadantaṃ yaḥ satyavādy ati taṃ sṛjanti
iha spaśaḥ pra carantīme asya sahasrākṣā ati paśyanti bhūmim yo 'sya vrataṃ pramināti kaś ca na sa mucyate varuṇasya pāśāt
uteyam asya pṛthivī samīcy utāsau dyaur bṛhatī dūreantā uto samudro varuṇasya kukṣā utāsminn alpa udake namuktaḥ
yas tiṣṭhati manasā yaś ca vañcati yo nilāyaṃ carati yaḥ pralāyam dvau yadyad vadataḥ sanniṣadya rājā tad veda varuṇas tṛtīyaḥ
sarvaṃ tad rajā varuṇo vi caṣṭe yad antarā rodasī yat parastāt saṃkhyātā asya nimiṣo janānām akṣān na śvaghnī bhuvanā mimīte
tvam eva rājan varuṇa dhartā devānām asi viśvarūpaḥ duścarmāstv adhamaḥ piśaṅgo yaḥ satyāṃ vācam anṛtena hanti
yaḥ samāmyo varuṇo yo vyāmyo yaḥ sandeśyo varuṇo yo videśyaḥ yo daivyo varuṇo yaś ca mānuṣaḥ sarvāṃs tve tān prati muñcāmy atra
śatena pāśair varuṇābhi dhehi mā te mocy anṛtavāṅ nṛcakṣaḥ āstāṃ jālma udaraṃ śraṃsayitvā kośa ivābandhraḥ parikṛtyamānaḥ
uto tvat pra pātayaty uto tvad api nahyati uto tvad asvakaṃ kṛtvā rājā varuṇa īyate
ainaṃ chinatti varuṇo naḍaṃ kaśipune yathā mūlaṃ tasya vṛścati ya enaṃ pramimīṣati
ya imāṃ devo mekhalām ābabandha yaḥ saṃnanāha ya u mā yuyoja yasya devasya praśiṣā carāmi sa pāram icchāt sa u mā vi muñcāt
āhutāsy abhihuta ṛṣīṇām asy āyudham pūrvā vratasya prāśnatī vīraghnī bhava mekhale
mṛtyor ahaṃ brahmacārī yad asmi bhūtān niryācan puruṣaṃ yamāya tam ahaṃ brahmaṇā tapasā śrameṇa anayainaṃ mekhalayā sināmi
ayaṃ vajras tarpayatāṃ vratena avāsya rāṣṭram abhi hantu jīvam bhinattu skandhān pra śṛṇātūṣṇihāḥ
adharottaram adharottareṇa gūḍhaḥ pṛthivyā mot sṛpat vajreṇāvahataḥ śayām
yo jināti tam anv iccha yo jināti tam ij jahi jinato vajra sāyaka sīmantam anvañcam anu pātaya
yad aśnāmi balaṃ kurve vajram ā dadā iti skandhān amuṣya śātayan vṛtrasyeva śacīpatiḥ
yat pibāmi saṃ pibāmi samudra iva saṃpibaḥ prāṇān amuṣya saṃpiban saṃ pibāmy ahaṃ pibam
yad girāmi saṃ girāmi samudra iva saṃgiraḥ prāṇān amuṣya saṃgiran saṃ girāmy ahaṃ giram
śraddhāyā duhitā tapaso 'dhi jātā svasa rṣīṇāṃ bhūtakṛtāṃ babhūva sā no mekhale matim ā dhehi medhām atho no dhehi tapa indriyaṃ ca
yāṃ tvā pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayaḥ paribedhire sā tvaṃ pari ṣvajasva mā dīrghāyutvāya mekhale
aśaṃ te śvaśrūr vadatu śvaśuras te aśantaram devā te abhiśocanaṃ brahma vidveṣaṇaṃ kṛtam
ā krandayolulā kuru vācam ā dhehy apriyām śiro lipsasva hastābhyāṃ keśās te abhiśocanam
ye keśā yau pratidhī yat kurīraṃ ya opaśaḥ atho ye te svāḥ santi sarve te te 'bhiśocanam
apa trasa paridhānād unmādanaṃ kṛṇomi te atho yat te svaṃ vāsaḥ sarvaṃ tat te 'bhiśocanam
arkam addhi pra patāto municakṣuṃ kṛṇomi te atho śvabhyo rāyadbhyaḥ prati sma gaṅgaṇaṃ kuru
ut tiṣṭhāre palāyasva marīcīnāṃ padaṃ bhava atho yat kāryaṃ kurv āśāṃ sam ṛṣa muṣkayoḥ
upa kṣvedābhi cālaya vātas tūlam ivaijaya dadbhiḥ saṃdaśya bāhvor udaddhi muravasthiye
abhi gāya śābaleyaṃ śauṇeyaṃ sādhuvāhinam kālmāṣeyasya carkṛdhy āyataḥ prati cālaya
ṛśyapucchaṃ śunaḥpucchaṃ vātaraṃhaṃ manojavam taṃ te rathaṃ saṃ bharantu devās tenā carāsi patim icchamānā
agnaye sam anaman tasmai pṛthivyā sam anaman yathāgnaye pṛthivyā samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu vittiṃ bhūtiṃ puṣṭiṃ paśūn brahma brāhmaṇavarcasam saṃnataya stha saṃ me namata svāhā
vāyave sam anaman tasmā antarikṣeṇa sam anaman yathā vāyave antarikṣeṇa samanaman
sūryāya sam anaman tasmai divā sam anaman yathā sūryāya divā samanaman
candrāya sam anaman tasmai nakṣatraiḥ sam anaman yathā candrāya nakṣatraiḥ samanaman
somāya sam anaman tasmā oṣadhībhiḥ sam anaman yathā somāyauṣadhībhiḥ samanaman
yajñāya sam anaman tasmai dakṣiṇābhiḥ sam anaman yathā yajñāya dakṣiṇābhiḥ samanaman
samudrāya sam anaman tasmai nadībhiḥ sam anaman yathā samudrāya nadībhiḥ samanaman
brahmaṇe sam anaman tasmai brahmacāribhiḥ sam anaman yathā brahmaṇe brahmacāribhiḥ samanaman
indrāya sam anaman tasmai vīryeṇa sam anaman yathendrāya vīryeṇa samanaman
devebhyaḥ sam anaman tebhyo 'mṛtena sam anaman yathā devebhyo 'mṛtena samanaman
prajāpataye sam anaman tasmai prajābhiḥ sam anaman yathā prajāpataye prajābhiḥ samanamann evā mahyaṃ saṃnamaḥ saṃ namantu vittiṃ bhūtiṃ puṣṭiṃ paśūn brahma brāhmaṇavarcasam saṃnataya stha saṃ me namata svāhā
sapta saṃnamo 'ṣṭamī dhītisādhanī sakāmān adhvanaḥ kṛṇu saṃjñānam astu vo dhane
ye vāruṇā uta nairṛtā vanaspatīnāṃ vīrudhāṃ ca pāśāḥ ye bhaumā bhūmyā adhi saṃbabhūvus te tvā na hiṃsāñ chivatātir astu te
ye antarikṣe divi ye ca pāśā anne vicṛttā bahudhā sinanti ye paśubhyo adhi saṃbabhūvus te tvā na hiṃsāñ chivatātir astu te
yaṃ mānuṣaṃ manuṣyāḥ śapante yāṃ vā hotrāṃ pitryām ārabhante samāmyo varuṇo ya ājagāma sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
apaḥ pragāhya yadi vā samāmiṣe agnim ārebhiṣe yadi vā samiddham vidvān avidvān anṛtaṃ yad uvaktha tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
yat pratīcyāṃ dṛṣatpiṣṭām̐ āmapeṣām̐ āmapātre papātha hīnaḥ satyenānṛtaṃ yad uvaktha tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
yaṃ bāṇavantaṃ sudihaṃ saṃbharanti yaṃ vā hastaṃ brāhmaṇasyārabhante samāmyo varuṇo yaṃ jaghāna tasya śmaśānād adhi loṣṭa ābhṛtaḥ sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
yaṃ grāvāṇam ārabhante yenāṃśūn abhiṣuṇvanti somam yad vā dhanaṃ dhanakāmo niremiṣe kṣetraṃ gām aśvaṃ puruṣaṃ vobhayādat tat tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
apaḥ pragāhya yadi vā vyāmiṣe agnim ārebhiṣe yadi vā samiddham jāmyā hastaṃ kṛtam ārebhiṣe dhanur vottatam iti cakramitha manyau vā rājño varuṇasyāsi saktaḥ sa tvā na hiṃsāc chivatātir astu te
yā te prajāpihitā parābhūd yonir vā mugdhā nihitā piśācaiḥ āsnānaṃ vā yad abhitaṣṭhātha ghoraṃ sarvaṃ tat te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi
yady asyāḥ prajā varuṇena guṣpitā durṇāmāno vā ṛtviyam asyā rihanti dveṣāt sāpatnād yadi cakrur asyā ayaṃ tā nāṣṭrā apa hantv agniḥ
asyā striyā yadi lakṣmīr aputryā garbho vāsyā yātudhānaiḥ parābhṛtaḥ duḥsvapnyaṃ vā yat svapatī dadarśa indrāgnī tat kṛṇutāṃ bhadrayā punaḥ
devainasād yadi putraṃ na vindase manuṣyāṇāṃ vā tvā śapatho rarādha pitṛbhir vā te yadi sūtaḥ pariṣṭhita idaṃ taṃ niṣ kṛṇmo janayāsi putram
vaiśvānaro janmanā jātavedāḥ prajāpatiḥ siñcatu reto asyām bādhatāṃ dveṣo nirṛtiṃ parācaiḥ putriṇīm imāṃ prasvaṃ kṛṇotu
iha prajām agnir asyai dadhātv ādityebhir vasubhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ viśve devā havam ā yantu ma imaṃ putro asyā jāyatāṃ vīryāvān
yena devy aditir garbham ādadhe yena prajā asṛjata prajāpatiḥ tenāham asyai haviṣā juhomi yathā pumāṃsaṃ janayāti putram
vanve te putraṃ pari devatābhyo anu manyantāṃ marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ garbhas tvā daśamāsyaḥ pra viśatu kumāraṃ jātaṃ pipṛtām upasthe
keśy agniṃ keśī viṣaṃ keśī bibharti rodasī keśī viśvaṃ svar dṛśe keśīdaṃ jyotir ucyate
munayo vātaraśanāḥ piśaṅgā vasate malāḥ vātasyānu dhrājiṃ yanti yad devāso ayukṣata
unmaditā mauneyena vātām̐ ā tasthimā vayam śarīred asmākaṃ yūyaṃ martāso abhi paśyatha
antarikṣeṇa patati svar bhūtāvacākaśat munir devasya devasya saukṛtyāya sakhā hitaḥ
indrasyāśvo vāyoḥ sakhā atho deveṣito muniḥ ubhā samudrāv ā kṣayati sadyaḥ pūrvam utāparam
gandharvāṇām apsarasāṃ devānāṃ caraṇe caran muniḥ ketasya saṃvidvān sakhā svādur madintamaḥ
vāyur asmā upāmanthat pinaṣṭi smā kunaṃnamā munir viṣasya pātreṇa yad rudreṇāpibat saha
saṃyukte dyāvāpṛthivī tiṣṭhantī avicartye keśenaikasya devasya vy aṣṭabhnāc chacīpatiḥ
na tam aṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam sajoṣaso yam aryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ
tad dhi vayaṃ vṛṇīmahe varuṇa mitrāryaman yan no nir aṃhaso yūyaṃ pātha nethā ca martyam ati dviṣaḥ
te nūnaṃ no yūyam ūtaye varuṇa nayiṣṭhā no neṣiṇa stha parṣiṣṭāḥ parṣiṇo ati dviṣaḥ
śunam asmabhyam ūtaye varuṇa mitrāryaman śarma yacchātha sapratha ādityāso yad īmahe ati dviṣaḥ
ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā rudraṃ marudbhir ugraṃ huvema indram agniṃ svastaye ati dviṣaḥ
netāra ū ṣu ṇas tiro varuṇo mitro aryamā ati viśvāni duritā rājānaś carṣaṇīnām ati dviṣaḥ
yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇa mitrāryaman yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priyā syāma supraṇītayo 'ti dviṣaḥ
yathā ha tyad vasavo gauryaṃ cit padi ṣitām amuñcatā yajatrāḥ evo ṣv asman muñcatā vy aṃhaḥ pra tāry agne prataraṃ na āyuḥ
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūto brāhmaṇebhyo nir vapāmi sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamānaḥ pitṝṇāṃ loke
anumataṃ pṛthivyemaṃ pacāmy anu me dyaur manyatām anv antarikṣam anu manyatām aditir devaputrā ime svarge loke astu
brahmaṇokhām adhi dadhāmy agnau bhūmyāṃ tvā bhūmim adhi dhārayāmi agniḥ pacan rakṣatv odanam imaṃ rakṣaḥpiśācān nudatāṃ jātavedāḥ
acyutam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīm utsam iva sadam akṣīyamāṇam pitā pitāmaha uta yas tṛtīyas ta enaṃ bhāgam upa jīvantv atra
prapīnam akṣitaṃ viśvadānīṃ somam iva punar āpyāyamānam putraḥ pautra uta yaḥ prapautras teṣām astu nihito bhāga eṣaḥ
mā me jārīn nihito bhāga eṣa mānuṣanmānuṣad gupto astu vaivasvate ni dadhe śevadhim etaṃ tasmā ut sṛjatu mahyam eva
punaḥ pūryatāṃ yad adanty asya odano 'yaṃ tiṣṭhatv akṣitaḥ sadā vaivasvatena gupto astu rājñā mamaitor upa jīvantu me svāḥ
śatadhāraṃ sahasradhāram utsam akṣitaṃ vyacyamānaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe ūrjaṃ duhānam anapasphurantam upāsīya sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaḥ
tad id āsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugras tveṣanṛmṇaḥ sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūn anu yaṃ viśve madanty ūmāḥ
vāvṛdhānaḥ śavasā bhūryojāḥ śatrur dāsāya bhiyasaṃ dadhāti avyanac ca vyanac ca sasni saṃ te navanta prabhṛtā madeṣu
tve kratum api pṛñcanti viśve dvir yad ete trir bhavanty ūmāḥ svādoḥ svādīyaḥ svādunā sṛjā sam adaḥ su madhu madhunābhi yodhīḥ
iti cid dhi tvā dhanā jayantaṃ raṇeraṇe anumadanti viprāḥ ojīyo dhṛṣṇo sthiram ā tanuṣva mā tvā dabhan durevā yātudhānāḥ
tvayā vayaṃ śāśadmahe raṇeṣu prapaśyanto yudhenyāni bhūri codayāmi ta āyudhā vacobhiḥ saṃ te śyāmi brahmaṇā vayāṃsi
stuṣeyyaṃ puruvarpasam ṛbhvam inatamam āptyam āptyānām ā darśate śavasā sapta dānūn pra sākṣate pratimānāni bhūri
ni tad dadhiṣe 'varaṃ paraṃ ca yasminn āvithāvasā duroṇe ā mātarā sthāpayase jigatnū ata inoṣi karvarā purūṇi
imā brahma bṛhaddivo vivakti indrāya śūṣam agriyaḥ svarṣāḥ maho gotrasya kṣayati svarājo duraś ca viśvā avṛṇod apa svāḥ
evā mahān bṛhaddivo atharvā avocat svāṃ tanvam indram eva svasāro mātaribhvarīr ariprā hinvanti ca śavasā vardhayanti ca
ṛdhaṅmandrayoninovibhāvā amṛtāsuḥ sujanmā vardhamānaḥ adabdhāsur bhrājamāno 'heva trito dādhāra trīṇi
ni yo dharmaṇi prathamaḥ sasāda ato vapūṃṣi kṛṇute purūṇi dhāsyur yoniṃ prathama ā viveśa ā yo vācam anuditāṃ cikāya
yas te śokas tanva ārireca kṣarad dhiraṇyaṃ śucayo 'nu svāḥ atrā dadhiṣe amṛtāni nāma asme vastrāṇīṣa erayanta
pra yad ete prataraṃ pūrvyaṃ guḥ sadaḥsada ātiṣṭhanto ajuryam kaviḥ śuṣasya mātarā rihāṇe jāmirvadhuryuḥpratimānimīta
tad ū ṣu te mahā pṛthuryaman namaḥ kaviḥ kāvyenākṛṇot yat samyañco 'bhiyanto *'dhi kṣām adhā mahī rodhacakrā vavardha
sapta maryādāḥ kavayas tatakṣus tāsām id ekām abhy aṃhuro gāt utāmṛtāsur vṛta eṣi kṛṇvann asura āptaḥ svadhayā samadguḥ
utāyur jyeṣṭho ratnā dadhāty ūrjā vā yaṃ sacate kavir dāḥ putro vā yat pitarā kṣatram īrte jyeṣṭhaṃ maryādam ahvayan svasti
darśan nu tān varuṇa ye ta iṣṭāv āvarvṛtataḥ kṛṇavo vapūṃṣi ardham ardhena śavasā pṛṇakṣy ardhena śuṣmaṃ vardhase *'mūra
avīvṛdhāma śagmyaṃ sakhāyaṃ varuṇaṃ putram aditer iṣiram kaviśastāny asmai vacāṃsy avocāma rodasī satyavācau
