ka idaṃ cakṣur asṛjata kaḥ prāṇaṃ kheṣv āvayat ka idaṃ manaś ca vācaṃ ca ka imāṃ sam abharat puram
brahma cakṣur asṛjata brahma khe prāṇam āvayat brahma manaś ca vācaṃ ca brahma sam abharat puram
nainaṃ cakṣur jahāti na prāṇo jarasaḥ puraḥ puraṃ yo brahmaṇo veda yasmāt puruṣa ucyate
yo vai tāṃ brahmaṇo veda amṛtenāvṛtāṃ puram tasmai brahma ca brāhmyāś ca āyuṣ prāṇaṃ prajāṃ daduḥ
aṣṭācakrā navadvārā devāṇāṃ pūr ayodhyā tasyāṃ hiraṇyayaḥ kośaḥ svargo jyotiṣāvṛtaḥ
tasmin hiraṇyaye kośe tryare tripratiṣṭhite tasmin yad antar ātmanvat tad vai brahmavido viduḥ
prabhrājamānāṃ hariṇīṃ yaśasā saṃparīvṛtām puraṃ hiraṇmayīṃ brahmā viveśāparājitām
ayaṃ te varaṇo maṇiḥ sapatnakṣayaṇaḥ kṛtaḥ tenā rabhasva tvaṃ śatrūn pra mṛṇīhi durasyataḥ
aināñ chṛṇīhi pra mṛṇā rabhasva maṇis te astu puraetā purastāt avārayanta varaṇena devā abhyācāram asurāṇāṃ śvaḥśvaḥ
ā tvārakṣad varaṇo viśvabheṣajaḥ sahasrākṣo harito hiraṇyayaḥ yas te śatrūn adharān pātayāsi pūrvas tān dabhnuhi ya u tvā dviṣanti
ayaṃ te kṛtyāṃ vitatāṃ pauruṣeyam ayaṃ vadham ayaṃ te sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ varaṇo vārayiṣyate
varaṇo vārayātā idaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ yakṣmaḥ praviṣṭo yo 'smin tam u devā avīvaran
svapnaṃ suptvā yadi paśyāsi pāpaṃ mṛgaḥ sṛtiṃ yati dhāvād ajuṣṭām parikṣavāc chakuneḥ pāpavādād ayaṃ maṇir varaṇo vārayātai
arātyā mā nirṛtyā abhicārād atho bhayāt mṛtyor ojīyaso vadhāt tvaṃ varaṇa vāraya
varaṇena pravyathitā bhrātṛvyā me sabandhavaḥ asūrtaṃ rajo 'py agus te yantv adhamaṃ tamaḥ
yan me mātā yan me pitā bhrātaro yac ca me svā yad enaś cakṛmā vayam tasmān no vārayiṣyate 'yaṃ devo vanaspatiḥ
ariṣṭo 'ham ariṣṭagur āyuṣmān sarvapūruṣaḥ taṃ māyaṃ varaṇo maṇiḥ pari pātu diśodiśaḥ
ayaṃ me varaṇa urasi rājā devo vanaspatiḥ sa me kṣatraṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca paśūn ojaś ca me dadhat
imaṃ bibharmi varaṇam āyuṣmāñ chataśāradaḥ sa me śatrūn vi bādhatām indro dasyūn ivāsurān
yathā vāto vanaspatīn jīrṇān bhanakty ojasā evā sapatnāṃs tvaṃ bhaṅdhi pūrvāñ jātān utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu
yathā vātena prakṣīṇā vṛkṣāḥ śere nyarpitāḥ evā sapatnāṃs tvaṃ sarvān pra kṣiṇīhi nyarpaya pūrvāñ jātān utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu
yathā vātaś cāgniś ca sarvān psāto vanaspatīn evā sapatnāṃs tvaṃ psāhi pūrvāñ jātān utāparān varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu
tāṃs tvaṃ pra chindhi varaṇa purā diṣṭāt purāyuṣaḥ ya imaṃ paśuṣu dipsanti ye cāsya rāṣṭradipsavaḥ
yathā sūryo atibhāti yathāsmin teja āhitam evā sapatnāṃs tvaṃ sarvān ati bhāhi śvaḥśvo varaṇas tvābhi rakṣatu
yathā yaśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yathāsmiñ jātavedasi evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mām
yathā yaśo agnihotre vaṣaṭkāre yathā yaśaḥ
yathā yaśaḥ somapīthe madhuparke yathā yaśaḥ
yathā yaśaḥ kanyāyāṃ yathāsmin saṃbhṛte rathe
yathā yaśaś candramasy āditye ca nṛcakṣasi
yathā yaśaḥ prajāpatau yathāsmin parameṣṭhini
yathā deveṣv amṛtaṃ yathaiṣu satyam āhitam evā me varaṇo maṇiḥ kīrtiṃ bhūtiṃ ni yacchatu tejasā mā sam ukṣatu yaśasā sam anaktu mām
asya vāmasya palitasya hotus tasya bhrātā madhyamo asty aśnaḥ tṛtīyo bhrātā ghṛtapṛṣṭho asya atrāpaśyaṃ viśpatiṃ saptaputram
sapta yuñjanti ratham ekacakram eko aśvo vahati saptanāmā trinābhi cakram ajaram anarvaṃ yasminn imā viśvā bhuvanāni tasthuḥ
imā ratham adhi ye sapta tasthuḥ saptacakraṃ sapta vahanty aśvāḥ sapta svāsaro abhi saṃ navanta yatra gavāṃ nihitā sapta nāmā
ko dadarśa prathamaṃ jāyamānam asthanvantaṃ yad anasthā bibharti bhūmyā asur asṛg ātmā kva svit ko vidvāṃsam upa gāt praṣṭum etat
pākaḥ pṛcchāmi manasāvijānan devānām enā nihitā padāni vatse baṣkaye 'dhi sapta tantūn vi tatnire kavaya otavā u
acikitvāṃś cikituṣaś cid atra kavīn pṛcchāmi vidmane na vidvān vi yas tastambha ṣaḍ imā rajāṃsy ajasya rūpe kim api svid ekam
iha bravītu ya īm aṅga veda asya vāmasya nihitaṃ padaṃ veḥ śīrṣṇaḥ kṣīraṃ duhrate gāvo asya vavriṃ vasānā udakaṃ padāpuḥ
mātā pitaram ṛta ā babhāja dhīty agre manasā saṃ hi jagme sā bībhatsur garbharasā nividdhā namasvanta id upavākam īyuḥ
yuktā mātāsīd dhuri dakṣiṇāyā atiṣṭhad garbho vṛjanīṣv antaḥ amīmed vatso anu gām apaśyad viśvarūpyaṃ triṣu yojaneṣu
tisro mātṝs trīn pitṝn bibhrad eka ūrdhvas tasthau nem ava glāpayanti mantrayante divo amuṣya pṛṣṭhe viśvavidaṃ vācam aviśvaminvām
dvādaśāraṃ nahi taj jarāya varvarti cakraṃ pari dyām ṛtasya ā putrā agne mithunāso atra sapta śatāni viṃśatiś ca tasthuḥ
pañcapādaṃ pitaraṃ dvādaśākṛtiṃ diva āhuḥ pare ardhe purīṣiṇam atheme anya upari vicakṣaṇaṃ saptacakre ṣaḍara āhur arpitam
pañcāre cakre parivartamāne tasminn ā tasthur bhuvanāni viśvā tasya nākṣas tapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanād eva na chidyate sanābhiḥ
sanemi cakram ajaraṃ vi vāvṛta uttānāyāṃ daśa yuktā vahanti sūryasya cakṣū rajasaity āvṛtaṃ yasminn ā viśvā bhuvanāny ārpitā
sākaṃjānāṃ saptatham āhur ekajaṃ ṣaḍ id yamā ṛṣayo devajā iti teṣām iṣṭāni vihitāni dhāmaśaḥ sthātre rejante vikṛtāni rūpaśaḥ
striyaḥ satīs tām̐ u me puṃsa āhuḥ paśyad akṣaṇvān na vi cetad andhaḥ kavir yaḥ putraḥ sa īm ā ciketa yas tā vijānāt sa pituṣ pitāsat
avaḥ pareṇa para enāvareṇa padā vatsaṃ bibhratī gaur ud asthāt sā kadrīcī kaṃ svid ardhaṃ parāgāt sā kva svit sūte nahi yūthe asmin
avaḥ pareṇa pitaraṃ yo asya anuveda para enāvareṇa kavīyamānaḥ ka iha pra vocad devaṃ manaḥ kuto adhi prajātam
ye arvāñcas tām̐ u parāca āhur ye parāñcas tām̐ u arvāca āhuḥ indraś ca yā cakrathuḥ soma tāni dhurā ni yuktā rajaso vahanti
dvā suparṇā sayujā sakhāyā samānaṃ vṛkṣaṃ pari ṣasvajāte tayor anyaḥ pippalaṃ svādv atty anaśnann anyo abhi cākaśīti
yasmin vṛkṣe madhvadaḥ suparṇā niviśante suvate cādhi viśve tasyed āhuḥ pippalaṃ svādv agre tan non naśad yaḥ pitaraṃ na veda
yatrā suparṇā amṛtasya bhakṣam animeṣaṃ vidathābhisvaranti ino viśvasya bhuvanasya gopāḥ sa mā dhīraḥ pākam atrā viveśa
yad gāyatre adhi gāyatram āhitaṃ traiṣṭubhād vā traiṣṭubhaṃ niratakṣata yad vā jagaj jagaty āhitaṃ padaṃ ya it tad vidus te amṛtatvam ānaśuḥ
gāyatreṇa prati mimīte arkam arkeṇa sāma traiṣṭubhena vākam vākena vākaṃ dvipadā catuṣpadā akṣareṇa mimate sapta vāṇīḥ
jagatā sindhuṃ divy askabhāyad rathantare sūryaṃ pary apaśyat gāyatrasya samidhas tisra āhus tato mahnā pra ririce mahitvā
upa hvaye sudughāṃ dhenum etāṃ suhasto godhug uta dohad enām śreṣṭhaṃ savaṃ savitā sāviṣan no 'bhīddho gharmas tad u ṣu pra vocam
hiṃkṛṇvatī vasupatnī vasūnāṃ vatsam icchantī manasābhy āgāt duhām aśvibhyāṃ payo aghnyeyaṃ sā vardhatāṃ mahate saubhagāya
gaur amīmed abhi vatsaṃ miṣantaṃ mūrdhānaṃ hiṅṅ akṛṇon mātavā u sṛkvāṇaṃ gharmam abhi vāvaśānā mimāti māyuṃ payate payobhiḥ
ayaṃ sa śiṅkte yena gaur abhīvṛtā mimāti māyuṃ dhvasanāv adhi śritā sā cittibhir ni cakāra martyaṃ vidyud bhavantī prati vavrim auhata
vidyud dadrāṇāṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe yuvānaṃ santaṃ palito jagāra devasya paśya kāvyaṃ mahitvādyā mamāra sa hyaḥ sam āna
anac chaye turagātu jīvam ejad dhruvaṃ madhya ā pastyānām jīvo mṛtasya carati svadhābhir amartyo martyenā sayoniḥ
apaśyaṃ gopām anipadyamānam ā ca parā ca pathibhiś carantam sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīr vasāna ā varīvarti bhuvaneṣv antaḥ
ya īṃ cakāra na so asya veda ya īṃ dadarśa hirug in na tasmāt sa mātur yonā parivīto antar bahuprajā nirṛtim ā viveśa
dyaur naḥ pitā janitā nābhir atra bandhur no mātā pṛthivī mahīyam uttānayoś camvor yonir antar atrā pitā duhitur garbham ādhāt
pṛcchāmi tvā param antaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi tvā bhuvanasya nābhim pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto vācaḥ pṛcchāmi paramaṃ vyoma
iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ yajño bhuvanasya nābhiḥ ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto brahmāyāṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma
saptārdhagarbhā bhuvanasya reto viṣṇos tiṣṭhanti pradiśo vidharmaṇi te dhītibhir manasā te vipaścitaḥ paribhuvaḥ pari bhavanti viśvataḥ
na vi jānāmi yad ivedam asmi niṇyaḥ sannaddho manasā carāmi yadā māgan prathamajā ṛtasya ād id vāco aśnuve bhāgam asyāḥ
apāṅ prāṅ eti svadhayā gṛbhīto 'martyo martyenā sayoniḥ tā śaśvantā viṣūcīnā viyantā ny anyaṃ cikyur na ci cikyur anyam
ṛco akṣare parame vyoman yasmin devā adhi viśve niṣeduḥ yas tan na veda kim ṛcā kariṣyati ya it tad vidus ta ime sam āsate
ṛcaḥ padaṃ mātrayā kalpayanto 'rdharcena cākl̥pur viśvam ejat tripād brahma pururūpaṃ vi caṣṭe tena jīvanti pradiśaś catasraḥ
sūyavasād bhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma addhi tṛṇam aghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddham udakam ācarantī
gaurīr mimāya salilāni takṣaty ekapadī dvipadī sā catuṣpadī aṣṭāpadī navapadī babhūvuṣī sahasrākṣarā bhuvanasya paṅktis tasyāḥ samudrā adhi vi kṣaranti
athāpād eti prathamā padvatīnāṃ kas tad vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā ciketa garbho bhāraṃ bharaty ā cid asya ṛtaṃ piparty anṛtaṃ ni pāti
kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ harayaḥ suparṇā apo vasānā divam ut patanti tā āvavṛtrant sadanād ṛtasya ād id ghṛtena pṛthivīṃ vy ūduḥ
dyaur javenā pṛthivī varimṇāntarikṣaṃ mahitvāpo bhūmnā devasya tvā savituḥ prasave 'śvinor bāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ prasūto brāhmaṇebhyo nir vapāmi
ṛṣibhyas tvā rṣeyebhyas tvā nir vapāmi
juṣṭatamaṃ vahnitamaṃ papritamaṃ sasnitamam ūrjo bhāgam akṣitam akṣitaye nir vapāmi
vasavas tvā gāyatreṇa chandasā nir vapantu
rudrās tvā traiṣṭubhena chandasā nir vapantu
ādityās tvā jāgatena chandasā nir vapantu
idam abhirāvṇām idam abhigatvarāṇām idam abhimanyūnām
yathā kūpaḥ śatakhāḥ sahasrakhā nopadasyati evedaṃ mopa dasat tīrtham aśvinor iva
yo no dveṣan manasā yaś ca vācā daivye loka uta mānuṣe yaḥ grāvṇā hantu mahatā tasya sarvam indro devo maghavāñ chacīpatiḥ
vīrutsu vastraṃ parijāyaitad ūrjā soma punar ā viśeha naḥ dṛṃhasva bāhvo amba dhṛṣva mā riṣo agniś caitat saniṣyatha
devīr āpa ūrjo bhāgāya vo 'kṣitā akṣitaya ā siñcāmi
akravyādā tanvā jātavedo yā te svargā tapasā sayoniḥ tayaudanam abhiśrāmyaitaṃ tayā no agne mahi śarma yaccha
somasyāṃśubhir yatam addhvam adityāḥ pṛṣṭhe sīdata ye ta odana devayāne loke viduḥ pātraṃ dārumayaṃ manuṣyāḥ teṣām edhi pātramātraḥ svargaḥ pṛthivīṃ vidma tava pātram
etās tvaudanopa yantv āpo ghṛtaścutaḥ payasā vardhayantīḥ stabhnāsi svaḥ pṛthivīm uta dyām utāntarikṣaṃ svadhayā pūrayāsi
yāvantās taṇḍulās ta rtasya viṣṭhās tāvanto yajñās ta rtasya dohāḥ tāvatī svadhā ghṛtapṛṣṭho me astu ūrjaṃ duhāṃ madhupṛcaṃ vyoman
yam odanaṃ pacāmi śraddadhānaḥ pātrīpūraṃ ghṛtapṛṣṭhaṃ juṣāṇaḥ sa me mā kṣeṣṭa sadam aśyamāno yamasya loke parame vyoman
odanaḥ pātreṇa saha dakṣiṇayā brāhmaṇebhyo datto amṛtatve dadhāti sūryasya dhrājīr anu raśmīn āgan divas pṛṣṭhān śakuna iva rohan
saṃ prāṇena prāṇabhṛtaṃ sṛjāmi saṃ vīryeṇa payasāśiṣā ca āstāvaṃ gaccha sukṛtāṃ yatra lokaṃ te tvā prāśnantu dakṣiṇato niṣadya
agniṣṭomena sarathaṃ hi yāhy athoktam atirātraṃ ca gaccha dvirātramātras tryahaṃ vy aśnuhy athā roha catūrātraṃ ratham iva
catūrātreṇa kalpamāno hi yāhy atha saptarātraṃ daśarātraṃ ca gaccha dvādaśāhaṃ paribhūya viśvata ekaviṃśatyā vi mṛdho nudasva
ekaviṃśatyā vi mṛdho hi yāhy athaikacatvāriṃśatopa yāhy ekam trayastriṃśatāmṛto bhūtvā trimāsyam odanānv ārabhasva
idāvatsaraṃ ca parivatsaraṃ ca bradhnasya viṣṭapi parame vyoman nākena nākam abhi saṃ bhavaudana
sādhyā nayantu mukhato mamaitam ādityā rudrā vasavaḥ sacetasaḥ viśve devā ṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānā imaṃ rakṣantu sadam apramādam
idāvatsaraṃ ca parivatsaraṃ ca saṃvatsaram ahorātrāṇi māsaḥ sūryasyāgneś candramaso 'nubhūtiṃ vātasyābhūtim anv ābhavaudana
yam īḍate pitaro yaṃ ca devāḥ purohitaṃ tapasā brahmaṇā ca svadhām ūrjam akṣitim ā juhomi vāte deve pavamāne bṛhaspatau
caturdhety odanaḥ kalpamāna ūrjā devān svadhā pitṝn śarīraṃ manuṣyān āśitaṃbhavo brāhmaṇān so 'smākam astu parame vyoman
ayaṃ panthā odana devayāno anāruddho mṛtyunā tena yāhi adabdhaḥ svato nihitaḥ sukṛdbhir brahmaṇā śiṣṭaḥ praśiṣā yamasya so 'smākam astu parame vyoman
yatra te gṛhā odana tat parehi yatrāpāṃ tad u gacchantv āpaḥ yatra yonim odanaṃ brāhmaṇā viduḥ so asmākam astu parame vyoman
hutaṃ te vāci hutam astu cakṣuṣi hutaṃ vijñāne hutam astu te bale śrotre prāṇe te hutaṃ prajāmṛtatve te hutaṃ kāme ca hutam astu te
yad vāgneyo yadi vāsyaindro yadi māruto yadi vaiśvadevaḥ yas te agnir nṛmaṇā nāma hṛdyas tasminn eṣa suhuto astv odanaḥ so asmākam astu parame vyoman
ya āviveśa nṛmaṇā manuṣyām̐ agnīnām agniḥ prathamo vayodhāḥ tasminn eṣaḥ
yā te tanūr apacakrāma mṛtyor devānāṃ sakhyam abhi jīvalokam apsucarā gahvareṣṭhā mahitvā tasyām eṣaḥ suhuto astv odanaḥ so asmākam astu parame vyoman
aheḍamānābhy ehi no gṛhaṃ saṃkāśaṃ bhadre sumanā aghorāḥ prati tvā varṣavṛddham etu
eṣā naḥ svadhā navagaj janitry amṛteṣv amṛtāhutābhūt tān no gopāya sadam apramādam āsmākam aitor anu rakṣa jāgṛhi
ye no nidhim abhidāsanty etaṃ pravāhaṃ proḍhaṃ yamarājye rājā teṣāṃ varuṇa indriyāṇy abhi tiṣṭḥatu harasā daivyena etaṃ sadhasthāḥ pari vo dadāmy anukhyātā yajñapatir yad āyat
ya ākhidanti vikhidanti dattaṃ vi gṛhṇate dakṣiṇā nīyamānāḥ tān indro devo maghavāñ chacīpatir agnimedī pradahann etu śakraḥ bṛhaspatir varuṇaḥ soma indro mamaiva dattaṃ kevalaṃ kṛṇvantu
śīrṣaktiṃ śīrṣāmayaṃ karṇaśūlaṃ tṛtīyakam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nirmantrayāmahe
karṇābhyāṃ te kaṅkūṣebhyaḥ śuktivalgaṃ vilohitam
yaḥ kṛṇoti pramotam andhaṃ kṛṇoti pūruṣam
yasya hetoḥ pracyavate yakṣmo nāsata āsyataḥ
śīrṣarogam aṅgarogaṃ viśvāṅgīnaṃ visalpakam sarvaṃ śīrṣaṇyaṃ te rogaṃ bahir nirmantrayamahe
yasya bhīmaḥ pratīkāśa udvepayati pūruṣam takmānaṃ śītaṃ rūraṃ ca taṃ te nir mantrayāmahe
ya ūrū anusarpaty atho ye 'nu gavīnike balāsam antar aṅgebhyo bahir nirmantrayāmahe
yadi kāmād apakāmād dhṛdayāj jāyate pari hṛdo balāsam aṅgebhyo bahir nirmantrayāmahe
harimāṇaṃ te aṅgebhyo yakṣmodhām antarātmanaḥ yakṣmaṃ te sarvam aṅgebhyo bahir nirmantrayāmahe
āso balāso bhavatu mūtraṃ bhavatv āmayat yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat
bahir bilaṃ nir dravatu kahāvāhaṃ tavodarāt yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat
udarāt te pari klomno nābhyā hṛdayād adhi yakṣmodhām antarātmano bahir nir mantrayāmahe
yāḥ sīmānaṃ virujanti mūrdhānaṃ pratyarṣaṇīḥ ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravanti bahir bilam
yā hṛdayam upasarpanty anutanvanti kīkasāḥ
yāḥ pārśve uparṣanty anunikṣanti pṛṣṭīḥ
yās tiraścīr uparṣanty arṣaṇīr vakṣaṇābhyaḥ
yā gudā anusarpanty āntrāṇi yopayanti ca
yā majjño anusarpanti parūṃṣi virujanti ca ahiṃsantīr anāmayā nir dravanti bahir bilam
ye aṅgāni madayanti yakṣmāso ropaṇāsaḥ yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat
visalpakasya vidradhasya vātīkārasya vālajeḥ yakṣmāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ viṣaṃ nir avocam ahaṃ tvat
pādābhyāṃ te kulphābhyāṃ jaṅgābhyāṃ jānubhyām ūrubhyāṃ śroṇibhyāṃ pari bhaṃsasaḥ anūkyād arṣaṇīr uṣṇihābhyo grīvābhyaḥ skandhebhyaś śīrṣṇo rogam anīnaśam
saṃ te śīrṣṇaḥ kapālāni hṛdayasya ca yo viduḥ udyan sūrya ādityo 'ṅgarogam anīnaśat
sapatnahanam ṛṣabhaṃ ghṛtena kāmaṃ śikṣāmi haviṣājyena nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādaya tvam abhiṣṭuto mahatā vīryeṇa
yan me manaso na priyaṃ na cakṣuṣo yan me hṛdaye nābhinandati tad duṣvapnyaṃ prati muñcāmi sapatne kāmaṃ tuṣṭuvān ud ahaṃ bhideyam
duṣvapnyaṃ kāma duritaṃ ca kāma aprajastām asvakṛtām avartim ugra īśānaḥ prati muñca tasmin yo asmabhyam aṃhūraṇā cikitsāt
sā te kāma duhitā dhenur ucyate yām āhur vācaṃ kavayo virājam tayā sapatnān pari vṛṅdhi ye mama pary enān prāṇaḥ prajāḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu
kāmasyendrasya varuṇasya rājño viṣṇor balena savituḥ savena agner hotreṇa pra ṇuda sapatnān śambīva nāvam udakeṣu dhīraḥ
adhyakṣo vājī mama kāma ugraḥ kṛṇotu mahyam asapatnam eva viśve devā mama nāthaṃ bhavantu sarve devā havam ā yantu ma imam
idam ājyaṃ ghṛtavaj juṣāṇāḥ kāmajyeṣṭhā iha mādayantām kṛṇvantu mahyam asapatnam eva
indrāgnī kāma sarathaṃ hi bhūtvā nīcaiḥ sapatnān mama pādayātha teṣāṃ pannānām adhamā tamāṃsy agne vāstūny anunirdahā tvam
jahi tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnā andhā tamāṃsy ava pādayainān anindriyā arasāḥ santu sarve yathā na jivāt katamac canaiṣām
avadhīt kāmo mama ye sapatnā uruṃ lokam akaran mahyam edhatum mahyaṃ namantāṃ pradiśaś catasro mahyaṃ ṣaḍ urvīr ghṛtam ā vahantu
yat te kāma śarma trivarūtham udbhid brahma varma vitatam anativyādhyaṃ kṛtam tena sapatnān pari vṛṅdhi ye mama pary enān prāṇaḥ prajāḥ paśavo jīvanaṃ vṛṇaktu
adharāñcaḥ pra plavantāṃ chinnā naur iva bandhanāt na sāyakapraṇuttānāṃ punar asti nivartanam
agnir yava indro yavaḥ somo yavaḥ yavayāvāno deva yāvayantv amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ jīvalokān mṛtalokaṃ gatāsum
asarvavīraś carati praṇutto mitrāṇāṃ dveṣyaḥ parivargyaḥ svānām uta pṛthivyām ava syanti vidyuta ugro devaḥ pra mṛṇat sapatnān
cyutā ceyaṃ bṛhaty acyutā ca vidyud bibharti stanayitnūṃś ca sarvān teṣām ādityo draviṇena tejasā udyan sapatnān nudatāṃ me sahasvān
yathā devā asurān prāṇudanta yena indro dasyūn adhamaṃ tamo babādhe tathā tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnās tān asmāl lokāt pra ṇudasva sarvān
yena devā asurān prāṇudanta viśvahā yenendro dasyūn adhamaṃ tamo babādhe tena tvaṃ kāma mama ye sapatnās tān asmāl lokāt pra ṇudasva dūram
kāmo jajñe prathamo nānyat purā nainaṃ devā āpuḥ pitaro nota martyāḥ tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nāma it kṛṇomi
na vai vātaś cana kāmam āpa nāgniḥ sūryo nota candramāḥ
na vā āpaś cana kāmam āpur nāhorātrāṇi vihitāni yanti
na vai puṇyajanāś cana kāmam āpur na gandharvāpsaraso na sarpāḥ tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
yāvatī dyāvāpṛthivī varimṇā yāvad āpaḥ siṣyadur yāvad agniḥ tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
yāvatīr diśaḥ pradiśo viṣūcīr yāvatīr āśā abhicakṣaṇā divaḥ tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
yāvatīr bhṛṅgā jatvaḥ kurūravo yāvatīr vaghā vṛkṣasarpyaḥ tatas tvam asi jyāyān viśvahā mahāṃs tasmai te kāma nama it kṛṇomi
yās te śivās taṇvas kāma bhadrā yābhiḥ satyaṃ bhavati yad vṛṇīte tābhiṣ ṭvam asmān upa saṃ viśasva anyatra pāpīr apa veśayā dhiyaḥ
yau te mātonmamārja jātāyāḥ pativedanau durṇāmā tatra mā gṛdhad aliṃśa uta vatsapaḥ
palālānupalālau śarkuṃ kokaṃ malimrucaṃ palījakam āśleṣaṃ vavrivāsasam ṛkṣagrīvaṃ pramīlinaṃ muṣkayor apa hanmasi
mā saṃ vṛto mopa sṛpa ūrū māva sṛpo 'ntarā kṛṇomy asyai bheṣajaṃ bajaṃ durṇāmacātanam
durṇāmā ca sunāmā ca ubhau saṃvṛtam icchataḥ arāyam apa hanmasi sunāmā straiṇam icchatām
yaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ keśy asura stambajā uta taṇḍikaḥ arāyān asyā bhaṃsaso muṣkayor apa hanmasi
anujighraṃ pramṛśantaṃ kravyādam uta reriham arāyaṃ śvakiṣkiṇaṃ bajaḥ piṅgo anīnaśat
yas tvā suptāṃ tsarati yaś ca dipsati jāgratīm chāyām iva pra tān sūryaḥ parikrāmam anīnaśat
yas tvā suptāṃ nipadyate bhrātā bhūtvā piteva ca bajas tvaṃ sahatām itaḥ klībarūpaṃ tirīṭinam
yaḥ kṛṇoty avatokāṃ mṛtavatsām imāṃ striyam tam oṣadhe tvaṃ nāśaya asyāḥ kamalam añjivam
ye śālāḥ parinṛtyanti sāyaṃ gardabhanādinaḥ kusūlā ye ca kukṣilāḥ kakubhāḥ saramāḥ sumāḥ tān oṣadhe tvaṃ gandhena viṣūcīnān vi nāśaya
ye kukundhāḥ kukūrabhāḥ kṛttīr dūrśāni bibhrati klībā iva pranṛtyanto ghoṣāṃ ye kurvate vane tān ito nāśayāmasi
yeṣāṃ paścāt prapade puraḥ pārṣṇī puro mukham khalajāḥ śakadhūmajā uruṇḍā ye ca maṭmaṭāḥ kumbhamuṣkā ayāśavaḥ tān asyā brahmaṇaspate pratībodhena nāśaya
ye sūryaṃ na titikṣanta ātapantam amuṃ divaḥ arāyān bastavāsino durgandhīṃl lohitāsyān makakān nāśayāmasi
ye sūryāt parisarpanti snuṣeva śvaśurād adhi bajaś ca teṣāṃ piṅgaś ca hṛdaye 'dhi ni vidhyatām
ya ātmānam atimātram aṃśa ādhāya bibhrati strīṇāṃ śroṇipratodina indra rakṣāṃsi nāśaya
ye pūrve vadhvo yanti haste śṛṅgāṇi bibhrataḥ āpākesthān prahāsina stambe ye kurvate jyotis tān ito nāśayāmasi
paryastākṣāḥ pracaṅkaśā straiṇāḥ santu paṇḍagāḥ ava bheṣaja pātaya ya imāṃ saṃvivṛtsaty apatiḥ svapatīṃ striyam
uddharṣiṇaṃ munikeśaṃ jambhayantaṃ marīmṛśam upeṣantam udumbalaṃ tuṇḍenam uta śāluḍam padā pra vidhya pārṣṇyā sthālīṃ gaur iva syandanā
yas te garbhaṃ pratimṛśāj jātaṃ vā mārayāti te piṅgas tam ugradhanvā kṛṇotu hṛdayāvidham
ye amno jātān mārayanti sūtikā anuśerate strībhāgān piṅgo gandharvān abhraṃ vāta ivājatu
pariśiṣṭaṃ dhārayataṃ yad dhitaṃ māva pādi tat garbhaṃ ta ugrau rakṣatāṃ bheṣajau nīvibhāryau
paripāṇaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ rakṣasām asi cātanam arāyān sarvān durṇāmno yātudhānān viṣūcīnān vi nāśaya
pavīnasāt taṅgalvāc chāyakād uta nagnakāt prajāyai patye tvā piṅgaḥ pari pātu kimīdinaḥ
dvyāsyāś caturakṣāḥ pañcapādād anaṅguleḥ vṛndād abhi prasarpataḥ pari pāhi varīvṛtāt
ya āmaṃ māṃsam adanti pauruṣeyaṃ ca ye kravir garbhān khādanti keśavāḥ arāyān asyā bhaṃsaso muṣkayor apa hanmasi
piṅga rakṣa jāyamānaṃ pumāṃsaṃ mā striyaṃ kran āṇḍādo garbhaṃ mā dabhan bādhasvetaḥ kimīdinaḥ
aprajāstvaṃ mārtavatsam ād rodam agham āvayam vṛkṣād iva srajaṃ kṛtvā apriye prati muñca tat
piṅga jahi yātudhānān durgandhīṃl lohitāsyān tvayā praṇuttāḥ kravyādo viṣvañco yantu nirhatāḥ
ucchiṣṭe nāmarūpāṇy ucchiṣṭe loka āhitaḥ ucchiṣṭa indraś cāgniś ca viśvam antaḥ samāhitam
ucchiṣṭe dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaṃ bhūtaṃ samāhitam āpaḥ samudra ucchiṣṭe candramā vāta āhitaḥ
sann ucchiṣṭe 'saṃś cobhau mṛtyur vājaḥ prajāpatiḥ laukyā ucchiṣṭa āyattā vraś ca draś cāpi śrīr mayi
dṛḍho dṛṃha sthiro nyo brahma viśvasṛjo daśa nābhim iva sarvataś cakram ucchiṣṭe devatā hitā
ṛk sāma yajur ucchiṣṭa udgīthaḥ prastutaṃ sthitam hiṅkāra ucchiṣṭe svaraḥ sāmno meḍiś ca tan mayi
aindrāgnaṃ pāvamānaṃ mahānāmnīr mahāvratam ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṅgāny antar garbha iva mātari
rājasūyaṃ vājapeyam agniṣṭomas tadadhvaraḥ arkāśvamedhā ucchiṣṭe jīvabarhir madintamaḥ
agnyādheyam atho dīkṣā kāmapraś chandasā saha utsannā yajñāḥ sattrāṇy ucchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ
agnihotraṃ ca śraddhā ca vaṣaṭkāro vrataṃ tapaḥ dakṣiṇeṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ ca ucchiṣṭe 'dhi samāhitāḥ
ekarātras trirātraś ca sadyaḥkrīḥ prakrīr ukthyaḥ otaṃ nihitam ucchiṣṭe yajñasyāṇūni vidyayā
catūrātraḥ pañcarātraḥ ṣaḍrātraś cobhayaḥ saha ṣoḍaśī saptarātraś ca ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve ye yajñā amṛte hitāḥ
pratihāro nidhanaṃ viśvajic cābhijic ca yaḥ sāhnātirātrā ucchiṣṭe dvādaśāho 'pi tan mayi
sūnṛtā saṃnatiḥ kṣemaḥ svadhorjāmṛtaṃ sahaḥ ucchiṣṭe sarve pratyañcaḥ kāmāḥ kāmena tṛpyantu
nava bhūmīḥ samudrāś ca ucchiṣṭe 'dhi śritā divaḥ ā sūryo bhāty ucchiṣṭe ahorātre ca tan mayi
upahavyaṃ viṣūvantaṃ ye ca yajñā guhā hitāḥ bibharti bhartā viśvasya ucchiṣṭo janituḥ pitā
pitā janitur ucchiṣṭo asoḥ pautraḥ pitāmahaḥ sa khyeti viśvasyeśāno vṛṣā bhūmyām atighnyaḥ
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ tapo dīkṣā śramo dharmaś ca karma ca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyad ucchiṣṭe vīryaṃ lakṣmīr balaṃ bale
samṛddhir oja ākutiḥ kṣatraṃ rāṣṭraṃ ṣaḍ urvyaḥ saṃvatsaro 'dhy ucchiṣṭa iḍā praiṣā grahā haviḥ
caturhotāra āpriyaś caturmāsyāni nividaḥ ucchiṣṭe yajñā hotrāś ca paśubandhās tad iṣṭayaḥ
ardhamāsāś ca māsāś ca ārtava ṛtubhiḥ saha ucchiṣṭe ghoṣiṇīr āpaḥ stanayitnuḥ śrutir mahī
śarkarāḥ sikatā aśmāna oṣadhayo vīrudhas tṛṇā abhrāṇi vidyuto varṣam ucchiṣṭe saṃśritā śritā
rāddhiḥ prāptir vyāptiḥ samāptir maha edhatuḥ atyāptir ucchiṣṭe bhūtir āhitā nihitā hitā
yac ca prāṇati prāṇena yac ca paśyati cakṣuṣā ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ
prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotram akṣitiś ca kṣitiś ca yā
devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā gandharvāpasaraś ca ye
ṛcaḥ sāmāni chandāṃsi purāṇaṃ yajuṣā saha
atharvāṅgiraso brahma sarpapuṇyajanāś ca ye
ānandāś ca pramodāś ca abhīmodamudaś ca ye ucchiṣṭāj jajñire sarve divi devā diviśritaḥ
yan manyur jāyām āvahat saṃkalpasya gṛhād adhi ka āsañ janyāḥ ke varāḥ ka u jyeṣṭhavaro 'bhavat
tapaś caivāstāṃ karma ca antar mahaty arṇave ta āsan janyās te varāḥ sa u jyeṣṭhavaro 'bhavat
daśa sākam ajāyanta devā devebhyaḥ paraḥ yo vai tāṃ vidyān nāmathā sa vā adya mahad vadet
prāṇāpāṇau cakṣuḥ śrotram akṣitiś ca kṣitiś ca yā vyānodāno vāṅ manas te vā ākūtim ā vahan
ajātā āsann ṛtavo 'tho dhātā bṛhaspatiḥ indrāgnī aśvinā tarhi kaṃ te jyeṣṭham upāsata
tapaś caivāstāṃ karma ca antar mahaty arṇave tapo ha jajñe karmaṇas taṃ te jyeṣṭham upāsata
kuta indraḥ kutaḥ somaḥ kuto agnir ajāyata kutas tvaṣṭā sam abhavad dhātā sam abhavat kutaḥ
indrād indraḥ somāt somo agner agnir ajāyata tvaṣṭā ha jajñe tvaṣṭur dhātā dhātur ajāyata
ye ta āsan daśa jātā devā devebhyaḥ paraḥ putrebhyo lokaṃ dattvā kasmin te loka āsate
yeto bhūmiḥ purvāsīd yām addhātaya id viduḥ ke tasyāṃ devā āsate kasminn u sādhiśritā
kutaḥ keśān kutaḥ snāva kuto asthīny ābharat aṅgā parvāṇi majjānaṃ ko māṃsaṃ kuta ābharat
yadā keśān asthi snāva māṃsaṃ majjānam ābharat śarīraṃ kṛtvā pādavat kaṃ lokam anu prāviśat
saṃsico nāma te devā ye saṃbhāraiḥ samabharan sarvaṃ saṃsicya martyaṃ devāḥ puruṣam āviśan
śiro hastāv atho bāhū jihvāṃ grīvāś ca kīkasāḥ pṛṣṭīr barjahye pārśve kas tat sam adadhād ṛṣiḥ
ūrū pādāv aṣṭhīvantau śroṇī hastāv atho mukham tvacā prāvṛtya tat sarvaṃ saṃdhā sam adadhān mahī
yat tac charīram apayat saṃdhayā saṃhitaṃ mahat yenedam adya rocate ko asmin varṇam ābharat
sarve devā upāśikṣan tad u jānād vadhūḥ satī īśā vaśasya yā jāyā sāsmin varṇam ābharat
yadā tvaṣṭā vyatṛṇat pitā tvaṣṭur ya uttaraḥ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā martyaṃ devāḥ puruṣam āviśan
svapno vai tandrīr nirṛtiḥ pāpmāno nāma devatāḥ jarā khālityaṃ pālityaṃ śarīram anu prāviśan
steyaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vṛjinaṃ satyaṃ yajño yaśo mahaḥ balaṃ ca kṣatram ojaś ca śarīram anu prāviśan
bhūtiś ca vā abhūtiś ca rātayo 'rātayaś ca yāḥ kṣudhaś ca sarvās tṛṣṇāś ca śarīram anu prāviśan
nindyāś ca vā anindyāś ca yaś ca hanteti neti ca śarīraṃ śraddhā dakṣiṇā aśraddhā cānu prāviśan
vidyāś ca vā avidyāś ca yac cānyad upadeśyam śarīraṃ brahma prāviśad ṛcaḥ sāmātho yajuḥ
ānandā nandāḥ pramudo 'bhīmodamudaś ca ye haso nariṣṭā nṛttāni śarīram anu prāviśan
ālāpāś ca pralāpāś ca abhīlāpalapaś ca ye śarīraṃ sarve prāviśann āyujaḥ prayujo yujaḥ
prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotram akṣitiś ca kṣitiś ca yā vyānodānau vāṅ manaḥ śarīrena ta īyante
āśiṣaś ca praśiṣaś ca saṃśiṣo viśiṣaś ca yāḥ cittāni sarve saṃkalpāḥ śarīram anu prāviśan
tvarāś ca vai dhṛtayaś ca īḍāśīḥ sūnṛterā śarīraṃ sarve prāviśann ṛtarīrṣyāyudho mṛdhaḥ
āsneyīś ca vāsteyīś ca tvaraṇāḥ kṛpaṇāś ca yāḥ guhyāḥ śukriyā yā sthūlā bībhatsur asādhayan
asthi kṛtvā samidhaṃ tad aṣṭāpo asādayan retaḥ kṛtvājyaṃ devāḥ puruṣam āviśan
yā āpo yāś ca devatā yā virāḍ brahmaṇā saha śarīraṃ brahma prāviśac charīre 'dhi prajāpatiḥ
sūryaś cakṣur vātaḥ prāṇaṃ puruṣasya vi bhejire athāsyetaram ātmānaṃ devāḥ prāyacchann agnaye
tasmād vai vidvān puruṣam idaṃ brahmeti manyate sarvā hy asmin devatāḥ śarīre 'dhi samāhitāḥ
yadaibhya sthānam aṅgeṣu pitā lokām̐ akalpayat śarīraṃ sarvā devatā yathāṅgam anu prāviśan
aṅgamaṅgaṃ śarīrasya sarve devā anu prāviśan pitā hy ebhyaḥ prāyacchat taṃ lokam aparājitam
taṃ lokam aparājitaṃ sarve devā anu prāviśan prajāpatir yam ābharac charīraṃ bahudhā hitam
agne jāyasvāditir nāthiteyaṃ brahmaudanaṃ pacati putrakāmā saptaṛṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvā manthantu prajayā saheha
kṛṇuta dhūmaṃ vṛṣaṇaḥ sakhāyo 'droghāvitā vācam accha ayam agniḥ pṛtanāṣāṭ suvīro yena devā asahanta śatrūn
agne 'janiṣṭhā mahate vīryāya brahmaudanāya paktave jātavedaḥ saptarṣayo bhūtakṛtas te tvājījanann asmai rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yaccha
samiddho agne samidhā samidhyase viśvān devān yajñiyām̐ eha vakṣaḥ tebhyo havyaṃ śrapayañ jātavedaḥ svargaṃ lokam adhi rohayainam
tredhā bhāgo nihito jātavedo yaḥ puro vo devānāṃ pitṝṇām uta martyānām aṃśāṃ jānīdhvaṃ vi bhajāmi taṃ vo yo devānāṃ sā imaṃ pārayāti
agne sahasvān abhibhūr abhīd asi nīco nyubja dviṣataḥ sapatnān iyaṃ mātrā mīyamānā mitā ca sajātāṃs te balihṛtaḥ kṛṇotu
sākaṃ sajātaiḥ payasā sahaidhy ud ubjainaṃ mahate vīryāya ūrdhvo nākasyādhi roha viṣṭapaḥ svargo loka iti yaṃ vadanti

uruḥ kośo vasudhānas tavāyaṃ yasminn imā viśvā bhūtāny antaḥ sa no mṛḍa paśupate namas te paraḥ kroṣṭāro abhibhāḥ śvānaḥ paro yantv agharudo vikeśyaḥ
dhanur bibharṣi haritaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ sahasraghni śatavadhaṃ śikhaṇḍin rudrasyeṣuś carati devahetis tasmai namo yatamasyāṃ diśītaḥ
yo 'bhiyāto nilayate tvām ugra nicikīrṣati paścād anuprayuṅkṣe taṃ viddhasya padanīr iva
bhavārudrau sayujā saṃvidānāv ubhā ugrau carato vīryāya tayor bhūmir antarikṣaṃ svar dyaus tābhyāṃ namo bhavamatyāya kṛṇmaḥ
namas te astv āyate namo astu parāyate namas te rudra tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ
namaḥ sāyaṃ namaḥ prātar namo rātryā namo divā bhavāya ca śarvāya ca ubhābhyām akaraṃ namaḥ
sahasrākṣam atipaśyaṃ purastād rudram asyantaṃ bahudhā vipaścitam mopārāma jihvayeyamānam
śyāvāsvāṃ kṛṣṇam asitaṃ mṛṇantaṃ bhīmaṃ rathaṃ keśinaḥ pādayantam pūrve pratīmo namo astv asmai
mā no 'bhi srā matyaṃ devahetiṃ mā naḥ krudhaḥ paśupate namas te anyatrāsmad divyāṃ śākhāṃ vi dhūnu
mā no hiṃsīr adhi brūhi pari ṇo vṛṅdhi mā krudha mā tvayā sam arāmahi
mā no aśveṣu goṣu puruṣeṣu mā gṛdho no ajāviṣu anyatrogra vi vartaya piyārūṇāṃ prajāṃ jahi
yasya takmā kāsikā hetir ekā aśvasyeva vṛṣaṇaḥ kranda eti abhipūrvaṃ nirṇayate namo astv asmai
yas tiṣṭhati viṣṭabhito antarikṣe 'yajvanaḥ pramṛṇan devapīyūn tasmai namo daśabhiḥ śakvarībhiḥ
tubhyam āraṇyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitās tubhyaṃ vayāṃsi śakunāḥ patatriṇaḥ tava yakṣmaṃ paśupate apsv antas tubhyaṃ kṣaranti divyā āpo vṛdhe
śiṃśumārā ajagarāḥ pulīkayā jaṣā matsyā rajasā yebhyo asyasi na te dūraṃ na pariṣṭha asti te bhava sadyaḥ sarvāṃ pari paśyasi bhūmim
pūrvasmād dhaṃsy uttarasmin samudre mā no rudra takmanā na viṣeṇa mā naḥ saṃ srā divyenāgninā anyatrāsmad vidyutāṃ pātayaitām
bhavo divo bhava īśe pṛthivyā bhava ā papra urv antarikṣam tasya na prāpad ducchunā kā caneha
bhava rājan yajamānāya mṛḍa paśūnāṃ hi paśupatir babhūtha yaḥ śraddadhāti santi devā iti catuṣpade dvipade asya mṛḍa
mā no mahāntam uta mā no arbhakaṃ mā naḥ kṣiyantam uta mā no akṣitaḥ mā no hiṃsīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ svāṃ tanvaṃ rudra mā rīriṣo naḥ
rudrasyailabakārebhyo 'saṃsūktagirebhyaḥ idaṃ mahāsyebhyaḥ śvabhyo akaraṃ namaḥ
namas te ghoṣiṇībhyo namas te keśinībhyaḥ namaḥ saṃyatībhyo namo namasvatībhyaḥ
namas te jāyamānāyai jātāyā uta te namaḥ bālebhyaḥ śaphebhyo rūpāyāghnye te namaḥ
yo vidyāt sapta pravataḥ sapta vidyāt parāvataḥ śiro yajñasya yo vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt
vedāhaṃ sapta pravataḥ sapta veda parāvataḥ śiro yajñasyāhaṃ veda somaṃ cāsyāṃ vicakṣaṇam
yayā dyaur yayā pṛthivī yayāpo gupitā imāḥ vaśāṃ sahasradhārāṃ brahmaṇācchā vadāmasi
śataṃ vatsāḥ śataṃ dogdhāraḥ śataṃ goptāro adhi pṛṣṭhe asyāḥ ye devās tasyāṃ prāṇanti te vaśāṃ vidur ekadhā
yajñapadīrākṣīrā svadhāprāṇā mahīlukā vaśā parjanyapatnī devām̐ apyeti brahmaṇā
anu tvāgniḥ prāviśad anu somo vaśe tvā ūdhas te bhadre parjanyo vidyutas te stanā vaśe
apas tvaṃ dhukṣe prathamā urvarā aparā vaśe tṛtīyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ dhukṣe annaṃ kṣīraṃ vaśe tvam
yad ādityair hūyamānā upatiṣṭha ṛtāvari indraḥ sahasraṃ pātraiḥ somaṃ tvāpāyayad vaśe
yad anūcīndram air āt tva ṛṣabho 'hvayat tasmāt te vṛtrahā payaḥ kṣīraṃ kruddho 'bharad vaśe
yat te kruddho dhanapatiḥ kṣīraṃ te abharad vaśe idaṃ tad adya nākas triṣu pātreṣu rakṣati
triṣu pātreṣu taṃ somam ā devy abharad vaśā atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣy āsta hiraṇyaye
saṃ hi somenāgata sam u sarveṇa padvatā vaśā samudre prānartīd ṛcaḥ sāmāni bibhratī
saṃ hi sūryeṇāgata sam u sarveṇa cakṣuṣā vaśā samudram aty aṣṭhād gandharvaiḥ kalibhiḥ saha
saṃ hi vātenāgata sam u sarvaiḥ patatribhiḥ vaśā samudram aty akhyad bhadrā jyotīṃṣi bibhratī
tad bhadrāḥ sam agacchanta vaśā deṣṭry atho svadhā atharvā yatra dīkṣito barhiṣy āsta hiraṇyaye
abhīvṛtā hiraṇyena yad atiṣṭha ṛtāvari aśvaḥ samudro bhūtvā adhy askandad vaśe tvā
vaśā mātā rājanyasya vaśā mātā svadhe tava vaśāyā jajña āyudhaṃ tataś cittam ajāyata
ūrdhvo bindur ud acarad brahmaṇaḥ kakudād adhi tatas tvaṃ jajñiṣe vaśe tato hotā ajāyata
āsnas te gāthā bhavantu uṣṇihābhyo balaṃ tava pājasyāj jajñe te yajña stanebhyo raśmayo vaśe
īrmābhyām ayanaṃ jātaṃ sakthibhyāṃ ca vaśe tava āntrebhyo atrā jajñira udarād adhi vīrudhaḥ
yad udaraṃ varuṇasya anu prāviśathā vaśe tatas tvā brahmodahvayat sa hi netram avet tava
sarve garbhād avepanta jāyamānād asūsvaḥ sasūva hi tām āhur vaśeti brahmaṇā kl̥pta uta bandhur asyāḥ
yudha ekaḥ saṃ sṛjati yo asyā eka id vaśī tarāṃsi yajñā abhavan tarasāṃ cakṣur abhavad vaśā
vaśā sūryaṃ praty agṛhṇād vaśā yajñam adhārayat vaśāyām antar āviśad odano brahmaṇā saha
vaśām evāhur amṛtaṃ vaśāṃ mṛtyum upāsate vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad devā manuṣyā asurāḥ pitara ṛṣayaḥ
ya evaṃ vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt tathā hi yajñaḥ sarvapād duhe dātre anapasphuran
tisro jihvā varuṇasya antar didyaty āsani tāsāṃ yā madhye rājati sa vaśā duṣpratigrahā
caturdhā reto abhavad vaśāyā apas turīyam amṛtaṃ turīyaṃ yajñas turīyaṃ paśavas turīyam ya evaṃ vidyāt sa vaśāṃ prati gṛhṇīyāt
vaśā dyaur vaśā pṛthivī vaśā viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ vaśāyā dugdham apiban sādhyā vasavaś ca ye
vaśāyā dugdhaṃ pītvā sādhyā vasavaś ca ye amī bradhnasya viṣṭapi payo asyā upāsate
somam enām eke duhre ghṛtam eka upāsate ya evaṃ viduṣe vaśāṃ dadus te gatās tridivaṃ divaḥ
vaśāṃ dattvā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sarvāṃl lokān sam aśnute ṛtaṃ hy asyām āhitam api brahmātho tapaḥ
vaśāṃ devā upa jīvanti vaśāṃ manuṣyā uta vaśedaṃ sarvam abhavad yāvat sūryo vipaśyati
yo vā ekaṃ brahmānuṣṭhyā vidyāt sa vā adya mahad vadet parūṃṣi yasya saṃbhārā ṛco yasyānūkyam
chandāṃsi yasya lomāni paristaraṇam id dhavir yajur hṛdayam ucyate
yad atithipatir atithīn pratipaśyati devayajanaṃ prekṣate
yad abhivadati dīkṣām upaiti yad udakaṃ yācaty apaḥ pra ṇayati yā yajñā apaḥ praṇīyante tā eva tāḥ
yat tarpaṇam āharanti yo 'gnīṣomīyaḥ paśur badhyate sa eva saḥ
yat khātam āharanti puroḍāśā eva tau yad āvasathān kalpayanti sadohavirdhānāny eva tat kalpayanti
yad upastṛṇanti barhir eva tat
yat kaśipūpabarhaṇāny āharanti paridhaya eva te yad upariśayanam āharanti svargam eva tena lokam ava rundhe
yad abhyañjanam āharanty ājyam eva tat yad aśanakṛtaṃ hvayanti haviṣkṛtam eva tad u hvayanti yad vrīhayo yad yavā nirupyante aṃśava eva te ny upyante
ulūkhalaṃ musalaṃ grāvāṇau śūrpaṃ pavitraṃ tūṣā ṛjīṣaḥ srug darvir mekṣaṇam āyavanam āpo 'bhiṣavaṇī yad droṇakalaśaḥ kumbhī
idam eva kṛṣṇājinaṃ vāyavyāni pātrāṇi yajamānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vā etad atithipatiḥ kṛṇute yad āhāryāṇy avekṣata idaṃ bhūyā idām iti
yad āha bhūya uddhareti prajāṃ caiva tena paśūṃś ca vardhayate prāṇam eva tena varṣīyāṃsaṃ kṛṇute yat saṃpṛcchati kāmam eva tenāva rundhe kāmaṃ hi pṛṣṭo yācati
yad udakam abhiṣiñcaty apa eva tenāva rundhe yad upaharati havīṃṣy ā sādayati
teṣām āsannānām atithir ātmani juhoti srukkāreṇa vaṣatkāreṇa srucā hastena prāṇe yūpe
tasmān na dviṣann adyān na dviṣato 'nnam adyān na mīmāṃsitasya na mīmāṃsyamānasya
sarvo vā eṣo jagdhapāpmā yasyānnam aśnanti
sarva u eṣo 'jagdhapāpmā yasyānnaṃ nāśnanti
prajāpater vā eṣa vikrāntam anuvikrame ya upaharanti
prajāpatyo vā etasyaiva yajño vitato ya upaharati
sarvadā vā eṣa sutasomo yuktagrāvārdrapavitra āhṛtayajñakratur vitatādhavaro ya upaharati
yo 'tithīnāṃ sa āhavanīyo yo 'nnakaraṇaḥ sa dakṣiṇāgnir yo veśmani sa gārhapatyaḥ
iṣṭaṃ ca vā eṣa pūrtaṃ cāśnāti yaḥ pūrvo 'tither aśnāti
prajāṃ ca vā eṣa paśūṃś cāśnāti
ūrjaṃ ca vā eṣa payaś ca gṛhāṇām aśnāti yaḥ pūrvo 'tither aśnāti
eṣa vā atithir yac chrotriyaḥ
tasmāt pūrvo nāśnīyād aśitāvaty aśnīyāt tad vratam
yajñasyāvicchedāya yajñasya guptaye yajñasya sātmatvāya
yat kṣīram upasicyopaharati yāvad agniṣṭomea samṛddheneṣṭvāvarundhe tāvad enenāva rundhe
yat sarpir upasicyopaharati yāvat sāhnena samṛddhena
yan madhūpasicyopaharati yāvad atirātreṇa samṛddhena
yan māṃsam upasicyopaharati yāvad dvādaśāhnena samṛddheneṣṭvāvarundhe tāvad enenāva rundhe
yad udakam upasicyopaharati prajānāṃ prajananāya jyog jīvati sarvam āyur eti na punar ā jarasaḥ pramīyate ya evaṃ veda
tasmai vāta uṣā hiṅ kṛṇoti savitā bhūtyā pra stauti bṛhaspatir ūrjayodgāyati tvaṣṭā puṣṭyā prati harati viśve devā nidhanam nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
tasmā udyant sūryo hiṅkṛṇoti saṃgavaḥ pra stauti madhyandina udgāyaty aparāhṇaḥ prati haraty astaṃyan nidhanam
tasmā abhro bhavan hiṅ kṛṇoti vidyotamānaḥ pra stauti stanayann udgāyati varṣan prati haraty udgṛhṇan nidhanam
atithīn prati paśyati hiṅ kṛṇoty abhi vadati pra stauty udakaṃ yācaty udgāyaty upa harati prati haraty ucchiṣṭaṃ nidhanam nidhanaṃ bhūtyāḥ prajāyāḥ paśūnāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
ete vai priyāś cāpriyāś ca rtvijaḥ svargaṃ lokaṃ gamayanti yad atithayaḥ
yat kṣattāraṃ hvayaty ā śrāvayati yat pratiśṛṇoti praty ā śrāvayati
yat pariveṣṭāra āvasathān prapadyante camasādhvaryava eva te teṣāṃ naikaś canāhotā
yat prātar upaharati prātaḥsavanam eva tat
yad dīvopaharati mādhyaṃdinam eva tat savanam
yat sāyam upaharati tṛtīyasavanam eva tat
yad atithipatir atithīn pariviṣyāsanaṃ yācate avabhṛtham eva tad upāvaiti
yat sabhāgayati dakṣiṇām eva tat sabhāgayati yad anutiṣṭhaty udavasyaty eva tat
sa upahūtaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yat pṛthivyāṃ viśvarūpam pṛthivyāṃ tapati pṛthivyām ā bhāti svargaloko bhavati ya evaṃ veda
sa upahūto antarikṣe bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad antarikṣe viśvarūpam antarikṣe tapaty antarikṣa ā bhāti
sa upahūto divi bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad divi viśvarūpam divi tapati divy ā bhāti
sa upahūto deveṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yad deveṣu viśvarūpam deveṣu tapati deveṣv ā bhāti
sa upahūto lokeṣu bhakṣayaty upahūtas tasmin yal lokeṣu viśvarūpam lokeṣu tapati lokeṣv ā bhāti svargaloko bhavati ya evaṃ veda
yat prāṅ āsīno virvapati yajñāya ca devebhyaś cā vṛścate
yad dakṣiṇāsīno nirvapati yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate
yat pratyaṅ āsīno nirvapati varuṇāyāpsuṣada ā vṛścate
yad udaṅ āsīno nirvapati somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cāvṛścate
yad upasthaṃ kṛtvāsīno nirvapati vāyave cāntarikṣāya cā vṛścate
yad ūrdhvas tiṣṭhan nirvapati dive cādityāya cāvṛścate
yaṃ kāmayeta pāpīyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupyaivam evānu nirvapet tadaiva sa pāpīyān ātmanā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati idamidaṃ kuryāt sā prāyaścītiḥ
yaṃ kāmayeta na vasīyān na śreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupayaivam evānu nirvapet tadaiva sa na vasīyān na śreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati idamidaṃ kuryāt sa prāyaścittiḥ
yaṃ kāmayeta vasīyāñ chreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena syād iti tasyaivaṃ nir vapet tasyaivaṃ nirupyaivam evānu nirvapet tadaiva sa vasīyāñ chreyān ātmanā prajayā paśubhir gṛhair dhanena bhavati idamidaṃ kuryāt sā prāyaścittiḥ
yad avahanyamānasya taṇḍula skandati samāṃsamāmasya varaḥ pramāyuko bhavati
yad ayastā bhavati pitṛdevatyaṃ karoti
yad viṣyandate gṛhāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca payo vi ṣyandate
yad apasiñcati gṛhāṇāṃ ca paśūnāṃ ca payo 'pa siñcati
yad āyavanī śīryate gṛhapatir mriyate
yad darviḥ śīryate gṛhapatnī mriyate
yat kumbhī vikasati sarvajyānir dātā ca pratigṛhītā ca jīyete
yat prāñcam udvartayati yajñāya ca devebhyaś cā vṛścate
yad dakṣiṇāñcam udvartayati yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate
yat pratyañcam udvartayati varuṇāyāpsuṣada ā vṛścate
yad udañcam udvartayati somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cā vṛścate
yad anuvṛttam uddharati diśodiśa evainaṃ bhayam ā gacchati
yat prācīnaṃ barhi stṛṇāti yajñāya ca devebhyaś cā vṛścate
yad dakṣiṇācīnaṃ barhi stṛṇāti yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate
yat pratīcīnaṃ barhi stṛṇāty akṛtapūrvaṃ karoti
yad udīcīnaṃ barhi stṛṇāti somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cā vṛścate
yat purastāt pātrasya tsaruṃ karoty arśaḥ pratigrahītur mukhe jāyate
yad dakṣiṇataḥ pātrasya tsaruṃ karoti yamāya ca pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate
yat paścāt pātrasya tsaruṃ karoti pratīcī pratigrahītāraṃ śaravya rcchati
yad uttarataḥ pātrasya tsaruṃ karoti somāya ca rājñe saptaṛṣibhyaś cā vṛścate
yac chukro bhavaty ādityānām eva priyaṃ dhāmopaiti sa yaḥ śukraṃ prāśnīyād ādityānāṃ tvā priyeṇa dhāmnā prāśnāmīty enaṃ prāśnīyāt tataś cainam anyena dhāmnā prāśnāty ādityebhyaś cā vṛścate
yat phalīkṛto bhavati viśveṣām eva devānāṃ priyaṃ sa yaḥ phalīkṛtaṃ prāśnīyād viśveṣāṃ tvā devānāṃ priyeṇa dhāmnā prāśnāti viśvebhyo devebhyaś cā vṛścate
yad aphalīkṛto bhavati marutām eva priyaṃ sa yo 'phalīkṛtaṃ prāśnīyān marutāṃ tvā priyeṇa prāśnāti marudbhyaś cā vṛścate
yad avakṣāmo bhavaty agner eva sa yo 'vakṣāmaṃ prāśnīyād agnes tvā priyeṇa prāśnāty agnaye cā vṛścate
yad anavakṣāmo bhavati mitrāvaruṇayor eva sa yo 'navakṣāmaṃ prāśnīyān mitrāvaruṇayos tvā priyeṇa prāśnāti mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ cā vṛścate
yad aklinno bhavati indrasyaiva sa yo 'klinnaṃ prāśnīyād indrasya tvā prāśnāti indrāya cā vṛścate
yat klinno bhavati pitṝṇām eva sa yaḥ klinnaṃ prāśnīyāt pitṝṇāṃ tvā prāśnāti pitṛbhyaś cā vṛścate
yat kṣudro bhavaty apām eva sa yaḥ kṣudraṃ prāśnīyād apāṃ tvā priyeṇa prāśnāty adbhyaś cā vṛścate
yac chithiro bhavati diśām eva sa yaḥ śithiraṃ prāśnīyād diśāṃ tvā prāśnāti digbhyaś cā vṛścate
yad gulantī bhavati prajāpater eva sa yo gulantinaṃ prāśnīyāt prajāpateṣ ṭvā prāśnāti prajāpataye cā vṛścate
yac chuṣko bhavaty ūrdhvanabhasa eva priyaṃ dhāmopaiti sa yaḥ śuṣkaṃ prāśnīyād ūrdhvanabhasas tvā priyeṇa dhāmnā prāśnāmīty enaṃ prāśnīyāt tataś cainam anyena dhāmnā prāśnāty ūrdhvanabhase cā vṛścate
yat kṣīram upasicya prathamaṃ prāśnāti kilāsaḥ pratigrahītā bhavati
yat sarpir upasicya prathamaṃ prāśnāti sarpaḥ pratigrahītāraṃ hanti
yan madhūpasicya prathamaṃ prāśnāti mahādevaḥ pratigrahītāraṃ hanti

ārtir aśyamānā vīkarto aśitā aśitā lokāc chinatti brahmacārī brahmajyam asmāc cāmuṣmāc ca
tasyā āhananaṃ kṛtyā menir āśasanaṃ valaga ūbadhyam asvagatā parihvṛtā agniḥ kravyād bhūtvā brahmagavī brahmajyaṃ praviśyātti
sarvāsyāṅgāni mūlāni vṛścati chinatty asya pitṛbandhūn parā bhāvayati mātṛbandhūn vivāhāṃ jñātīn sarvān api kṣāpayati brahmagavī kṣatriyasyāpunardīyamānā
avāstum enam asvagam aprajasaṃ karoty aparāparaṇo bhavati kṣīyate ya evaṃ viduṣo brāhmaṇasya kṣatriyo gām ādatte
kṣipraṃ vai tasyāhanane gṛdhrāḥ kurvata ailavam tasyādahanaṃ pari nṛtyanti keśinīr āghnānāḥ pāṇinorasi kurvāṇāḥ pāpam ailavam
tasya vāstuṣu gaṅgaṇaṃ kurvate vṛkāḥ kṣipraṃ vai tasya pṛcchanti yat tad āsīd idaṃ nu tāt
chindhy ā chindhi pra chindhy api kṣāpaya kṣāpaya ādadānam āṅgirasi brahmajyam upa dāsaya
vaiśvadevī hy ucyase kṛtyā kūlbajām āvṛtā oṣantī samoṣantī brahmaṇo vajraḥ
kṣurapavir mṛtyur bhūtvāpidhāvitaḥ ā datse jinatāṃ varca iṣṭaṃ pūrtaṃ cāśiṣaḥ
ādāya jītaṃ jītāya loke 'muṣmin pra yacchasi aghnye padavīr bhava brāhmaṇasyābhiśastyā
meniḥ śaravyā bhavāghād aghaviṣā bhava agnhye pra śiro jahi brahmajyasya kṛtāgasaḥ

yat te śīrṣaṇi daurbhāgyaṃ saktaṃ keśeṣu nihitaṃ lalāṭe ayaṃ tad viśvabheṣajo apāmārgo 'pa lumpatu

yā te kā ca pāpī lakṣmīr atho yā te apaśutā ayaṃ tad viśvabheṣajo apāmārgo 'pa lumpatu
kaṇṭhadaghnām ahimārttinṛṇāṃ devebhyaḥ kilbiṣaṃ yad babhūva imās tad āpaḥ pra vahantu ripraṃ punātu mā śatadhāraṃ pavitram
snāhi ripraṃ śamalaṃ ca sarvaṃ kṛṣṇe cele sādayitvā pāpam hitvāvartiṃ nirṛtiṃ mṛtyupāśān sūryaṃ jyotir abhy ehy agnim
udyanto asmān mahataḥ samudrān mucyamāno aṃhasaḥ pāpmanaś ca punar manaḥ punar āyur na āgan mā mā dabhan paṇayo yātudhānāḥ
ava ripram anikṣmahy aśastim adhy ātmanaḥ varca ā dhīyatāṃ mayi teja ā dhīyatāṃ mayi prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭaṃ sarvam āyur aśīya
brahma jajñānam ity ekā brahma bhrājad ud agād antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca brahmāvādhūṣṭāmṛtena mṛtyum brahmopadraṣṭā sukṛtasya sākṣād brahmāsmad apa hantu śamalaṃ tamaś ca
pratīcīr āyatā stara vitatāḥ paśyāmahai samudre apsu yā hitā asurāṇām ayasmayī
hariḥ suparṇo divam āruho 'rciṣā ye tvā dipsanti divam utpatantam ava tāṃ jahi harasā jātavedo 'bibhyad ugro hy arciṣā divam ā roha sūrya
ayojālā asurā māyino 'yasmayaiḥ pāśair aṅkino ye caranti tāṃs te randhayāmi harase jātavedaḥ sahasrabhṛṣṭiḥ sapatnān pramṛṇan yāhi vajraḥ
devānām adhipā eti gharma ṛtena bhrājann amṛtaṃ vicaṣṭe hiraṇyavarṇo nabhaso deva sūrya gharmo bhrājan divo antān pary eṣi vidyutā
vidyotante vidyuto agnijihvā hiraṇyavarṇā amṛtā apsv antaḥ samudre rudrasya kṣipno stanayitnor vidyut tasya vaiśvānārasya hetiḥ pari ṇo vṛṇaktu
vidyutā bhrājan hṛdayaṃ yāty agnir vyāghrā apsuṣado yatra bhīmāḥ viṣṇoḥ kramai stanayann eti rudro nudaṃ chatrūn vi mṛdho bādhamāno 'sapatnāḥ pradiśo me kṛṇotu
apo vasānaḥ samaity antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca samiddho agnir divyas tapodhāḥ vaiśvānaraḥ śamayā śītarūre apāṃ suparṇo diva eti pṛṣṭhe
vaiśvānaraḥ samudraṃ pary eti śukro gharmo bhrājan tejasā rocamāṇaḥ nudaṃ chatrūn pradahan me sapatnān ādityo dyām adhyarukṣad vipaścit
vaiśvānaraḥ saṃ tapaty antarikṣaṃ divaṃ ca samiddho agnir divyas tapojāḥ śikṣantv asmā abhi sunvanti soma ṛtena bhrājann amṛtaṃ vaste atkī
rārahyete nelayataḥ śītarūre tanvāv asya bhīme rūpāṇy eti bahudhā vasāno guhā kṛṇvānas tanvaḥ parācīḥ
pañcāre cakre parivartamāne samārohanti bhuvanāni viśvā tasya nākṣas tapyate bhūribhāraḥ sanād eva na chidyate sanābhiḥ
pañcabhis taptas tapaty eṣa etat sahasradhāmānam anu tiṣṭhanty enam sapta tvā sūrya harito vahanti brahmaṇādityas trivṛtā mukhena
vi dyotate dyotata ā ca dyotate apsv antar amṛto gharma udyan hantā vṛtrasya haritām anīkam anādhṛṣṭās tanvaḥ sūryasya
gharmaḥ paścād uta gharmaḥ purastād ayodaṃṣṭrāya dviṣato 'pi dadhmaḥ vaiśvānaraḥ śītarūre vasānaḥ sapatnān me dviṣato hantu sarvān
ṛtūn ṛtubhiḥ śrapayati brahmaṇaikavīro gharmaḥ śucānaḥ samidhā samiddhaḥ brahmā tvā tapati brahmaṇā tejasā ca
brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ samā dade taj jāyamānaṃ na bibhide na bhidyate tad aṅgamānaṃ pitaraṃ vyāhati tasya nāḍya ātatā vitatās tatā u tāḥ
asayajjāna sata ā jabhāra ya īṃ jajāna sa id asya bhartā prajāpatiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃvidānas trīṇi jyotīṃṣi dadhate na pākaḥ
prajāpatiś carati garbhe antaḥ sa jāyamāno bahudhā pra jāyate tasya padam abhi paśyanti vedhasas tasminn ārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā
yasmin devāḥ pitaro manuṣyā arā nābhāv iva śritāḥ apāṃ tvā puṣpaṃ pṛcchāmi yatra tan māyayāhitam
yatrāpāṃ puṣpaṃ nihitaṃ māyayātihitaṃ guhā yo vai tad vidyāt pratyakṣaṃ sa vidyād brāhmaṇaṃ mahat
maṇis triṣūtro nihitaḥ svarvid ūrdhvas tiryaṅ viśa etu prajānan sa pumān puṃso janayann ṛtena sarvān antān gacchatu sadya eva
sarvāṃ rātrīṃ sam oṣatv ādityo jātavedasā agner adhi divam ā rohann āyuṣā sam anaktu mā varcasā saṃ sṛjāti mā
gharmaḥ sāhasraḥ samidhā samiddho 'sapatnāḥ pradiśo me kṛṇotu sapatnān sarvān me sūryo hantu vaiśvānaro hariḥ
gharmas taptaḥ pra dahatu bhrātṛvyān dviṣato mama ā dattāṃ chatrūn āditya udyan sūryaḥ pṛtanyataḥ
vaiśvānaraḥ pra dahatu bhrātṛvyān dviṣato vṛṣā udyan me śukra ādityo vi mṛdho hantu sūryaḥ
śukraṃ suparṇaṃ hari brahma bhrājad ajasraṃ jyotir divam ā tatāna hariḥ suparṇaḥ pramathiṣṇur āśuḥ sapatnān hantu mahātā vadhena
hariḥ suparṇaḥ sudino 'bhayaṃkaro hiraṇyavarṇo durudāpa āśuḥ sapatnān sarvān me sūrya ādityo hantu raśmibhiḥ
mahāntam arthaṃ pari sadya etv ahorātre vidadhac chukra udyan sapatnān sarvān me sūrya etu vaiśvānaro dahan
udyann adya mitramaha ity ekā
tejas tapāṃsi mukhato bibharṣy ānandaṃ bhūtiṃ mahasaḥ pratiṣṭhām paryūhamāṇaḥ śriyam eṣi sarvato amoghaṃ satyaṃ yaśa udyataṃ te
brahmacārīṣṇaṃś carati rodasī ubhe yasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utāmūṃ sa ācāryaṃ tapasā pipartu
ācārya upanayamāno brahmacāriṇaṃ kṛṇute garbham antaḥ taṃ rātrīs tisra udare bibharti taṃ jātaṃ draṣṭum abhisaṃyanti devāḥ brahmacāriṇaṃ pitaro manuṣyā devajanā gandharvā enam anu yanti sarve
trayastriṃśataṃ triśatān ṣaṭ sahasrān sarvān sa devāṃs tapasā piparti iyaṃ samit pṛthivī dyaur dvitīyā utāntarikṣaṃ samidhā pṛṇāti brahmacārī samidhā mekhalāvī śrameṇa lokāṃs tapasā piparti
pūrvo jāto brahmaṇo brahmacārī gharmaṃ vasānas tapaso 'dhi tiṣṭhat tasmāj jātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāś ca sarve amṛtena sākam
brahmacārī samidhā samiddhaḥ kārṣṇaṃ vasāno dīkṣito dīrghaśmaśruḥ sa sadya eti pūrvād aparaṃ samudraṃ lokān saṃrabhya muhur ācarikrat
brahmacārī janayan brahma apo lokaṃ prajāpatiṃ parameṣṭhiṇaṃ virājam garbho bhūtvāmṛtasya yonāv indro bhūtvāsurāṃs tatarha
imāṃ bhūmīṃ pṛthivīṃ brahmacārī bhikṣāṃ jabhāra prathamo divaṃ ca te brahma kṛtvā samidhā upāsate tayor ārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā
ācāryas tatakṣa nabhasī ubhe urvī gambhīre pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca te brahmacārī tapasābhi rakṣati tayor devāḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti
arvāg anyaḥ paro anyo guhā nidhī nihitau brāhmaṇasya tau brahmacārī tapasābhi rakṣati tat kevalaṃ kṛṇute brahma vidvān
arvāg anyo divas pṛṣṭhād ito 'nyaḥ pṛthivyā agnī sameto nabhasī antareme tayoḥ śrayante raśmayo 'dhi dṛḍhās tān ā tiṣṭhati tapasā brahmacārī
abhikrandann aruṇaḥ śitiṅgo bṛhacchepo 'nu bhūmau jabhāra brahmacārī siñcati sānau retaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tena jīvanti pradiśaś catasraḥ
parjanyo mṛtyur varuṇaḥ soma oṣadhayaḥ payaḥ jīmūtā āsan satvānas tair idaṃ svar ābharan
agnau sūrye candramasi mātariśvani brahmacāry apsu samidham ā dadhāti teṣām arcīṃṣi pṛthag abhre caranti teṣām ājyaṃ puruṣo varṣam aśvaḥ
amā ghṛtaṃ kṛṇute kevalam ācāryo bhūtvā varuṇo yadyad aicchat prajāpatau tad brahmacārī prāyacchat svān mitro adhy ātmanaḥ
ācāryo brahmacārī brahmacārī prajāpatiḥ prajāpatir vi rājati virāḍ indro 'bhavad vaśī
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā rājā rāṣṭraṃ vi rakṣate ācāryo brahmacaryeṇa brahmacāriṇam icchate
brahmacaryeṇa kanyā yuvānaṃ vindate patim anaḍvān brahmacaryeṇa aśvo ghāsaṃ jigīrṣati
brahmacaryeṇa tapasā devā mṛtyum apājayan indro ha brahmacaryeṇa amṛtaṃ svar ābharat
oṣadhayo bhūtā bhavyam ahorātre vanaspatayaḥ saṃvatsaraḥ sahartubhis te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ
pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā grāmyā ca ye apakṣāḥ pakṣiṇaś ca ye te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ
pṛthak sarve prajāpatyāḥ prāṇām̐ ātmasu bibhrati sarvāṃs tān brahma rakṣati brahmacāriṇy ābhṛtam
brahmacārī brahma bhrājad bibharti tasmin devā adhi viśve sametāḥ sa snāto babhruḥ piṅgalaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bahu rocate
devānām etat pariṣūtam anabhyārūḍhaṃ carati rocamānam tasmin sarve paśavas tatra yajñās tasminn annaṃ saha devatābhiḥ
prāṇāpānau janayann ād vyānaṃ cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ janayan brahma medhām vācaṃ śreṣṭhāṃ yaśo asmāsu dhehy
annaṃ reto lohitam udaraṃ tāni kalpan brahmacārī salilasya pṛṣṭhe tapo 'tiṣṭhat tapyamānaḥ samudre
satyaṃ bṛhad ṛtam ugraṃ dīkṣā tapo brahma yajñaḥ pṛthivīṃ dhārayanti sā no bhūtasya bhavyasya patny uruṃ lokaṃ pṛthivī naḥ kṛṇotv asaṃbādhaṃ madhyato mānaveṣu
yasyā udyataḥ pravataḥ samaṃ bahu nānāvīryā oṣadhīr yā bibharti pṛthivī naḥ prathatāṃ rādhyatāṃ naḥ
yasyāṃ samudra uta sindhur āpo yasyāṃ devā anṛtam anvavindan yā bibharti bahudhā prāṇam ejat sā no bhūmir goṣv aśveṣv apy anne kṛṇotu
yasyāṃ pūrve pūrvajanā vicakrire yasyāṃ devā asurān abhyavartayan yasyām idaṃ jīvati viśvam ejat sā no bhūmiḥ pūrvapeye dadhātu
yasyāṃ catasraḥ pradiśaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yasyām annaṃ kṛṣṭayaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ gavām aśvānāṃ vayasaś ca viṣṭhā bhagaṃ varcaḥ pṛthivī no dadhātu
viśvaṃbharā vasudhānī pratiṣṭhā hiraṇyavakṣā jagato niveśanīḥ vaiśvānaraṃ bibhratī bhūmir agnim indrarṣabhā draviṇe no dadhātu
yasyām āpaḥ paricarāḥ samānīr ahorātre apramādaṃ kṣaranti sā no bhūmir bhūridhārā payo duhām atho ukṣatu varcasā
yāṃ rakṣanty asvapnā viśvadānīṃ devā bhūmiṃ pṛthivīm apramādam sā no madhu priyaṃ duhām atho ukṣatu varcasā
yārṇave 'dhi salilam agra āsīd yāṃ māyābhir anvacaran manīṣiṇaḥ yasyāṃ hṛdayaṃ parame vyomant satyenāvṛtam amṛtaṃ pṛthivyāḥ sā no bhūmis tviṣiṃ balaṃ rāṣṭre dadhātu me
yām aśvināv amimātāṃ viṣṇur yasyāṃ vicakrame indro yāṃ cakra ātmane anamitrāṃ chacīpatiḥ sā no bhūmir vi sṛjatāṃ mātā putrāya naḥ payaḥ
girayas te parvatā himavanto 'raṇyan te pṛthivi syonam astu naḥ babhruṃ kṛṣṇāṃ rohiṇīṃ viśvarūpāṃ dhruvāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīm indraguptām ajīto 'hato akṣato adhyaṣṭhāṃ pṛthivīm aham
yat te madhyaṃ pṛthivi yac ca nabhyaṃ yās ta ūrjas tanvaḥ saṃbabhūvuḥ tāsu no dhehy abhi naḥ pavasva
mātā bhūmiḥ putro ahaṃ pṛthivyāḥ parjanyaḥ pitā sa u naḥ pipartu
yasyāṃ vediṃ parigṛhnanti bhūmyāṃ yasyāṃ yajñaṃ tanvate viśvakarmāṇaḥ yasyāṃ mīyante svaravaḥ pṛthivyām ūrdhvāḥ śukrā āhutyāḥ purastāt sā no bhūmir vardhayād vardhamānā
yo no dveṣat pṛthivi yat pṛtanyād yo 'bhimanyātai manasā vadhena tan no bhūme randhaya pūrvakṛtvane
tvajjātās tvayi caranti martyās tvaṃ bibharṣi dvipadaś catuṣpadaḥ tvayīme pṛthivi pañca mānavā yebhyo jyotir amṛtaṃ martyebhya udyan sūryo raśmibhir ā tanoti
tā naḥ prajāḥ saṃ duhratāṃ samagrā vāco madhu pṛthivī dhehi mahyam
viśvasvaṃ mātaram oṣadhīnāṃ dhruvāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīṃ dharmaṇā dhṛtām śivāṃ syonām anu carema viśvahā
mahat sadhasthaṃ mahatī babhūvitha mahān vega ejathur vepathuṣ ṭe mahāṃs tvendro rakṣati vīryeṇa sā no bhūme prarocaya hiraṇyasyeva saṃdṛśi
agnir bhūmyām agnir oṣadhīṣv agnim āpo bibhraty agnir aśmasu agnir antaḥ puruṣeṣu goṣv aśveṣv agnayaḥ
agnir diva ā tapaty agner devasyorv antarikṣam agniṃ martāsa indhate havyavāhaṃ ghṛtapriyam
agnivāsāḥ pṛthivy asitajñus tviṣīmantaṃ saṃśitaṃ mā kṛṇotu bhūmyāṃ devebhyo juhvati yajñaṃ havyam araṃkṛtam bhūmyāṃ manuṣyā jīvanti svadhayānnena martyāḥ sā no bhūmiḥ prāṇam āyur dadhātu jaradaṣṭiṃ mā pṛthivī kṛṇotu
yas te gandhaḥ pṛthivi saṃbabhūva yaṃ bibhraty oṣadhayo yam āpaḥ yaṃ gandharvā apsarasaś ca bhejire yas te gām aśvam arhati tenāsmān surabhīn kṛṇu mā no dvikṣata kaś cana
yas te gandhaḥ puṣkaram āviveśa yaṃ saṃjabhruḥ sūryāyā vivāhe amartyāḥ pṛthivi gandham agre tenāsmān surabhīn kṛṇu mā no dvikṣata kaś cana
yas te bhūme puruṣeṣu strīṣu puṃsu bhago rucir yo vadhūṣu vadhūyuṣu yo goṣv aśveṣu yo mṛgeṣūta hastiṣu kanyāyāṃ varco yad bhūme tenāsmām̐ adhi saṃ sṛja mā no dvikṣata kaś cana
śilā bhūmir aśmā pāṃsur yā bhūmiḥ saṃbhṛtā dhṛtā yasyāṃ vṛkṣā vānaspatyā dhruvās tiṣṭhanti viśvahā bhūmiṃ hiraṇyavakṣasaṃ dhṛtām acchā vadāmasi
udīrāṇā utāsīnās tiṣṭhantaḥ prakrāmantaḥ padbhyāṃ dakṣiṇasavyābhyāṃ mā vyathiṣmahi bhūmyām
vimṛgvarīṃ pṛthivīm ā vadāmi kṣamāṃ bhūmiṃ brahmaṇā vāvṛdhānām ūrjaṃ puṣṭiṃ bibhratīm annabhāgaṃ ghṛtaṃ tvābhi ni ṣīdāmi bhūme
śuddhā ma āpas tanvaḥ kṣaranti yo me sehur apriye taṃ ni dadhmaḥ pavitreṇa pṛthivīm ut punāmi
nidhīn bibhratī bahudhā guhā vasu maṇiṃ hiraṇyaṃ pṛthivī dadhātu naḥ vasūni no vasudā rāsamānā devī dadhātu sumanasyamānā
yās te prācīḥ pradiśo yā udīcīr yās te bhūme adharād yāś ca paścāt syonās tā mahyaṃ carate bhavantu mā ni paptaṃ bhuvane śiśriyāṇe
mā mā paścān mā purastān nudiṣṭhāḥ svasti bhūme me kṛṇu varīyo yāvayā vadhan mā vidan paripanthinaḥ
yāvat te 'bhi vipaśyāmi bhūme sūryeṇa medinā tāvan me cakṣur mā meṣṭa uttarām uttarāṃ samām
yat te bhūme vikhanāmy oṣaṃ tad api rohatu mā te marma vimṛgvari mā te hṛdayam arpipam
yac chayānaḥ paryāvarte dakṣiṇaṃ savyam abhi bhūme pārśvam uttānās tvā pratīcīṃ pṛṣṭyā yad abhiśemahe mā hiṃsīs tatra no bhūme sarvasya pratiśīvari
grīṣmas te bhūme varṣāṇi śarad dhemantaḥ śiśiro vasantaḥ ṛtavas te vihitā hāyanā ahorātre pṛthivī no duhātām
yāpa sarpaṃ nudamānā vimṛgvarī yasyām āsann agnayo apsv antaḥ parā dasyūn dadatī devapīyūn indraṃ vṛṇānā pṛthivī na vṛtraṃ śakrāya dadhre vṛṣabhāya vṛṣṇe sa no bhūmer ā diśatu yad dhanaṃ kāmayāmahe
bhago anu prayuṅktām indro yātu purogavaḥ yasyāṃ sadohavirdhāne yūpo yasyāṃ nimīyate brahmāṇo yasyām arcanti ṛgbhiḥ sāmnā yajurvidaḥ yujyante yasyām ṛtvijaḥ somam indrāya pātave sā no bhūmir dakṣiṇāyāṃ suśevā yajñe dadhātu sumanasyamānā
yasyāṃ pūrve bhūtakṛta ṛṣayo gā udānṛcuḥ sapta satreṇa vedhaso yajñena tapasā saha sā naḥ paśūn viśvarūpān dadhātu dīrghaṃ ma āyuḥ savitā kṛṇotu
yasyām annaṃ vrīhiyavau yatremāḥ pañca kṛṣṭayaḥ bhūmyai parjanyapatnyai namo 'stu varṣam edhate
yasyāṃ gāyanti nṛtyanti janā martyā vailavāḥ yujyante yasyām ākrando yasyāṃ vadati dundubhiḥ sā no bhūmiḥ pra ṇudatāṃ sapatnān yo no dveṣṭy adharaṃ taṃ kṛṇotu
yasyāṃ puro devakṛtāḥ kṣetre yasyāṃ vikurvate prajāpatiḥ pṛthivīṃ viśvagarbhām āśāmāśāṃ raṇyāṃ naḥ kṛṇotu
janaṃ bibhratī bahudhā vivācasaṃ nānādharmāṇaṃ pṛthivī yathaukasam sahasraṃ dhārā draviṇasya no duhāṃ dhruveva dhenur anapasphurantī
yas te sarpo vṛścikas tṛṣṭadaṃśmā hemantajabdho bhṛmalo guhā śaye krimir ilmaṃ pṛthivi prāvṛṣi yad ejati tan naḥ sarpan mopa sṛpad yac chivaṃ tena no mṛḍa
ye te panthāno bahudhā janāyanā rathasya vartman manasaś ca yātave yebhiś caranty ubhaye bhadrapāpās taṃ panthāṃ jayemānamitram ataskaram
mandaṃ bibhratī gurubhṛd bhadrapāpasya nidhanaṃ titikṣuḥ sūkareṇa pṛthivī saṃvidānā varāhāya vi jihīte mṛgāya
ye ta āranyāḥ paśavo mṛgā vane hitāḥ siṃhā vyāghrāḥ puruṣādaś caranti ulaṃ vṛkaṃ pṛthivi ducchunām ita ṛkṣīkāṃ rakṣo apa badhāsmat
ye gandharvāpsaraso ye carāyāḥ kimīdinaḥ piśācān sarvā rakṣāṃsi tān asmad bhūme yāvaya
yāṃ dvipādaḥ pakṣiṇaḥ saṃpatanti haṃsāḥ suparṇāḥ śakunā vayāṃsi yasyāṃ vāta īyate mātariśvā rajāṃsi kṛṇvaṃś cyāvayaṃś ca vṛkṣān vātasya pravām upavām anu vāty arcir yasyāṃ kṛṣṇam aruṇaṃ ca saṃbhṛte ahorātre vihite bhūmyām adhi
varṣeṇa bhūmiḥ pṛthivī vṛtāvṛtā sā no dadhātu bhadrayā priye dhāmanidhāmani
dyauś ca ma idaṃ pṛthivī ca antarikṣaṃ ca me vyacaḥ agniḥ sūrya āpo medhāṃ viśve devāś ca saṃ dadhuḥ
aham asmi sahamāna uttaro nāma bhūmyām abhisāḍ asmi viśvāṣāḍ āśāmāśāṃ viṣāsahiḥ
yad ado devi prathamānā purastād devaiḥ sṛṣṭā vyasarpo mahitvam ā tvā subhūtam aviśat tadānīm akalpayathāḥ pradiśaś catasraḥ
ye grāmā yāny araṇyāni yāḥ sabhā adhi bhūmyām teṣv ahaṃ devi pṛthivy udyāsaṃ madhumad vacaḥ
yad vadāni madhumat tad vadāni yad īkṣe ṣutadyaḥ punantu mā tviṣīmān asmi jūtimān yān hanmi dodhataḥ
aśva iva rajo duduhe vi taṃ janaṃ ya ākṣiyan pṛthivīm ād ajāyata madrā pari bhuvanasya gopā vanaspatīnāṃ gṛbhir oṣadhīnām
śantivā surabhiḥ syonā kīlālodhnī payasvatī bhūmir no adhi bravītu pṛthivī payasā saha
bhūmi mātar ni dhehi mā bhadrayā supratiṣṭhitam saṃvidānā divā tvaṃ śriyāṃ mā dhehi bhūtyām
yām anvaicchad dhaviṣā viśvakarmā yasyām āsann agnayo 'psv antaḥ bhujiṣyaṃ pātraṃ nihitaṃ guhā āsīd āvir bhogair abhavan mātṛmadbhiḥ
tvam asy āvapanī janānām aditiḥ kāmadughā viśvarūpā yat ta ūnaṃ tat ta ā pūrayāti prajāpatiḥ prajābhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ
kasminn aṅge tapo asyādhi tiṣṭhati kasminn aṅga ṛtam asyādhyāhitam kva vrataṃ kva śraddhāsya tiṣṭhati kasminn aṅge satyam asya pratiṣṭhitam
kva brahma kva tiṣṭhanty āpaḥ kasminn aṅge diśo asya pratiṣṭhitāḥ katamad aṅgam anu saṃ carete ahorātre saṃvidāne samānam
kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhati bhūmir asya kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty antarikṣam kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty āhitā dyauḥ kasminn aṅge tiṣṭhaty uttaraṃ divaḥ
kasmād aṅgād dīpyate agnir asya kasmād aṅgāt pavate mātariśvā kasmād aṅgād vi mimīte 'dhi candramāḥ skambhasya mahad vimimāno aṅgam
kva prepsan dīpyata ūrdhvo agniḥ kva prepsan pavate mātariśvā yatra prepsantīr abhiyanty āvṛtaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
kva prepsantī yuvatī virūpe ahorātre dravataḥ saṃvidāne yatra prepsantīr abhiyanty āpaḥ skambhaṃ
kvārdhamāsāḥ kva yanti māsāḥ saṃvatsareṇa saha saṃvidānāḥ yatra yanty ṛtavo yatrārtavāḥ skambhaṃ
yasmin skandhā prajāpatir lokān sarvām̐ adhārayat skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
yat paramam avamaṃ yac ca madhyamaṃ prajāpatiḥ sasṛje viśvarūpam kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra yan na pārviśat kva tad babhūva
kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa bhūtaṃ kiyad bhaviṣyad anvāśaye 'sya ekaṃ yad aṅgam akṛṇot sahasradhā kiyatā skambhaḥ pra viveśa tatra
yatra lokāś ca kośāś ca brahma yatra janā viduḥ asac ca yatra sac cāntaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
yatra tapaḥ parākramya ṛtaṃ dhārayaty uttaram vrataṃ ca yatra śraddhā ca brahmāpaḥ samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ
yasmin bhūmir antarikṣaṃ dyaur asminn adhyāhitā yatrāgniś candramā sūryo vātas tiṣṭhanty ārpitāḥ skambhaṃ
yasya trayastriṃśad devā aṅge sarve samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ
yatra ṛṣayo bhūtakṛta ṛcaḥ sāma yajur mahī ekarṣir yasminn ārpitāḥ skambhaṃ
yasya catasraḥ pradiśo nāḍyas tiṣṭhanti prapyasāḥ yajño yasmin parākrāntaḥ skambhaṃ
yatrāmṛtaṃ ca mṛtyuś ca puruṣaś ca samāhitāḥ samudro yasya nāḍyaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
ye puruṣe brahma vidus te skambham anu saṃ viduḥ yo veda parameṣṭhinaṃ yaś ca veda prajāpatim jyeṣṭhaṃ ye brāhmaṇaṃ vidus te skambham anu saṃ viduḥ
yasya śiro vaiśvānaraś cakṣur aṅgiraso 'bhavan aṅgāni yasya yātavaḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
yasya brahma mukham āhur jihvāṃ madhukaśām uta virājaṃ yasyodha āhuḥ skambhaṃ
yasmād ṛco apātakṣaṃ yajur yasmād apākaṣan chandāṃsi yasya lomāni skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
asacchākhāṃ pratiṣṭhantīṃ paramam iva janā viduḥ uto san manyante 'vare ye 'sya śākhām upāsate
yatrādityāś ca rudrāś ca vasavaś ca samāhitāḥ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
yasya trayastriṃśad devā nidhiṃ rakṣanti sarvadā nidhiṃ tam adya ko veda yaṃ devā abhirakṣata
yatra devā brahmavido brahma jyeṣṭham upāsate yo vai ta brāhmaṇo veda taṃ vai brahmavido viduḥ
bṛhanto nāma te devā asatas pari jajñire ekaṃ tad aṅgaṃ skambhasya asad āhuḥ paro janāḥ
yatra skambhaḥ prajanayan purāṇaṃ vyavartayat ekaṃ tad aṅgaṃ skambhasya purāṇam anu saṃ viduḥ
yatra trayastriṃśad devā aṅgā gātrāṇi bhejire tān vai trayastriṃśad devān eke brahmavido viduḥ
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ paramam anatyudyaṃ janā viduḥ skambhas tad agre prāsiñcad dhiraṇyaṃ loke antarā
skambhe lokāḥ skambhe tapaḥ skambhe 'dhy ṛtam āhitam skambhaṃ tvā vidma pratyakṣam indre sarvaṃ samāhitam
indre lokā indre tapa indre 'dhy ṛtam āhitam indraṃ tvā vidma pratyakṣaṃ skambhe sarvaṃ samāhitam
nāma nāmnā johavīmi purā sūryāt puroṣasaḥ yad adaḥ prathamaṃ saṃbabhūva saha tat svarājyaṃ jagāma yasmān na param asti bhūtam
yasya bhūmiḥ pramāntarikṣam utodaram divaṃ yaś cakre mūrdhānaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
yasya sūryaś cakṣuś candramāś ca punar navaḥ agniṃ yaś cakra āsyaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
yasya vātaḥ prāṇāpānau cakṣur aṅgiraso 'bhuvan diśo yaś cakre prajñānīs tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
yaḥ śramāt tapaso jāto lokān sarvān samānaśe somaṃ yaś cakre kevalaṃ tasmai jyeṣṭhāya brahmaṇe namaḥ
skambho dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyām utāmūṃ skambho dādhārorv antarikṣam skambho dādhāra pradiśaḥ ṣaḍ urvīḥ skambha idaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanam ā viveśa
kathaṃ vāto nelayati kathaṃ na ramate manaḥ kim āpaḥ satyaṃ prepsantīḥ pra caṅkramīti sarvadā
mahad yakṣaṃ bhuvanasya madhye tapasi krāntaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe tasmiṃ chrayante ya u ke ca devā vṛkṣasya skambhaṃ parita iva śākhāḥ
yasmai hastābhyāṃ pādābhyāṃ vācā śrotreṇa cakṣuṣā yasmai devā sadā baliṃ prayacchanti vimite 'mitaṃ skambhaṃ taṃ brūhi katamaḥ svid eva saḥ
apa tasya tamo hataṃ vyāvṛttaḥ sa pāpmanā sarvāṇi tasmin jyotīṃṣi yāni trīṇi prajāpatau
yo vetasaṃ hiraṇyayaṃ tiṣṭhantaṃ salile veda sa vai guhyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
na prajāpatim aty eti nāty eti parameṣṭhinam utota tatra no vṛta yaj jyeṣṭhaṃ paro atyayat
asti vai tat paro bhūmer asti vai tat paro divaḥ lokā vai tasmin saṃprotā yasminn otāḥ prajā imāḥ
antaḥpātre rerihati dūrśe durnihitaiṣiṇi uruṇḍe abhicaṅkrame vakmake bastavāsini sarvāsāṃ bhaṇvā vaḥ sākaṃ nāmadheyāni vidmasi yati jātāni vas tati naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
karṇā dṛṣadrathāmaham urukīṃ keśinīṃ krakum khaḍurīm ambarīṣyaṃ nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ prapāṭhaka
paṇḍugirāṃ phāladatīm asaṃsūktanigāriṇīm asātāḥ sarvā vo brūmo naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
yāḥ śayānaṃ jambhayanti naktam icchanty āturam atho janasya suptasya mukhā hastāt pra rihanti datsu datkavanocitās tā ito nāśayāmasi
āpatantīr vikṣiṇānā vastagandhāḥ sadānvāḥ bhaṇvā sinā totsyāmi tīkṣṇaśṛṅga ivarṣabhaḥ
sadānvāḥ sādānveyāṃ strīpuṃsām̐ ubhayān saha sahe sahasvān sahasā vi mṛdho hanmi rakṣasaḥ
caturdaṃṣṭrān kumbhamuṣkān dīrghakeśām̐ asṛnmukhān alābugandhīn undurān durṇāmno nāśayāmasi
stambe jātā adhi bāle rodākām̐ rudatīṃ tvat durṇāmnīḥ sarvāḥ santokā nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
yāsāṃ jātāni krośanti bhitsv antar vane jvala upa vṛkṣeṣu śerate
yā vātābhra utpatite carttā varṣeṇa vidyutā śālā icchanti satvaram durṇāmnīḥ sarvāḥ santokā nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
yā dhānyāt saṃbhavanti kṣetrād uptād varpitāta kṛtād abhiprahāyyā naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
yāḥ puruṣāḥ pāpagandhāḥ sadā rukṣā visṛkpadī tā vajreṇa samarpayan nirajetaḥ śacīpate
ut tiṣṭhata nir dravata na va ihāsti nyañcanam indro vaḥ sarvāsāṃ sākaṃ garbhān āṇḍāni bhetsyati
indra jahi sthūlaśaṃkhāṃ mṛṇīhi durṇaśīṃ kuham arāyīṃ śakadhūmyaṃ nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
kim āsutāṃ nagnahvam ajamāyuṃ ca nighnatīm viṭiṭiṅgāḥ pratodinīr nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
yasyāsutaṃ randhayadhve yūyaṃ bhaṇvāḥ sadānvāḥ tṛṣṭaṃ kṛṇutāṇḍaraṃ yadā rasena tṛpyata āt surām ava mehatha
tasyāḥ pītvāvamakty atho śīrṣakty ā śaye tā ekānnadūṣaṇīr nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
apārogāñ chakadhūmān vṛkṣāṇāṃ yantu satvaram atho durhārdaso gṛhaṃ pra mṛśantv arāyyaḥ
tāsām ekācchavakā śaṅkāvaṅkā vanekṛkur hasanaikā kanikradā sarvāsāṃ bhaṇvā vaḥ sākaṃ nāmadheyāni vidmasi yati jātāni vas tati naśyatetaḥ sadānvāḥ
sahasvatīṃ pra harāmi imāṃ śālāṃ viṣāsahim sadānvāghnīm oṣadhiṃ jaitrāyācchā vadāmasi
duḥsaṃkāśe bhīmacakṣo nagne bhaṇve sadānve dhrājiṃ tviṣiṃ śucim agnim arāyi kim ihecchase dhūmaṃ mābhi pra gāyi ni stauṣāmi sadānve
kaṅkyekā prakhidaikā kim ic chāntyabhiśrayā caranti naktaṃ durṇāmno arāyīḥ sūtikaiṣyas tā ito nāśayāmasi
apakrathām abhiśrayām ānṛtyantīṃ kutūhalām kusūlīṃ rathabhañjanīṃ khalāj jātās trikūkvas tā ito nāśayāmasi
yā vikeśīr unmadityā urarā ghoracakṣavaḥ śīrśāṇy anyā anyāsāṃ vitāvantīr ivāsate sadānvā brahmaṇaspate paro bhrūṇāny arpaya
yāsāṃ gandho nānārūpaḥ paryaiti puruṣaṃ pathi tā agniḥ sahatām ito jātavedāḥ sadānvāḥ
yāḥ puruṣaṃ dahyamānaṃ śūnyam agnau jighatsanti bhaṇvā niṣkuṣṭā nāmāsi muṣṭāgreṇa sadānvās tā ito nāśayāmasi
yā ucitā āvapane śuṣkaṃ khādanti maṣmasaṃ vaḍavā gardabhīr iva nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
garbhān ekaḥ prati morśaṃ yā adanti sadānvāḥ ucitās tanvaṃ striyā gāva ā rohiṇīr iva tā ito nāśayāmasi
yāḥ pitṛyāt saṃbhavanti indrajā naḥ sadānvāḥ apa mityam ivābhṛtaṃ punas tā prati dadmasi
āmādinīḥ krūrādinīr anagnigandhyādinīḥ amuṃ paretyoddhitaṃ śavam atta sadānvāḥ śavaḥ kevala ācāraḥ kim u śālāsv icchatha
yāḥ kumārīr yāḥ sthavirā yuvatīr yāḥ sadānvāḥ sarvā yantu kurūṭinīḥ kulīnādhenu sarpatv arāyīr abhibhā itaḥ
tābhyo rudro visṛjat tviṣim adhvagaghātinīm tā astā hantu vidyutā vajreṇānaparādhinā tāsāṃ tvaṃ śakra moc chiṣa indra bhaṇvāḥ phalīkuru
kumārān ekā sthavīrān yā adanti prakhādinīḥ tā indro hantu vṛtrahā yā devo viśvād rakṣāṃsi sedhati
yāś ca dāsīr asurāṇāṃ manuṣyebhyaś ca yāḥ kṛtāḥ ubhayīs tāḥ parā yantu parāvataṃ navatiṃ nāvyā ati
yāsāṃ ghoṣaḥ saṃgatānāṃ vṛkāṇām iva gaṅgaṇaḥ pracaṅkaśāmaivaharāṃ prayacchantīṃ pratigrahāṃ nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
yāni sāyaṃ yathāsthāmād rātrīṃ yakṣāṇi prerate agniṣ ṭā sarvā sāhantyo viśvād rakṣāṃsi sedhatu
yā ṛkṣīkāḥ kalīlāndā apsu jātāḥ pulīkayāḥ gopā āsām eko veda yato jātāḥ sadānvās tā ito nāśayāmasi
gurucchāyām ūrdhāryaṃ śiśumākāṃ pratiśrukām atiduhnāṃ vicalantīṃ vitūlumām sarvāś caṇḍasya naptyo nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
āvadantīṃ nāmahūkāṃ taṃstanīkāṃ vṛṅktapadīm udradantīm anāsikāṃ nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
vāvadākām albhaṣāsāṃ vijavrāṃ labruvaṃ lavum arāyīṃ vācamejayāṃ nāśayāmaḥ sadānvāḥ
dadāmīty eva brūyād anu cainām abhutsata vaśāṃ brahmabhyo yācadbhyas tat prajāvad apatyavat
prajayā sa vi krīṇīte paśubhiś copa dasyati ya ārṣeyebhyo yācadbhyo devānāṃ gāṃ na ditsati
kūṭayāsya saṃ śīryante śroṇayā kāṭam ardati baṇḍayā dahyante gṛhāḥ kāṇayā jīyate svam
vilohito adhiṣṭhānāc chakno vindati gopatim tathā vaśāyāḥ sāṃvidyaṃ duradabhnā hy ucyase
yo asyāḥ karṇāv āskunoty ā sa deveṣu vṛścate lakṣma kurva iti manyate kanīyaḥ kṛṇute svam
pador asyā adhiṣṭhānād viklindur nāma vindati anāmanāt saṃ śīryante yā mukhenopajighrati
yad asyā gopatau satyā loma dhvāṅkṣo ajīhiḍat tataḥ kiśorā mriyante vatsāṃś ca ghātuko vṛkaḥ
yad asyāḥ kasmai cid bhogāya bālān kaś cit pra kṛntati tataḥ kumārā mriyante yakṣmaś chantsaty anāmanāt
yad asyāḥ palpulanāya śakṛd dāsī samasyati tato 'pirūpaṃ jāyate tasmād avyeṣyad enasaḥ
jāyamānābhi jāyate devān sabrāhmaṇān vaśā tasmād brahmabhyo deyaiṣā tad āhuḥ svasya gopanam
ya enāṃ vanim āyanti teṣāṃ devakṛtā vaśā brahmajyeyaṃ tad abruvan ya enāṃ nipriyāyate
ya enāṃ yācadbhya ārṣeyebhyo na ditsati ā sa deveṣu vṛścate brāhmanānāṃ ca manyave
yasyānyaḥ syād vaśābhogo anyām iccheta tarhi saḥ hiṃsyād adattā gopatiṃ yācitāṃ ca na ditsati
yathā śevadhir nihito brāhmaṇānāṃ tathā vaśā tām etad ā yanti yasmin kasmiṃś ca jāyate
svam etad ā yanti yad vaśāṃ brāhmaṇā abhi yathaitān anyaj jinīyād evāsyānirodhanam
cared evā traihāyaṇād avijñātagadā satī vaśāṃ ca vidyān nārada brāhmaṇas tarhy eṣyaḥ
ya enām avaśām āha devānāṃ nihitaṃ nidhim ubhau tasmai bhavāśarvau parikramyeṣum asyataḥ
duradabhnainam ā śaye yācitāṃ ca na ditsati nāsmai kāmaḥ sam ṛdhyate yam adattvā cikīrṣati
yo asyā ūdho na veda atho asyā stanān uta ubhayenaivaināṃ duhe dātuṃ ced aśakad vaśām
devā vaśāṃ yācanti mukhaṃ kṛtvā brahmaṇam teṣāṃ sarveṣām adadad dheḍaṃ ny eti mānuṣaḥ
heḍaṃ paśūnāṃ ny eti brāhmaṇebhyo 'dadad vaśām devānāṃ nihitaṃ bhāgaṃ martyaś cen nipriyāyate
yad anye śataṃ yāceyur brāhmaṇā gopatiṃ vaśām athaitā devā abruvann evaṃ ha viduṣo vaśā
ya evaṃ viduṣe 'dattvā anyasmai dadad vaśām durgā tasmā adhiṣṭhāne pṛthivī sahadevatā
devā vaśām ayācan yasminn agre ajāyata tām etāṃ vidyān nāradaḥ saha devair ud ājata
anapatyam alpapaśuṃ vaśā kṛṇotu pūruṣam brāhmaṇaiś ca yācitām athaināṃ ni priyāyate
agnīṣomābhyāṃ kāmāya mitrāya varuṇāya ca tebhyo yācanti brāhmaṇās tebhya ā vṛścate 'dadhat
yāvad asyā gopatir na upaśṛṇuyād ṛcaḥ svayam cared asya tāvad goṣu nāsya śrutā gṛhe syāt
yo asyā ṛca upaśrutya atha goṣv acīcarat āyuś ca tasya bhūtiṃ ca devā vṛścanti hīḍitāḥ
vaśā carantī bahudhā devānāṃ nihito nidhiḥ āviṣkṛṇute rūpāṇi yathā sthāma jigāṃsati
āvir ātmānaṃ kṛṇute yathā sthāma jigāṃsati atho ha brahmabhyo vaśā yākyāya kṛṇute manaḥ
manasā saṃkalpayati tad devām̐ api gacchati atho ha brahmāṇo vaśām upaprayanti yācitum
svadhākāreṇa pitṛbhyo yajñena devatābhyaḥ dānena rājanyo vaśāyā mātur heḍaṃ na gacchati
vaśā rājanya te mātā tathā saṃbhūtam agraśaḥ tasyā āhur anarpaṇaṃ ya brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate
yathājyaṃ pratigṛhītam ālumpet sruco agnaye evā ha brahmāṇo vaśām āgnaye vṛścate 'dadhat
puroḍāśavatsā sudughā loke asyopa tiṣṭhati sāsmai sarvān kāmān duhe vaśā pradaduṣe bahūn
sarvān kāmān yamarājye vaśā pradaduṣe duhe athāhur nārakaṃ lokaṃ nirundhānasya yācitām
pravīyamānā carati kruddhā gopataye vaśā vehataṃ mā manyamāno mṛtyoḥ pāśeṣu badhyatām
yo vehataṃ manyamāno gṛheṣu pacate vaśām apy asya putrān pautrāṃś ca yācayate bṛhaspatiḥ
mahad eṣā vi tapati carantī goṣu gaur api tato ha gopataye vaśā daduṣe viṣaṃ duhe
priyaṃ paśūnāṃ bhavati yad brahmabhyaḥ pradīyate ato vaśāyās tat priyaṃ yad devatrā haviḥ syāt
yā vaśā udakalpayan devā yajñād udetya tāsāṃ viliptyaṃ bhīmām udākuruta nāradaḥ
tāṃ devā amīmāṃsanta vaśeyāṃ na vaśeti tām abravīn nārada eṣā vaśānāṃ vaśatamā
kati nu vaśā nārada yās tvaṃ vettha manuṣyajāḥ katamāsāṃ bhīmatamā kasyā nāśnīyād abrāhmaṇaḥ
viliptyā bṛhaspate yā ca sūtavaśā vaśā tāsāṃ nāśnīyād abrāhmaṇo ya āśaṃseti bhūtyām
namas te astu nārada anuṣṭha viduṣe vaśā katamāsāṃ bhīmatamā yām adattvā parābhavet
viliptyā bṛhaspate yā ca sūtavaśā vaśā yāḥ prayacched brahmabhyo ya āśaṃśeti bhūtyām
trīṇi vai vaśājātāni viliptī sūtavaśā vaśā tāḥ pra yacched brahmabhyaḥ syonāvaskaḥ prajāpatau
etad vo brāhmaṇā havir iti manvīta yācitaḥ vaśāṃ ced enaṃ yāceyur yā bhīmādaduṣo gṛhe
devā vaśām upāvadan na no dād iti hīḍitāḥ etābhir ṛgbhir bhedasya tasmād vai sa parābhavat
utaitāṃ bhedo nāradād vaśām indreṇa yācitaḥ tasmāt taṃ devā enaso vṛścann ahamuttare
ye vaśāyā adānāya vadanti parirāpinaḥ indrasya manyave jālmā ā vṛścante acityā
yo gopatiṃ pārāṇīya athāhur mā dadā iti rudrasyās tāṃ hetiṃ te pari yanty acetasaḥ
yadi hutāṃ yady ahutām amā ca pacate vaśām devān sabrāhmaṇān ṛtvā jihmo lokān nir ṛcchati
asṛṅ māṃsaṃ tvacaṃ peṣṭraṃ mastṛhaṇaṃ majjñaḥ śarīram agniḥ kravyād attv amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya
prātaryāvadbhyo devebhyaḥ sāyaṃyāvadbhyo devebhyo viśvadānīṃyāvadbhyo devebhyaḥ amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi
vaiśvānarāya kṣipradhanvane 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi
kṣipradhanvan kṣiprahasta amuṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasya hṛdayaṃ yakṛn matasne pra vidhya
indrāgnibhyāṃ prajāpataye parameṣṭhine somāya rājñe varuṇāya rājñe pūṣṇe dhātre savitre tvaṣṭre 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi
uṣase 'hne rātraye sūryāyāmum
vīrudbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo vānaspatebhyo 'mum
adbhyo mātariśvane 'dyāvāpṛthivībhyām amum
idāvatsarāya parivatsarāya saṃvatsarāya bṛhate viśvarūpāyāmum
mādbhyaḥ saṃvatsarāyāmum
digbhyo antardeśebhya āśābhya āśāpālebhyo 'mum ṛtubhya ārtavebhyo adhipatibhya ādhipatyebhyo 'mum ṛṣibhya ārṣeyebhyo aṅgirobhya āṅgirasebhyo 'tharvabhya ātharvaṇebhyo 'mum vasubhyo rudrebhya ādityebhyaḥ sādhyebhya āptyebhyo 'mum marudbhyo 'śvibhyāṃ brahmaṇe brahmaṇaspataye 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi
ye svaś cakrur ye svar jajñuḥ tebhyaḥ svaḥkṛdbhyaḥ svaḥkārebhyo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi te svaḥkṛtaḥ svaḥkārā amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ parā bhāvayantu
ye tapaś cakrur ye tapo jajñuḥ tebhyas tapaskṛdbhyas tapaskārebhyo 'mum te tapaskṛtas tapaskārā amum
ye brahma cakrur ye brahma jajñuḥ tebhyo brahmakṛdbhyo brahmakārebhyo 'mum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putram ā vṛścāmi te brahmakṛto brahmakārā amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ parā bhāvayantu
aghāriṇīm amūm aghaviddhāṃ vikeśīm apapratidhimāsoktīṃ devamanuṣyāḥ paśyantu amum āmuṣyāyaṇam amuṣyāḥ putraṃ rurudhuṣīm
aliklavā gṛdhrāḥ kaṅkāḥ suparṇāḥ śvapadāḥ patatriṇaḥ vayāṃsi śakunayo 'muṣyāmuṣyāyaṇasyāmuṣyāḥ putrasyādahane carantu
tad āpaḥ pra vahata avadyaṃ ca malaṃ ca yat yad duṣvapnyam ārima yad ṛcānṛtam ūdima
āpaḥ sapta sravantīs tā no muñcaṃtv aṃhasaḥ
muñcantu mā śapathyād atho varuṇyād uta atho yamasya paḍbīśād viśvasmād devaduṣkṛtāt
jāmiśaṃsād duṣvapnyād druho mā muñcantu varuṇasya pāśāt
mahyam indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ādadhan
bhrātṛvyahaṃ sapatnaham asau me bhrātṛbhyo 'sau sapatnaḥ
taṃ hanmi taṃ duḥsvapnyena vidhyāmi tam anāyuṣṭayā vidhyāmi taṃ kṣapitāyavyena vidhyāmi tam adharāñcaṃ mṛtyupatham abhyapa nudāmi
vidma te svapna janitraṃ pāpmanaḥ putro 'sy abhūtyā adhi jāto yamasya karaṇaḥ taṃ tvā svapna tathā vidma yo bhadraḥ svapnaḥ sa mama yaḥ pāpas taṃ dviṣate pra hiṇmaḥ tam asmai gamayāmas tenainaṃ vidhyāmo 'bhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmo nirbhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmaḥ parābhūtyainaṃ vidhyāmo grāhyaiṇaṃ vidhyāmas tamasainaṃ vidhyāmo agna enaṃ kravyāda ā vṛśāmo devānām enaṃ ghoraiḥ krūraiḥ praiṣair abhi preṣyamo vaiśvāṇarasyainaṃ daṃṣṭrayor api dadhmaḥ
janitraṃ grāhyāḥ putro 'si nirṛtyā adhi
janitraṃ varuṇasya putro 'si varuṇānyā adhi
janitram ahnaḥ putro 'si rātryā adhi
janitraṃ divas putro 'si bhūmyā adhi
janitraṃ vanaspatīnāṃ putro 'sy oṣadībhyo 'dhi
janitraṃ vānaspatyānāṃ putro 'si vīrudbhyo 'dhi
janitraṃ tandriyāḥ putro 'si koṭīyā adhi
janitraṃ rakṣasāṃ putro 'sy abhvebhyo 'dhi
vidma te svapna janitraṃ gandharvāṇāṃ putro 'sy apsarobhyo adhi jāto yamasya karaṇaḥ taṃ tvā svapna iti trīṇi
dyāvāpṛthivī ahorātre nakṣatrapeśaḥ idam aham amuṣminn āmuṣyāyaṇe 'muṣyāḥ putre duṣvapnyaṃ vrajet
yad asmāsv ity āṣṭādaśakī
mā pra gāma patho vayaṃ mā yajñād indra sominaḥ mānta sthur no arātayaḥ
yo yajñasya prasādhanas tantur deveṣv ātataḥ tam āhutam aśīmahi
namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣase maho devāya tad ṛtaṃ saparyata dūredṛśe devajātāya ketave divas putrāya sūryāya śaṃsata
dyāvā ca tatra tatatanann ahāni ca na te adevaḥ pradivo vi vāsati yad etaśebhiḥ pratarai ratharyasi prācīnam anyad anu vartate raja ud anyena jyotiṣā yāsi sūrya
yena sūrya jyotiṣā bādhase tamo jagac ca viśvam abhīyarṣi bhānunā tenāsmad viśvām anirām anāhutim apāmīvām apa duṣvapnyaṃ suva
